paper.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents build on vision-language models to complete user tasks end-to-end in real applications through interface actions such as tapping, swiping, text entry, and navigation. However, existing GUI agents are trained and evaluated largely on offline trajectories, simulated environments, and standardized benchmarks. These differ substantially from real applications in interface layout, interaction logic, and abnormal-state distribution, and cannot faithfully character

summary.core_problem: 解决 GUI Agent 在离线轨迹和模拟环境中训练评测良好、但真实手机应用中执行稳定性不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 系统和训练评测闭环创新。它强调真实设备状态分布、异常状态、账号权限、支付认证和风控机制对 GUI Agent 的影响，这些因素通常被标准 benchmark 低估。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Xiaomi-GUI-0，一个面向真实移动环境的原生多模态 GUI Agent。核心是 real-device-dominant hybrid infrastructure：以物理设备为主要交互环境，结合闭环执行、真实应用状态采样和混合基础设施来训练与评估 Agent。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型参数量、训练数据规模或量化结果。可确认评测重点从离线轨迹和模拟器转向真实设备闭环，覆盖真实应用中的布局变化、交互逻辑差异和异常状态分布。
summary.authors_note: 题名和作者列表显示这是 Xiaomi-GUI-0 技术报告，团队关注真实移动端 GUI Agent 的训练、执行和评测闭环。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the gap between GUI agents that perform well on offline or simulated benchmarks and their poor execution stability in real mobile applications.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-system and training-evaluation loop design. It emphasizes real-device state distributions, abnormal states, account permissions, payment authentication, and risk-control flows that standard GUI benchmarks often miss.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Xiaomi-GUI-0, a native multimodal GUI agent for real mobile environments. The core is a real-device-dominant hybrid infrastructure, where physical devices serve as the primary interaction environment, combined with closed-loop execution, real-app state sampling, and hybrid infrastructure for training and evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, training-data size, or quantitative numbers. The evaluation focus shifts from offline trajectories and simulators to real-device closed loops, covering layout variation, interaction-logic differences, and abnormal-state distributions in real applications.
summary_en.authors_note: The title and author list indicate a Xiaomi-GUI-0 technical report focused on training, execution, and evaluation loops for real mobile GUI agents.

recommendation.zh: 看真实设备闭环和异常状态分布设计；它对 pretrain 不直接，但能校正 GUI Agent benchmark 过乐观的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the real-device loop and abnormal-state distribution design; it is not pretraining work, but it corrects over-optimistic GUI-agent benchmark priors.

paper.title: LUMOS: A Semantic Operating-System Layer for Accessibility-Grounded AI Agents
paper.abstract: Current operating systems expose interfaces optimized for human users but not for AI agents. Humans benefit from pixels, icons, windows, visual grouping, mouse movement, and keyboard shortcuts; AI agents instead need compact semantic state, grounded actions, and reliable feedback. As a result, many computer-use agents are forced to interpret screenshots, OCR output, and visual crops, introducing high token costs, visual ambiguity, latency, and coordinate uncertainty. This paper introduces LUMOS

summary.core_problem: 现有操作系统面向人类交互设计，AI Agent需解析截图、OCR输出与视觉裁剪块，带来高token成本、视觉歧义、延迟与坐标不确定性，缺乏面向Agent的原生语义交互层。
summary.importance: 系统创新，首次提出操作系统级的Agent语义交互抽象层，从底层降低GUI Agent的感知开销与交互噪声。
summary.technical_approach: 设计LUMOS语义层，将操作系统原生可访问性元数据与浏览器UI结构转换为带稳定标识符、角色、名称、值、边界与动作可供性的机器可读语义蓝图；支持通过OS自动化API查询光标附近UI元素的实时语义指针 grounding，LLM直接基于语义状态执行动作。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体LLM型号、测试任务集与量化性能数据，仅提及系统架构设计与交互流程。

summary_en.core_problem: Current operating systems are designed for human interaction, forcing AI agents to parse screenshots, OCR outputs, and visual crops, which incurs high token cost, visual ambiguity, latency, and coordinate uncertainty, with no native semantic interaction layer for agents.
summary_en.importance: System innovation, proposing the first OS-level semantic interaction abstraction layer for AI agents that reduces perception overhead and interaction noise at the underlying level.
summary_en.technical_approach: The LUMOS layer converts native OS accessibility metadata and browser UI structures into machine-readable semantic blueprints with stable identifiers, roles, names, values, bounds, and action affordances; it supports live semantic pointer grounding via OS automation APIs, allowing LLMs to act directly on semantic states.
summary_en.experiments: No specific LLM model, test benchmark, or quantitative performance metrics are disclosed in the abstract; only system architecture and interaction workflow are described.

recommendation.zh: 通用GUI Agent的系统层交互范式改进，与预训练无直接关联，仅作Agent架构设计参考。
recommendation.en: System-level interaction paradigm improvement for general GUI agents; no direct pretraining relevance, reference only for agent architecture design.

paper.title: OSWorld2.0: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on Long-Horizon Real-World Tasks
paper.abstract: Existing computer-use benchmarks fail to capture the realism, complexity, and long-horizon demands of real-world computer use, limiting their ability to reveal the limitations of frontier agents. We introduce OSWorld 2.0, a benchmark of 108 long-horizon computer-use workflows across everyday and professional tasks, designed to capture complex and challenging real-world phenomena. Each task represents a realistic end-to-end workflow that takes human users a median of about 1.6 hours to complete a

summary.core_problem: 现有电脑使用Agent基准的任务时长短、场景窄，多为单应用、孤立子任务，无法覆盖真实工作流的长时程、跨应用、步骤相互依赖、环境动态变化等核心特征，导致前沿Agent在旧基准上的高分高估了实际部署能力。该工作构建了更贴近真实场景的长时程电脑使用基准。
summary.importance: 多模态基座与通用Agent基座的能力评测、对齐数据（SFT/RL轨迹）构建均依赖电脑使用基准。现有基准的简化任务设置会掩盖基座在长时程规划、状态跟踪、错误修复等核心能力上的缺陷。OSWorld2.0提供了更严格的评测资产与真实工作流轨迹数据，可引导Agent导向的基座预训练与对齐向真实需求优化。
summary.technical_approach: 构建108个长时程真实电脑使用任务，遵循三个设计原则：1）真实工作流：任务来自专业场景的专家访谈与标注员调研，输入素材采用真实材料而非合成生成；2）长时程结构：难度来自跨多个应用的相互依赖步骤，而非任务重复或无关子任务拼接；3）多样挑战现象：每个任务标注10类能力维度（跨源推理、隐状态推断、冲突消歧、动态环境适应等）。具体实现上，自托管31个任务相关的web服务（邮件、银行、团队聊天等）以控制状态可评分；基于连贯的有状态用户配置初始化任务；注入任务中消息模拟动态环境；提供带有限知识的模拟用户；评分采用细粒度功能性检查点（平均每任务27.25个）而非模型打分；所有任务通过单元测试、人工重解、前沿Agent rollout审计，避免奖励黑客与假阴性问题。
summary.experiments: 任务统计显示，人类完成任务的中位数时长为1.6小时（是OSWorld1.0的48倍），Claude Opus4.7最大思考模式下平均每任务需318次工具调用（OSWorld1.0约为30次）。对Claude Opus4.8/4.7、GPT-5.5、主流开源模型在150/300/500步预算下的评测显示，最强配置（Claude Opus4.8+最大思考+批量工具调用）的严格二分类完成率仅为20.6%，部分完成分为54.8%；token效率最高的GPT-5.5完成率约为13%，token消耗不到Opus的1/5。长时程任务的完成率随时长增加暴跌至接近0，但部分完成分仍保持较高水平；人类认为简单的任务对Agent仍存在较高难度。能力缺陷分析显示，Agent的弱点集中在隐状态推断、多项目状态跟踪、冲突消歧、动态环境适应，且用于错误修复的预算占比不到7%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：首先阅读引言部分，了解现有基准的核心缺陷与OSWorld2.0的三个设计原则；随后查看第二节的任务构建标准与环境设计要点；再浏览评测部分的核心性能数据与能力缺口分析。无需深入附录中的具体任务细节，除非需要开展Agent评测或对齐数据构建工作。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing computer-use agent benchmarks rely on short, narrow, single-application tasks with isolated subtasks, which fail to capture core features of real-world workflows: long horizon, cross-application dependencies, and dynamic environments. This leads to inflated frontier agent scores that do not reflect real deployment capability. A long-horizon computer-use benchmark aligned with real scenarios is constructed to address this gap.
summary_en.importance: Multimodal base models and general-purpose agent bases depend on computer-use benchmarks for capability evaluation and alignment data (SFT/RL trajectory) curation. The simplified task setup of prior benchmarks hides critical weaknesses of base models in long-horizon planning, state tracking, and error recovery. OSWorld 2.0 provides stricter evaluation assets and realistic workflow trajectory data that can guide pre-training and alignment of agent-oriented base models toward real-world requirements.
summary_en.technical_approach: 108 long-horizon real-world computer-use tasks are built following three design principles: 1) Authentic workflows: tasks are sourced from expert interviews and annotator research on real professional scenarios, with input artifacts adapted from real materials instead of synthetic generation; 2) Long-horizon structure: difficulty comes from interdependent steps across multiple applications, rather than task repetition or concatenation of unrelated subtasks; 3) Diverse challenge phenomena: each task is annotated with 10 capability dimensions (cross-source reasoning, implicit-state inference, conflict disambiguation, dynamic environment adaptation, etc.). For implementation, 31 task-facing web services (email, banking, team chat, etc.) are self-hosted to enable controlled, scorable states; tasks are initialized from coherent stateful user profiles; mid-task messages are injected to simulate dynamic environments; a simulated user with bounded knowledge is provided; scoring relies on fine-grained functional checkpoints (average 27.25 per task) instead of model-based judgment. All tasks are audited via unit tests, human re-solving, and frontier agent rollouts to prevent reward hacking and false negatives.
summary_en.experiments: Task statistics show a median human completion time of 1.6 hours (48× longer than OSWorld 1.0) and an average of 318 tool calls per task for Claude Opus 4.7 with maximum thinking (vs. ~30 in OSWorld 1.0). Evaluations of Claude Opus 4.8/4.7, GPT-5.5, and leading open-source models under 150/300/500 step budgets find that the strongest configuration (Claude Opus 4.8 + maximum thinking + batched tool calls) reaches only 20.6% strict binary completion rate and 54.8% partial score. GPT-5.5, the most token-efficient model, achieves ~13% completion rate with less than 1/5 of Opus's token consumption. Completion rate drops to near zero on the longest workflows despite high partial scores, and tasks rated easy by humans remain challenging for agents. Capability gap analysis shows weaknesses concentrate on implicit-state inference, multi-item state tracking, conflict disambiguation, and dynamic environment adaptation, with agents allocating less than 7% of their budget to error recovery.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction first for core limitations of prior benchmarks and three design principles of OSWorld 2.0. Then review task construction standards and environment design in Section 2, followed by key performance results and capability gap analysis in the evaluation section. Skip detailed task descriptions in appendices unless working on agent benchmarking or alignment data curation. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不改预训练 recipe，但会改你评估 Agent 的 prior：只看任务成功率不够，318 步级别的失败分布更像真实产品问题。
recommendation.en: This will not change a pretraining recipe, but it should change the evaluation prior: success rate on short tasks misses the failure modes that appear around 300 tool calls.

paper.title: GUICrafter: Weakly-Supervised GUI Agent Leveraging Massive Unannotated Screenshots
paper.abstract: Data, as the fundamental substrate of modern intelligence, has greatly driven the development of current foundation models. Naturally, researchers aim to extend this paradigm to the domain of GUI agents, hoping to build strong GUI agents through a similar paradigm. However, GUI agent data cannot be directly harvested from the internet, making it costly and difficult to collect at scale. As a result, current GUI agents suffer from poor cross-device generalization and limited visual grounding abil

summary.core_problem: GUI agent 缺少大规模、低成本、细粒度的训练数据，导致视觉定位能力弱，跨设备、跨界面泛化不稳。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的价值主要在数据构造和训练信号设计。它把未标注截图、网页 DOM/交互元素、移动端自动采集的 GUI 元素转成可验证的弱监督训练任务，接近“GUI 领域的预训练数据引擎”。对基座研究员的启发不在 GUI 任务本身，而在如何为多模态 agent 构造可扩展、低人工标注成本、带可验证奖励的预训练阶段。
summary.technical_approach: GUICrafter 采用两阶段训练。第一阶段是 weakly-supervised GUI pretraining：从真实网页和已有移动端 GUI 数据中抽取可交互元素，把按钮、输入框、链接等交互信号转换为 meta-task，让模型根据截图完成定位和操作，并用可验证奖励更新模型。这里的关键取舍是不用人工写完整任务轨迹，也不依赖 MLLM 自动生成高噪声标签，而是利用界面自带的交互结构提供监督。第二阶段使用少量高质量人工标注 GUI 任务做强化微调，继续用 RLVR/GRPO 类算法优化实际任务表现。课程学习的设计比较清楚：先让模型广泛看界面、学元素 grounding，再用更接近真实任务的数据校准多步行为。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖六个不同平台的 GUI benchmark，包括 Mind2Web 和 ScreenSpot-Pro 等。论文报告 Stage 1 单独就能显著提升 grounding accuracy；Stage 1 加 Stage 2 后，视觉定位和泛化进一步提升。一个值得注意的结果是，GUICrafter 使用的 Stage 1 与 Stage 2 总训练数据量约为 UI-TARS 的 0.1%，但达到可比或更好的结果。在相同人工标注数据量下，它也超过 GUI-R1 等已有 RLVR 方法。这个结果说明收益主要来自弱监督数据规模和训练信号质量，而不是简单堆人工轨迹。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 GUI 数据困境的拆解，Method 中 Stage 1 的数据生成流程、meta-task 构造和奖励设计，以及实验部分关于 Stage 1/Stage 2 的消融。若只关心预训练，可以跳过具体 GUI benchmark 细节，集中看未标注截图如何变成可训练样本，以及为什么可验证交互信号比自动 caption/action 标注更稳。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the data bottleneck for GUI agents: fine-grained GUI grounding and multi-step action data are expensive to annotate, and current agents generalize poorly across devices, layouts, and application domains.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining lies in the data pipeline rather than in GUI automation as an application. GUICrafter shows how large collections of unlabeled screenshots and webpages can be converted into weakly supervised, reward-verifiable training instances. This is useful for thinking about multimodal agent pretraining, especially when the environment contains latent supervision signals such as DOM structure, clickable regions, input fields, and interaction affordances.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses a two-stage curriculum. Stage 1, called weakly supervised GUI pretraining, extracts interaction signals from crawled webpages and mobile GUI data, then turns them into meta-tasks that ask the model to locate and act on the corresponding GUI elements. The model receives verifiable rewards when its action matches the interactive target, and training is performed with an RLVR-style algorithm based on GRPO. Stage 2 adds a smaller amount of high-quality human-annotated GUI task data for reinforcement fine-tuning. The key design choice is to avoid noisy MLLM-generated labels and expensive full-trajectory annotation, using structured GUI affordances as the supervision source instead.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on six GUI benchmarks spanning different platforms, including Mind2Web and ScreenSpot-Pro. Stage 1 alone improves grounding accuracy, and the full two-stage curriculum further improves both grounding and generalization. The reported data efficiency is the main empirical point: the total amount of Stage 1 and Stage 2 training data is about 0.1% of UI-TARS, while achieving comparable or better performance. Under the same amount of human-annotated data, GUICrafter also outperforms prior RLVR-based GUI agents such as GUI-R1.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Read the problem formulation in the introduction, then focus on the Stage 1 data construction pipeline, the meta-task design, and the reward mechanism. The most useful ablations are those separating weakly supervised pretraining from the second-stage high-quality reinforcement fine-tuning. Readers focused on foundation-model training can skip most benchmark-specific GUI details.

recommendation.zh: 弱监督 + 课程学习的思路对数据稀缺的 agent 领域有参考，主要看 §3 两阶段训练设计和无标注信号的构造方式
recommendation.en: The weak-supervision + curriculum-learning pipeline is instructive for data-scarce agent domains; focus on §3 two-stage training design and how unlabeled signals are constructed.

paper.title: Agent-Computer Observation Interfaces Enable Dynamic Computer Use
paper.abstract: SWE-agent established the action interface as an underexplored design axis for software-engineering agents; we make the analogous case for the observation interface in computer-use (CU) agents. Current CU agents, closed and open-source alike, tie observation to action--one screenshot every 3-5 s, no audio--leaving them blind and deaf between screenshots to video, animations, transient UI events, meetings, and spoken instructions. We introduce the Agent-Computer Observation Interface (AOI), a mod

summary.core_problem: 当前 computer-use Agent 多数只在动作之间接收低频截图，难以处理视频、动画、临时 UI 事件、会议音频和口头指令。
summary.importance: 贡献是把 Agent 的 observation interface 作为独立设计轴，并给出动态计算机使用任务的系统接口和 benchmark；它更接近 Agent 系统研究，而不是模型预训练研究。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Agent-Computer Observation Interface，解耦连续自适应观察和离散动作，包含三类门控组件：动作间关键帧捕获、音量门控语音转写、由 CU 模型生成并持久化为文本的视觉叙述；静态无声场景下几乎不产生额外信息，退化为常规循环。
summary.experiments: 在 DynaCU-Bench 上测试 100 个动态浏览器任务和 50 个静态控制任务；7B 到 frontier 级 CU 模型在动态任务上提升 17 到 48 个百分点，摘要称静态任务不退化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets computer-use agents that observe only sparse screenshots between actions and therefore miss video, animation, transient UI events, meetings, and spoken instructions.
summary_en.importance: It frames the observation interface as an independent design axis and introduces both a system interface and a dynamic CU benchmark; this is useful for agent systems, but peripheral to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Agent-Computer Observation Interface decouples continuous adaptive observation from discrete actions through gated inter-step keyframe capture, volume-gated audio transcription, and persistent text visual narration generated by a CU model. On static and silent content, it reduces to the standard loop.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate on DynaCU-Bench with 100 dynamic browser tasks and a 50-task static control. CU models from 7B to frontier scale gain 17 to 48 percentage points on dynamic tasks, with no reported degradation on static tasks.

recommendation.zh: 这是 Agent 接口论文，不是模型论文；扫 AOI 组件和动态任务失败例即可，训练侧收益很间接。
recommendation.en: This is an agent-interface paper rather than a model paper; skim the AOI components and dynamic-task failures, with only indirect implications for training.

paper.title: Introducing computer use in Gemini 3.5 Flash

summary.core_problem: 此前Gemini的计算机交互（Computer Use）能力仅由独立的Gemini 2.5专用模型提供，开发者构建跨浏览器、移动端、桌面端的智能体时，需要在专用模型与通用基座模型之间路由任务，导致上下文割裂、无法复用通用模型原生的函数调用与搜索/地图grounding能力；同时，智能体在真实生产环境运行时，还存在间接prompt注入、敏感/不可逆操作无管控的安全空白。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的具体影响：1）验证了通用多模态基座可以原生集成GUI感知与操作能力，无需拆分专用模型即可统一表征工具调用、多模态grounding、跨平台计算机交互三类能力，为统一建模范式提供了落地参考；2）针对计算机交互场景的定向对抗训练，为「特定能力配套场景化安全信号注入」提供了具体实践，区别于通用RLHF的粗粒度安全对齐；3）分层防护的设计明确了模型训练（内置安全）与系统外围防护的分工边界，避免将所有安全约束压入预训练/对齐阶段导致的通用能力损失。
summary.technical_approach: 现有计算机交互智能体主要有两种实现路径：一是使用独立的专用小模型，无法复用通用大模型的知识与工具调用能力，上下文割裂；二是给通用LLM外挂GUI操作工具，依赖prompt工程触发，稳定性与连贯性差。本次方案的不同之处在于：1）原生集成进主模型：将原Gemini 2.5独立的计算机使用能力合并入Gemini 3.5 Flash主基座，与已有的函数调用、Search/Maps grounding等内置工具共享同一套表征与推理流程，无需跨模型切换上下文，降低延迟、提升多能力协同的连贯性；2）场景化安全对齐：不依赖通用RLHF的安全能力，针对计算机交互场景的特殊攻击面（如网页内嵌隐藏提示、文档中的间接注入指令）做定向对抗训练，缓解实时环境下的prompt注入风险；3）分层防护机制：配套两层可选的企业级防护——敏感/不可逆操作强制用户显式确认、检测到间接prompt注入时自动终止任务，采用纵深防御思路，避免把所有安全约束都压入模型训练阶段；4）统一接口暴露：通过Gemini API与企业智能体平台对外提供服务，开发者无需自行搭建GUI操作的中间件。
summary.experiments: 博客未披露具体的模型参数量、训练数据规模、定量benchmark分数。公开信息仅包括：1）官方宣称该集成方案是Google当前在agentic计算机使用任务上的最优性能表现；2）给出两个典型场景的功能演示：通过GUI分析自动梳理Gemini app的分类功能列表、自动审计Gemini官方文档的可访问性问题；3）确认该能力已在企业客户侧完成落地验证，但未披露具体性能提升的量化数据。
summary.reading_guide: 该内容为官方产品博客而非学术论文，精读时重点关注以下部分：1）能力集成逻辑：对比之前独立的Gemini 2.5 computer use模型，梳理原生集成到通用基座的设计思路，尤其是与原有内置工具链的兼容方式；2）安全防护章节：研究针对计算机交互场景的定向对抗训练设计，以及两层企业级防护的边界划分——这部分明确了模型训练内置安全与系统级外围防护的取舍，是对预训练对齐研究最有启发的内容；3）公开的参考实现与Browserbase demo的API定义：可以反推模型输出的GUI动作空间（点击、输入、滚动等）的token化方式；4）值得深挖的方向：从能力融合效果反推预训练阶段可能采用的「GUI截图-动作配对数据+通用图文/工具调用数据」的混合训练配比与课程策略。
summary.authors_note: Google DeepMind，具体作者名单未在博客中披露

summary_en.core_problem: Prior to this release, Gemini's computer interaction (Computer Use) capability was exclusive to a standalone Gemini 2.5 specialized model. Developers building agents for cross-browser, mobile, and desktop environments had to route tasks between separate specialized and general-purpose base models, causing context fragmentation and inability to reuse the general model's native function calling and Search/Maps grounding capabilities. Additionally, agents operating in live production environments faced unaddressed security gaps, including indirect prompt injection and unregulated sensitive or irreversible actions.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, this work delivers three concrete takeaways: 1) It validates that a general-purpose multimodal base can natively integrate GUI perception and operation capabilities, unifying representations for tool calling, multimodal grounding, and cross-platform computer interaction without siloed specialized models, providing a real-world reference for unified modeling paradigms. 2) The scenario-specific adversarial training for computer use offers a practical example of injecting targeted safety signals for specific capabilities, as opposed to relying on coarse-grained general RLHF alignment. 3) The layered defense framework clarifies the division of labor between safety embedded in model training and external system-level safeguards, avoiding the capability degradation that comes from cramming all safety constraints into pretraining or alignment stages.
summary_en.technical_approach: Existing computer-use agent systems follow two suboptimal paths: standalone specialized small models that cannot reuse general LLM knowledge and tool capabilities, leading to context fragmentation; or general LLMs wrapped with external GUI operation tools that rely on prompt engineering, resulting in poor stability and consistency. This implementation takes a different approach: 1) Native base model integration: It merges the previously standalone Gemini 2.5 Computer Use capability into the main Gemini 3.5 Flash base, sharing a single representation and inference pipeline with existing built-in tools (function calling, Search grounding, Maps grounding) to eliminate cross-model context switching, reduce latency, and improve coherence across multi-capability collaboration. 2) Scenario-specific safety alignment: Instead of relying on general RLHF safety capabilities, it applies targeted adversarial training tailored to the unique attack surfaces of computer interaction scenarios (such as hidden prompts embedded in web pages, indirect injection instructions in documents) to mitigate prompt injection risks in live environments. 3) Layered safeguard mechanism: It ships two optional enterprise-grade protection layers — mandatory explicit user confirmation for sensitive/irreversible actions, and automatic task termination when indirect prompt injection is detected — adopting a defense-in-depth approach to avoid overloading model training with all safety constraints. 4) Unified interface exposure: The capability is served via the Gemini API and Enterprise Agent Platform, removing the need for developers to build custom GUI operation middleware.
summary_en.experiments: The blog does not disclose specific model parameter counts, training dataset sizes, or quantitative benchmark scores. Publicly shared information includes: 1) An official statement that this integrated implementation delivers Google's best reported performance on agentic Computer Use tasks to date. 2) Two functional demo use cases: automated categorized feature listing of the Gemini app via GUI analysis, and automated accessibility auditing of Gemini's official documentation. 3) Confirmation that the capability has been deployed and validated with enterprise customers, though no quantitative performance lift metrics are provided.
summary_en.reading_guide: As this is an official product blog rather than an academic paper, focus on the following sections for pretraining-relevant insights: 1) Capability integration logic: Compare the design with the previous standalone Gemini 2.5 Computer Use model, and extract the design rationale for native integration into the general base, especially the compatibility mechanism with existing built-in toolchains. 2) Safety and safeguards section: Study the targeted adversarial training design for computer-use-specific attack surfaces, and the boundary划分 of the two-layer enterprise protection framework — this part clarifies the tradeoff between safety embedded in model training and system-level external safeguards, and is the most insightful content for pretraining alignment research. 3) Public reference implementation and Browserbase demo API specifications: These can be used to infer the tokenization scheme for the model's output GUI action space (click, input, scroll, etc.). 4) Worth further exploration: Reverse-engineer the possible mixed training ratio and curriculum strategy for "GUI screenshot-action paired data + general text-image/tool calling data" in the pretraining stage based on the observed capability fusion performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Google DeepMind; specific author names are not disclosed in the blog post

recommendation.zh: 别当研究论文读；把它当产品信号看，重点想清楚 GUI 轨迹数据、动作 token 化和安全约束会怎样反过来塑造下一代预训练目标。
recommendation.en: Do not read this as a research paper; read it as a product signal about where GUI trajectories, action tokenization, and safety constraints may reshape future pretraining objectives.

paper.title: VisCritic: Visual State Comparison as Process Reward for GUI Agents
paper.abstract: GUI agents powered by vision-language models show strong potential for automating digital tasks, yet frequently fail in long-horizon scenarios due to the absence of step-level verification. Existing process reward models verify actions through textual reasoning alone, missing the visual nature of GUI state changes. We introduce VisCritic, a visual process reward framework that verifies agent actions by directly comparing pre-action and post-action screenshots in visual feature space. VisCritic e

summary.core_problem: 现有GUI智能体的过程奖励模型仅依赖文本推理，忽略GUI状态变化的视觉本质，导致长时序任务中步骤级验证失效。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出视觉过程奖励范式，为GUI智能体提供即插即用的步骤级验证模块，同时给出弱监督数据构造管线。
summary.technical_approach: 设计VisCritic框架，采用孪生视觉Transformer提取动作前后截图的变化感知特征，结合动作感知批评头联合评估动作成功率、任务进度与错误类型，无需额外人工标注即可从已有轨迹构造弱监督训练数据。
summary.experiments: 在5个GUI智能体基准上进行离线分析与集成实验，验证其作为即插即用增强模块对多种智能体的通用性，未披露具体模型参数量与训练数据规模。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing process reward models for GUI agents rely solely on textual reasoning and ignore the visual nature of GUI state changes, causing step-level verification failures in long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation introducing a visual process reward paradigm with a plug-and-play step verifier and a weakly supervised data construction pipeline for GUI agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: VisCritic uses a Siamese vision transformer to extract change-aware representations from pre/post-action screenshots, paired with an action-aware critic head that jointly evaluates action success, task progress, and error type; critic training data is built from existing trajectories without extra human labels.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated as a plug-and-play enhancement across five GUI agent benchmarks with offline analyses; no specific model sizes or training data scales disclosed.

recommendation.zh: GUI Agent的视觉奖励建模属于垂直Agent方法创新，对预训练研究员仅作弱信号参考，看摘要和实验结论即可。
recommendation.en: Visual reward modeling for GUI agents is a vertical agent innovation; only weak signal for pretraining researchers, read abstract and results only.

paper.title: Training Open Models for Agentic Phone Use
paper.abstract: Phones are becoming an important execution surface for general-purpose agents, but training open models for reliable phone use remains difficult because the environment that matters at deployment, real devices running real apps, is slow, stateful, side-effectful, and hard to reset or verify, while scalable mock environments only approximate real behavior. We present PhoneBuddy, a training recipe and open-model line for agentic phone use that combines a real-app environment with a mock-app enviro

summary.core_problem: 在真实手机环境难以大规模采样、难以重置和难以验证的条件下，如何训练可用的开放式手机操作 agent。
summary.importance: 这是通用 agent 训练工作，不是基座预训练论文。它的价值主要在于训练 recipe：把真实 app 环境与可扩展的 mock 环境混合，用于 SFT 和 RL。对预训练研究员的启发有限，但对 post-train 环境构造、sim2real 和 agent 数据生成有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 PhoneBuddy 训练流程和模型线。核心做法是构建 PhoneWorld，从真实 GUI 使用结构重建可运行的 mock apps；先在真实环境与 mock 环境混合轨迹上做共享 SFT，再比较只在真实 app 上做 RL 与在真实+mock 混合环境上做 RL 的效果。方法重点是环境设计与训练配方，而不是新的 agent 架构。
summary.experiments: 在人类评测的 150 个真实手机任务上，任务成功率从 SFT 后的 36.67% 提升到真实 app RL 的 40.67%，再到混合 RL 的 45.33%。任务覆盖 app、mini-app 和跨 app workflow。摘要未给出底座模型规模、训练 token 或更细的错误分析。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 The Chinese University of Hong Kong、Renmin University of China、Wuhan University 等。未见可明确确认的顶级实验室代表性作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles how to train open phone-use agents when real-device environments are slow, stateful, hard to reset, and difficult to verify at scale.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-training paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining paper. Its main value is the training recipe: mixing real-app environments with scalable mock environments for SFT and RL. For pretraining researchers, the relevance is limited, though it offers some signal on post-training environment design, sim-to-real transfer, and agent data generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors present PhoneBuddy, a training recipe and model line for agentic phone use. The key component is PhoneWorld, which reconstructs runnable mock apps from real GUI usage structure. Training first performs shared SFT on trajectories from both real and mock environments, then compares RL on real apps only versus mixed RL on both real and mock apps. The contribution is mainly environment construction and recipe design, not a new agent architecture.
summary_en.experiments: On a 150-task human evaluation over real phones, task success improves from 36.67% after SFT to 40.67% with real-app RL and 45.33% with mixed RL. The tasks span apps, mini-apps, and cross-app workflows. The abstract does not provide base model size, training scale, or deeper failure analysis.
summary_en.authors_note: The institutions include The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Renmin University of China, and Wuhan University. No clearly identifiable top-lab signature author can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 更像 agent recipe，不是 pretrain 论文；如果你关心环境混合训练，只看真实环境 RL vs 混合 RL 的增益就够了，别指望学到新的基座方法。
recommendation.en: This is an agent recipe, not a pretraining paper; if you care about mixed-environment training, just read the real-RL vs mixed-RL comparison and do not expect a new foundation-model insight.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: Automating SKILL.md Generation for Computer-Using Agents via Interaction Trajectory Mining
paper.abstract: Explicit skill libraries make computer-using agents easier to inspect, but it remains unclear whether such libraries can be mined from interaction data in a way that improves downstream policies. We study this question through a three-stage pipeline that segments GUI trajectories, clusters segments into candidate skills, and trains a skill-aware policy from the resulting annotations. The mined clusters are readable on the source benchmark: five of eight clusters have at least 0.95 purity against

summary.core_problem: 研究能否从 GUI agent 的交互轨迹中自动挖掘可读 SKILL.md，并用这些技能标注提升下游 computer-using agent policy。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 诊断研究，价值主要在负结果。它区分了“技能簇可读”与“技能能提升策略迁移”这两个容易混淆的目标，对 agent skill library 的自动构建有警示意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出三阶段 pipeline：先切分 GUI 交互轨迹，再把轨迹片段聚类成候选技能，最后用这些注释训练 skill-aware policy。作者同时分析边界检测、无序片段表示和离线 reward model 的失败点。
summary.experiments: 在源 benchmark 上，8 个聚类中有 5 个相对 InteraSkill Workflows 标签达到至少 0.95 purity，说明可读性较好；但 transfer 弱，GRPO 只把 IW skill-step accuracy 从 18.5% 提到 20.5%，BrowseComp+ 基本不变，并在关键源域指标上弱于简单频率先验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether readable SKILL.md files can be automatically mined from GUI-agent interaction trajectories and then used to improve downstream computer-using policies.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a diagnostic agent study. Its value lies in the negative result: readable mined skills do not necessarily transfer into better policies, which is a useful warning for automatic skill-library construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline segments GUI trajectories, clusters segments into candidate skills, and trains a skill-aware policy from the resulting annotations. The analysis points to boundary detection, orderless segment representation, and offline reward modeling as limiting factors.
summary_en.experiments: On the source benchmark, five of eight clusters reach at least 0.95 purity against InteraSkill Workflows labels, indicating readable structure. However, GRPO only improves IW skill-step accuracy from 18.5% to 20.5%, leaves BrowseComp+ nearly unchanged, and underperforms trivial frequency priors on key source-domain metrics.

recommendation.zh: 负结果比方法更有用：看 purity 与 transfer 的数字即可，别把可读 cluster 误当成可用技能。
recommendation.en: The negative result is the useful part: check the purity-versus-transfer numbers and do not equate readable clusters with usable skills.

paper.title: Skill-Guided Continuation Distillation for GUI Agents
paper.abstract: Improving GUI agents typically relies on behavior cloning on expert trajectories. However, as the current policy deviates from the expert policy, it inevitably encounters policy-induced off-trajectory states during closed-loop execution, i.e., states that fall outside the expert trajectories. Since expert trajectories provide no demonstrations for these unseen states, such states receive no effective supervision, leaving the policy unable to select the correct action. To close this supervision g

summary.core_problem: 现有GUI Agent基于专家轨迹的行为克隆训练会在闭环执行中遇到无有效监督的策略诱导离轨状态，且GUI环境下这类状态复现成本高、现有筛选方法覆盖差且有偏差。
summary.importance: 该工作的迭代自改进思路可迁移至所有需要闭环交互的Agent后训练场景，从失败模式中提炼引导技能以合成高质量监督数据的方法，对后训练数据构造有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出迭代自改进框架SGCD，分两步补全离轨监督：一是通过无引导策略执行不同步数的早期交互，无需人工启发式即可生成覆盖真实分布的离轨状态；二是从历史rollout提取续接计划、关键目标、失败陷阱、成功标准等技能，引导策略从离轨状态生成经验证的成功续接轨迹，最后与专家轨迹混合训练。
summary.experiments: 在OSWorld-Verified基准上，Qwen3-VL-8B、Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B、STEP3-VL-10B三个模型的任务成功率均从30%左右提升至50%以上，跨模型通用性得到验证。
summary.reading_guide: 先读引言中离轨监督缺口的定义与两个核心观察（失败集中在早期、失败模式重复），再看SGCD的核心设计逻辑，最后浏览跨模型性能实验；预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: GUI agents trained via behavior cloning on expert trajectories face a supervision gap for policy-induced off-trajectory states during closed-loop execution, plus high state reproduction costs and biased, sparse coverage from existing heuristic state selection methods.
summary_en.importance: The iterative self-improvement pipeline transfers to all closed-loop interactive agent post-training scenarios. The method of extracting guidance skills from failure patterns to synthesize high-quality supervision data offers direct reference for post-training data construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: SGCD is an iterative self-improvement framework that fills the off-trajectory supervision gap via two steps. First, the unguided current policy is rolled out for varying early-step counts to generate realistic off-trajectory states without hand-crafted heuristics. Second, continuation skills including plans, critical targets, failure traps and success criteria extracted from historical rollouts guide a policy to produce verified successful continuations from these states, which are then mixed with expert trajectories for training.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on OSWorld-Verified across three VLMs (Qwen3-VL-8B, Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B, STEP3-VL-10B), all models see consistent task success rate improvements from ~30% to over 50%, validating cross-model generality.
summary_en.reading_guide: First read the introduction for the definition of off-trajectory supervision deficit and two key observations (early-stage failure concentration, recurring failure patterns); then review SGCD's core design logic; finally browse cross-model performance experiments. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 其'主动生成分布外状态再补监督'的思路可迁移到LLM后训练的分布覆盖问题，重点看§3的状态构造与技能抽取细节。
recommendation.en: The idea of actively generating out-of-distribution states then providing supervision is transferable to LLM post-training coverage issues; focus on §3 state construction and skill extraction.

paper.title: ProCUA-SFT Technical Report
paper.abstract: Training computer-use agents (CUAs) -- models that interact with graphical desktops through screenshots and keyboard/mouse actions -- requires large-scale, diverse trajectory data collected in full desktop environments. The largest public resource, AgentNet (22.5K human trajectories), leads to negative transfer when used for supervised fine-tuning (SFT): continuing training UI-TARS 7B on AgentNet causes OSWorld success rate to fall from 26.3% to 8-10%. We present ProCUA-SFT, a dataset of 3.1M st

summary.core_problem: 现有最大公开计算机使用Agent（CUA）轨迹数据集AgentNet用于SFT时会产生严重负迁移，导致UI-TARS 7B在OSWorld基准上成功率从26.3%降至8-10%。
summary.importance: 数据贡献+工程创新，提出百万级规模的高质量CUA SFT数据集，以及自动化的任务合成与可行性校验pipeline，解决公开数据集的负迁移问题。
summary.technical_approach: 构建全自动化数据合成pipeline：基于真实电子表格、演示文稿、OSWorld配置在活桌面中合成 grounded 任务，通过二元预条件检查验证任务可行性后，rollout生成93K条合成轨迹，蒸馏得到3.1M step级SFT样本；下游模型架构保持不变，仅用该数据集执行SFT。
summary.experiments: 基线模型为UI-TARS 7B，对比数据集为AgentNet（22.5K人类轨迹），评估基准为OSWorld；覆盖2484种应用组合，AgentNet SFT导致性能大幅下降，ProCUA-SFT可避免负迁移并提升性能（摘要截断，具体提升幅度未披露）。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队来自NVIDIA，Andrew Tao为英伟达资深研究员，长期从事大模型与多模态Agent研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The largest public computer-use agent (CUA) trajectory dataset AgentNet causes severe negative transfer during SFT, reducing UI-TARS 7B's OSWorld success rate from 26.3% to 8-10%.
summary_en.importance: Data contribution + engineering innovation, presenting a million-scale high-quality CUA SFT dataset and an automated task synthesis + feasibility verification pipeline that resolves negative transfer from public datasets.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a fully automated data synthesis pipeline: synthesizes grounded tasks on live desktops seeded with real spreadsheets, presentations and OSWorld configs, verifies feasibility via binary precondition checking, rolls out 93K synthetic trajectories and distills them into 3.1M step-level SFT samples; downstream model architecture remains unchanged, only SFT is performed.
summary_en.experiments: Baseline is UI-TARS 7B, comparison dataset is AgentNet (22.5K human trajectories), evaluation benchmark is OSWorld; covers 2,484 application combinations; AgentNet SFT causes severe performance drop while ProCUA-SFT avoids negative transfer and improves performance (abstract truncated, exact uplift not disclosed).
summary_en.authors_note: Author team is from NVIDIA; Andrew Tao is a senior researcher at NVIDIA focusing on large models and multimodal agents.

recommendation.zh: 数据合成pipeline中的预条件检查设计可借鉴，用于避免Agent SFT的负迁移，其余为常规工程增量。
recommendation.en: The precondition check design in the data synthesis pipeline is worth referencing to avoid negative transfer in agent SFT; the rest is standard incremental engineering.

paper.title: PreAct: Computer-Using Agents that Get Faster on Repeated Tasks
paper.abstract: Computer-using agents drive real software through the screen -- clicking and typing -- but they solve every task from scratch: asked to repeat a task, an agent re-reads the screen, re-reasons every tap, and pays the full cost again. We present PreAct, which lets such an agent get faster on tasks it has done before. The first time it succeeds, PreAct compiles the run into a small state-machine program-states that check the screen, transitions that act-and on later runs replays it directly instead

summary.core_problem: 现有基于屏幕交互的计算机操作Agent每次执行重复任务时都从零启动完整的视觉-推理-行动循环，没有对历史成功经验的可验证复用能力，重复任务执行冗余成本高、效率低。
summary.importance: 为Agent在使用过程中的效率自提升提供了轻量可落地的范式，核心的"先校验再执行、入库前先验证"设计思路对大模型调用缓存、技能复用类工作有直接参考价值，同时点出了当前Agent评测普遍忽略重复任务效率维度的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 1. Agent首次成功完成任务后，将完整执行轨迹编译为小型状态机：每个状态存储屏幕校验规则，每个迁移对应具体可执行操作；2. 后续遇到同类任务时优先执行状态机，每步操作前先校验当前屏幕是否符合状态机预期，完全匹配则无需调用大模型直接执行，出现不匹配立刻交回原始Agent接管；3. 新编译的程序入库前额外做一次独立完整重放，只有通过任务本身的判定器确认确实能完成目标的状态机才会存入技能库，避免错误程序累积导致性能随使用衰减。
summary.experiments: 在AndroidWorld（移动端）、OSWorld（桌面端）、WebArena（网页端）三个跨平台基准上测试，成功复用状态机的重复任务执行速度比全量调用Agent快8.5-13倍，全程无逐步骤大模型调用；屏幕校验机制相比无校验的盲目重放，在冷启动到热启动的过渡阶段任务成功率提升1.75-2.6个点；检索环节用简单嵌入检索替代大模型选程序，检索准确率仅从100%降到75.6%但成本大幅降低，对最终效果影响极小；提示词措辞、手写运行护栏等因素对结果无显著影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看引言部分对现有复用方案缺陷的对比、核心的两层校验设计，以及消融实验中区分高影响设计与无关设计的结论，不需要深入推导状态机构建的实现细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing screen-interfacing computer-using agents solve every task from scratch even for recurring routines, running full vision-language reasoning cycles for every action without verifiable reuse of past successful trajectories, leading to high redundant cost on repeated tasks.
summary_en.importance: This work presents a lightweight, production-ready paradigm for agent efficiency improvement over extended use. Its core design principles of 'check before acting, verify before storing' provide direct reference for LLM call caching and skill reuse systems, and highlights the missing repeated-task efficiency dimension in most current agent evaluation protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. After an agent successfully completes a task for the first time, PreAct compiles the full trajectory into a lightweight finite state machine, where each state stores a screen state validation rule, and each transition stores a concrete executable action. 2. For subsequent matches to the same task, PreAct runs the state machine directly: it validates screen alignment with expected state before every action, invokes no LLM calls during successful replay, and immediately returns control to the base agent when a screen mismatch is detected. 3. Newly compiled state machines are only added to the skill library after a full independent replay that passes the benchmark's native task verifier, preventing accumulation of buggy programs that cause performance degradation over time.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across three platforms: AndroidWorld (mobile), OSWorld (desktop), WebArena (web). Warm replays of matched tasks run 8.5-13x faster than full agent inference with zero per-step LLM calls. The screen check mechanism improves success rate by 1.75-2.6 tasks across the cold-to-warm transition compared to blind replay without validation. Replacing LLM-based skill retrieval with a simple embedding retriever drops retrieval accuracy from 100% to 75.6% but has negligible impact on end performance at significantly lower cost. Factors including prompt wording and hand-written runtime guardrails show no measurable effect on results.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper. Focus on the comparison of limitations of prior skill reuse approaches in the introduction, the two-layer verification design, and the ablation results separating high-impact design choices from irrelevant ones. There is no need to dig into low-level implementation details of state machine construction. Expected reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和验证门槛即可；它把 agent 记忆做成可检查程序，比向量记忆更像工程上能落地的重复任务缓存。
recommendation.en: Read the method and validation gate; programmatic replay is a cleaner repeated-task cache than vector-memory reuse.

paper.title: Naive Visual Memory is Not Enough: A Failure-Mode Study of GUI Agents
paper.abstract: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents are increasingly used to automate complex computer tasks across applications, websites, and operating systems. To improve their reliability, recent work has introduced experiential memory, where agents retrieve prior trajectories to guide decision-making in similar states. More recent approaches further extend this idea to visual memory by storing and retrieving screenshots from past interactions, providing agents with richer contextual information than text

summary.core_problem: 分析 GUI agent 中“视觉记忆”到底在修复哪些失败模式、又会引入哪些新错误，而不是默认记忆越多越好。
summary.importance: 价值在于 failure-mode 分析而非提出新 agent 架构。对做通用 agent、工具使用和长期交互的研究员有参考意义，但对 LLM 基座预训练的直接推动有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一套 GUI agent 失败分类法，将错误映射到 perception-reasoning-action 管线中的四类：认知失败、视觉状态误解、隐藏操作盲区、grounding error。核心做法是系统比较加入视觉记忆前后的行为变化，分析视觉记忆在不同失败类型上的作用与副作用。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示其通过系统实验研究 prepending visual memory 的效果，但给出的文本被截断，无法确认具体 benchmark、模型、任务规模和数值提升。可以确定的是，这篇更像诊断性分析，而不是 clean 的方法增益论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者中有 Jinwoo Shin。若为其常见团队线索，这类工作通常偏可靠的分析与系统视角，但仅凭摘要无法确认具体机构。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies what visual memory in GUI agents actually fixes and what new failure modes it introduces, instead of assuming more memory is always better.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a failure-mode analysis rather than a new agent architecture. It is useful for researchers working on general agents, tool use, and long-horizon interaction, but only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a taxonomy of GUI-agent failures mapped to the perception-reasoning-action pipeline: cognitive failure, visual state misunderstanding, hidden operation blindness, and grounding error. The main method is a systematic comparison of agent behavior with and without visual memory to isolate where memory helps or hurts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates controlled experiments on the effect of prepending visual memory, but the provided text is truncated, so the exact benchmarks, models, and quantitative gains are unclear. What is clear is that this is primarily a diagnostic study rather than a clean method paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Jinwoo Shin is among the authors. If this is from his usual line of work, the paper likely has a solid analysis/system flavor, though the exact institution cannot be confirmed from the provided metadata alone.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 agent memory，这篇可看失败分类和负面案例；对 pretrain 本身帮助不大，读 taxonomy 和案例分析就够了。
recommendation.en: If you work on agent memory, read the failure taxonomy and negative cases; for pretraining, the direct payoff is small, so the analysis sections are enough.

paper.title: Mind the Gap: Can Frontier LLMs Pass a Standardized Office Proficiency Exam?
paper.abstract: The deployment of Large Language Model (LLM) agents for computer automation is accelerating, yet their ability to navigate complex, professional-grade productivity software is largely untested. We argue that Office automation is an ideal environment for benchmarking document-automation capability, as it requires long-horizon planning and reasoning, precise parameter configuration, and multi-application integration. To quantify this capability, we introduce an evaluation based on China's National

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的核心问题不是 Office 自动化方法本身，而是评测缺口：现有 agent benchmark 很少真正覆盖知识工作里最常见、也最容易暴露长程执行缺陷的办公软件环境。作者要回答的是，frontier LLM 和 coding agent 在真实、标准化、可机器评分的 Office 任务上到底能做到什么程度，以及它们失败主要卡在执行层、规划层，还是 Office 语义层。为此，论文把中国 NCRE 的 Word/Excel/PowerPoint 实操考试转成一个可复现实验基准 OfficeEval，用统一 rubric 去测单轮代码生成和自主 coding-agent 两种范式。
summary.importance: 从基座模型研究视角，这篇论文的价值主要在评测资产和误差分解，而不在提出新的训练方法。它的重要性有三点。第一，Office 环境比网页导航或代码补全更接近日常知识工作，任务天然是长链条、多步骤、跨应用、强约束的，这类环境能更早暴露模型在工具使用、状态跟踪、参数精确配置上的短板。第二，基准来自成熟的人类标准化考试，评分规则细到 7,118 个 machine-gradable criteria，避免了很多 agent benchmark 里常见的主观 judge 噪声。第三，论文给出的诊断很有信息量：强 agent 的代码执行成功率已经接近 98–99%，但操作语义正确率仍然低，说明当前瓶颈不再只是“代码能不能跑”，而是“是否真正理解 Office 对象模型、格式语义和任务约束”。这对 post-train、tool-use 数据合成、环境交互预训练都有直接启发。若从严格的预训练研究相关性看，它更偏 eval，但属于高质量、可迁移的 agent capability benchmark。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，论文的主要贡献是 benchmark construction 和 evaluation protocol，而不是新模型。OfficeEval 从 NCRE 一级、二级 MS Office 模块中抽取 200 道实操题，覆盖 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 三类应用，并保留原始评分 rubric 的点数分配。每道题都不是简单问答，而是要求模型对真实文档执行一串互相依赖的操作，例如格式设置、公式与函数、图表与透视表、邮件合并、动画与版式调整等。最终总共拆成 7,118 个可机器判分的 criteria，用 Score Rate 作为统一指标，即模型拿到的 rubric 分数占比。

评测设置分两类。第一类是 single-turn code generation：给模型任务说明和相关文件，让它一次性输出完成任务的代码。第二类是 autonomous coding agent：允许模型在更接近真实 agent 的循环中规划、编写、执行、修正代码。这个区分很关键，因为它把“模型能力”与“agent scaffold 带来的执行恢复能力”分开了。论文还做了中英文指令版本对照，用来检查语言是否是主要瓶颈；由于任务原始语言是中文，而参测模型大多具备多语能力，这个设计能帮助判断失败是否来自语言理解，还是来自 Office 操作语义本身。

另一个方法亮点是 error taxonomy。作者没有停留在总分，而是把错误拆成 execution crash 与 logic/operation errors。前者指代码无法运行、环境调用失败、脚本崩溃等；后者指代码能运行，但生成的文档、表格、幻灯片不符合 rubric 要求。这个拆分很重要，因为很多 agent 论文把“能跑通”当作很大进展，但在 Office 这种高约束环境里，真正难的是细粒度语义正确性。论文因此把 benchmark 从单纯排行榜，提升成了诊断工具。
summary.experiments:
核心结果很明确。单轮代码生成范式下，没有任何模型达到 practical subset 的 60 分参考线；最好的 Claude Opus 4.7 只有 36.6% SR。进入 autonomous coding-agent 范式后，成绩明显上升，Claude Code 达到 53.0%，Codex 达到 68.8%，后者超过了 60 分参考线，但仍显著低于 95.5% 的 community-reference score。模型间差异也很大，最低如 Grok-4.1-fast 只有 2.8% SR，说明“frontier API”标签并不自动转化为 Office 自动化能力。

更有价值的是误差分解。论文发现，在较强的 coding-agent 设置下，代码执行成功率可以从不足 50% 提升到 98–99%，但操作正确率仍然偏低。这意味着 agent scaffold、工具调用和自我修复已经能解决大量“脚本跑不起来”的问题，但离“按要求把文档改对”还有明显距离。换句话说，当前瓶颈从 execution robustness 转向 domain-semantic accuracy。

论文还利用 NCRE 的一级/二级结构分析难度梯度，通常可以看到 Level 2 任务显著更难，因为它包含更复杂的 Excel 操作、跨对象格式控制和 PowerPoint 动画等。中英文版本对照实验则用于检验语言因素；从论文主叙事看，语言不是主要矛盾，真正困难在于 Office-specific semantics 和长程多步依赖。若阅读全文，建议特别留意各应用维度的拆分结果，因为 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 往往对应不同类型的失败模式：Excel 更偏公式与结构逻辑，Word 更偏格式与版式细节，PowerPoint 更偏对象层级与视觉布局约束。
summary.reading_guide:
先看 benchmark 构建部分，尤其是任务来源、rubric 提取、machine grading 设计。这里决定了这个基准是否只是“把考试题搬上来”，还是一个真正可复现、可比较、可诊断的评测资产。重点确认三件事：评分是否客观、任务是否覆盖真实 Office 工作流、参考阈值 60 分与 95.5% community reference 分别代表什么。

第二个重点是主结果表。阅读时不要只盯总分，要同时看 single-turn 与 agent 两种范式的差距，以及不同模型之间的离散程度。这个差距本身就是结论：agent scaffold 能显著改善执行，但不能自动补上 Office 语义理解。

第三个重点是 error taxonomy 和应用维度拆分。若只看总 SR，很难知道模型到底是死在环境调用、代码生成，还是细节操作。论文最有启发的部分恰恰是把“能运行”和“做正确”分开。若你关心 post-train 数据构造、tool-use 训练或环境交互式评测，这部分最值得细读。

如果时间有限，建议阅读顺序是：1）Introduction；2）OfficeEval 构建与评分协议；3）主结果表；4）错误分析；5）语言对照实验。预计 30–45 分钟可以抓住主要信息。若要深挖，可继续看附录中的任务示例和评分细则，这些内容对设计 agent 训练数据很有参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an evaluation gap rather than a new Office automation method. The central question is whether frontier LLMs and coding agents can actually operate professional productivity software at a level comparable to standardized human certification, and if not, where they fail: execution, planning, or Office-specific semantics. To answer this, the authors convert the practical component of China's National Computer Rank Examination (NCRE) into OfficeEval, a benchmark built from real Word, Excel, and PowerPoint tasks with machine-checkable scoring rubrics.
summary_en.importance: Its value is primarily as an evaluation asset and a diagnostic study. For foundation-model researchers, the benchmark matters because Office automation is a strong stress test for long-horizon tool use: it requires precise parameter settings, stateful multi-step execution, and cross-application workflows. Unlike many existing agent benchmarks, the tasks are not synthetic and the scoring is not based on subjective LLM judges. The benchmark inherits 7,118 machine-gradable criteria from a mature human exam system, which makes the signal much cleaner. The most useful finding is the gap between execution success and semantic correctness. Strong coding agents can get code to run at 98-99% success rates, yet still score poorly on the actual task rubric. That suggests the bottleneck is shifting from raw code generation or tool invocation toward domain-specific semantic understanding of Office object models, formatting rules, and task constraints. This is more of an eval paper than a pretraining paper, but it is highly relevant to post-training, tool-use data synthesis, and environment-grounded capability assessment.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main contribution is benchmark construction and evaluation protocol. OfficeEval is derived from the Level 1 and Level 2 MS Office practical exams in the NCRE. The benchmark contains 200 tasks spanning Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, and preserves the original rubric structure and point allocations. These are not short QA items. Each task requires a sequence of interdependent operations on real documents, spreadsheets, or presentations, such as formatting, formulas, pivot tables, chart customization, mail merge, animation settings, and layout edits. The full benchmark is decomposed into 7,118 machine-gradable criteria, and performance is reported as Score Rate (SR), the percentage of rubric points earned.

The evaluation compares two paradigms. The first is single-turn code generation, where the model receives the task and relevant files and outputs code in one shot. The second is an autonomous coding-agent setup, where the model can iteratively plan, write code, execute it, inspect outcomes, and revise. This distinction is important because it separates raw model competence from the recovery and iteration benefits provided by an agent scaffold.

Another strong design choice is the bilingual setup. Since the original tasks are in Chinese, the authors also construct English-translated versions of all tasks, documents, and scoring criteria. This allows them to test whether language understanding is the main bottleneck or whether the harder issue is Office-specific semantic execution.

The paper's most informative methodological addition is its error taxonomy. Instead of reporting only aggregate scores, it distinguishes execution crashes from logic or operation errors. Execution failures include code crashes and environment-level failures. Logic errors correspond to cases where code runs but the resulting Office artifact does not satisfy the rubric. This turns the benchmark into a diagnostic instrument rather than just a leaderboard.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline results are straightforward. Under the single-turn code generation setting, no model reaches the 60-point reference threshold for the practical subset. The best model, Claude Opus 4.7, achieves only 36.6% SR. Under the autonomous coding-agent setting, performance improves substantially: Claude Code reaches 53.0% and Codex reaches 68.8%. Even then, models remain well below the 95.5% community-reference score used as a sanity-check upper baseline. Performance is also highly polarized across models, with some systems such as Grok-4.1-fast dropping to 2.8% SR, showing that frontier branding does not translate directly into Office competence.

The error breakdown is the most useful part of the study. In stronger coding-agent settings, execution success rises from below 50% to around 98-99%, but operation accuracy remains low. In other words, agent scaffolding and iterative repair solve much of the 'can the script run?' problem, but not the 'did it perform the correct Office operation?' problem. That is a meaningful diagnosis for future training work.

The benchmark also supports difficulty analysis through the NCRE Level 1/Level 2 split. Level 2 tasks are naturally harder because they involve more advanced spreadsheet logic, richer formatting constraints, and more complex PowerPoint operations. The Chinese-English comparison is used to test language sensitivity; the paper's overall conclusion is that language is not the dominant issue. The harder challenge is Office-specific semantics under long-horizon, multi-step execution. The per-application breakdown is also worth attention: Excel tends to stress formula and structural reasoning, Word stresses formatting and layout fidelity, and PowerPoint stresses object hierarchy and visual arrangement constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Begin with the benchmark construction section. The key question is whether OfficeEval is merely a repackaged exam or a rigorous, reproducible benchmark. Pay attention to task sourcing, rubric extraction, machine grading, and the meaning of the two reference points: the 60-point threshold and the 95.5% community-reference score.

Next, read the main results table with two comparisons in mind: single-turn generation versus autonomous agents, and variance across models. The gap between those two paradigms is itself a major result. It shows that agent scaffolding helps a lot with execution, but does not close the semantic gap.

Then focus on the error taxonomy and the per-application analysis. Aggregate SR alone hides the most important distinction in the paper: running code is not the same as performing the correct Office operation. If your interests include post-training, tool-use supervision, or environment-grounded evaluation, this is the section to read carefully.

If time is limited, a good reading order is: introduction, benchmark construction and scoring protocol, main results, error analysis, and the language comparison. That should take roughly 30-45 minutes. For deeper study, the appendix examples and rubric details are useful because they expose the granularity of the supervision signal and suggest concrete directions for synthetic training data or agent curriculum design.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务构成和错误分析；它不改预训练方法，但能校准“Agent 已能办公自动化”的过高预期。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and failure analysis; it will not change pretraining recipes, but it usefully calibrates claims about office-automation agents.

paper.title: Workflow-GYM: Towards Long-Horizon Evaluation of Computer-use Agentic tasks in Real-World Professional Fields
paper.abstract: Recent years have witnessed the rapid evolution of AI agents toward handling increasingly complex, real-world tasks. However, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate whether agents can operate graphical user interfaces to complete long-horizon, high-value professional workflows across diverse domains. Current GUI benchmarks still predominantly focus on general-purpose software, relatively simple applications, and short-horizon tasks, leaving it largely unknown whether modern agents can follow user i

summary.core_problem: Workflow-GYM 关注 GUI agent 的长程真实工作流评测：现有 GUI benchmark 多数偏短任务、通用软件和简单操作，难以判断 agent 是否能在专业软件中完成有经济价值的端到端任务。它把问题设定为：只给自然语言目标，不给中间提示，agent 需要在已配置好的专业软件环境中规划、操作、纠错，并产出可验证结果。
summary.importance: 这是一篇评测资产类工作，对预训练本身的直接影响有限，但对 agent post-training、工具使用数据合成和 multimodal action model 训练有参考价值。它把 GUI agent 的评测压力从“会不会点按钮”推到“能否完成一整段专业 workflow”。这类 benchmark 可以帮助定位模型缺失的是视觉理解、软件知识、长程规划、状态记忆，还是动作执行稳定性。对基座研究的启发在于：仅靠网页和通用桌面任务训练出来的 computer-use 能力，可能无法迁移到专业软件流程；后续如果做 agentic pretrain 或 action data mixture，需要覆盖更长、更结构化的软件操作轨迹。
summary.technical_approach: 核心贡献是 Workflow-GYM benchmark。每个任务都在一个完整配置的环境中执行，所需专业软件已安装，agent 只接收自然语言任务目标。评测不依赖人工主观打分，而是检查最终状态或最终产物；每个任务都有唯一且自动可验证的成功条件。这一点很关键，因为长程 GUI 任务如果依赖人工打分，会很难规模化，也很难区分局部进展和真正完成。数据构建流程包含专家设计、多阶段验证和环境内执行检查，目标是保证任务真实、长程、需要专业软件知识，同时又能自动判定。论文还把 workflow 定义为一类有结构的、目标导向的 GUI action 序列，而不是孤立点击任务。
summary.experiments: 实验评测了多个代表性 GUI agent 框架和基础模型。结果显示，当前系统在这类专业长程 workflow 上成功率很低，最强模型也只有约 30% success rate。错误分析给出几类高频失败：遗漏 workflow 阶段，早期错误在后续步骤中放大，执行过程中目标漂移，对专业软件功能和操作路径不了解，以及重复动作循环。论文还指出一个更底层的问题：多数 GUI agent 采用离散 observation-action 循环，而人类操作软件时是连续感知、连续调整的过程；这种交互范式差异会放大长程任务中的累积误差。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 benchmark 任务定义、自动验证标准、数据构建流程，以及 failure analysis。实验表格可以快速扫，核心数字是最强系统约 30% 成功率；更有信息量的是失败类型，因为它能指导后续训练数据和 agent 架构改进。若关注 pretrain/post-train 接口，可以重点看任务轨迹是否适合作为 imitation、SFT 或 RL 环境，以及自动 verifier 是否足够稳定，可否转化为训练反馈。

summary_en.core_problem: Workflow-GYM evaluates long-horizon GUI agents in professional software workflows. Existing GUI benchmarks mostly cover short tasks, general-purpose applications, and simple operations. This benchmark asks a harder question: given only a natural-language goal, can an agent operate domain-specific software in a configured environment, plan across many steps, recover from errors, and produce a verifiable final artifact?
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation benchmark, not a pretraining method. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes through agent post-training, computer-use data generation, and multimodal action modeling. It shifts evaluation from local GUI manipulation to end-to-end workflow completion. That distinction matters because failures can come from different sources: visual perception, software-specific knowledge, long-horizon planning, memory, action grounding, or error recovery. For pretraining and data-mixture design, the signal is clear: web browsing and generic desktop tasks are unlikely to cover the distribution of professional software workflows needed for robust computer-use agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main contribution is the Workflow-GYM benchmark. Each task is instantiated in a fully configured environment with the required professional software installed. The agent receives only a natural-language instruction, with no intermediate hints or step-level guidance. Evaluation is based on the final state or artifact, and every task has a unique automatically verifiable success criterion. This design avoids subjective human grading and makes it possible to distinguish real task completion from partial progress. The benchmark construction pipeline combines expert-driven task design, multi-stage validation, and environment-grounded execution checks. The paper frames a workflow as a structured, goal-directed sequence of GUI actions rather than a collection of isolated clicks.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate multiple GUI-agent frameworks and foundation models. The reported performance remains low: even the strongest system reaches only about a 30% success rate. The failure analysis is more informative than the aggregate score. Common errors include omitted workflow stages, propagation of early mistakes, objective drift, insufficient knowledge of specialized software, and repetitive action loops. The paper also points to a deeper interface issue: most current agents operate through a discrete observation-action loop, while human software use involves more continuous perception and adjustment. This mismatch becomes more damaging as task horizons grow.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim reading should take around 25 to 35 minutes. Focus on the task definition, automatic verification design, data construction pipeline, and failure analysis. The main experimental number is the roughly 30% success rate of the strongest evaluated system, but the failure taxonomy is more useful for research planning. For readers interested in the pretrain/post-train interface, the key question is whether these workflows can be converted into imitation data, SFT traces, or RL environments, and whether the automatic verifiers are reliable enough to serve as training feedback.

recommendation.zh: 填补了专业领域长周期GUI Agent评测的空白，30%的低成功率表明当前模型在复杂长序列决策上仍有巨大提升空间，值得关注其任务构造和评测指标。
recommendation.en: Fills the gap in evaluating GUI agents on long-horizon professional workflows; the low 30% success rate highlights significant room for improvement in complex long-sequence decision-making. Worth checking its task construction and metrics.

paper.title: DragOn: A Benchmark and Dataset for Drag-Based GUI Interactions
paper.abstract: GUI agents - vision-based models that control desktops, web browsers, and mobile devices through graphical user interfaces - promise to automate a wide range of digital tasks. While million-scale datasets have enabled substantial progress on click-grounding, drag grounding (e.g. drag-and-drop, swipe, highlight) data remains an order of magnitude smaller and current models fall short on complex drag-based interactions. We introduce DragOn, a drag grounding benchmark and training dataset covering

summary.core_problem: GUI Agent 的视觉定位能力研究集中在点击场景（click grounding），数据规模已达千万级；而拖拽类交互（drag-and-drop、滑动、文本高亮、单元格选择等）的可用训练数据比点击小一个数量级且以文本高亮任务为主，导致当前 VLM 在拖拽类 GUI 交互上性能大幅落后。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于其数据合成方法论——利用渲染器自身几何信息作为标注源（rendering-as-supervision），以远低于 VLM/OCR 标注的成本获得像素精度的标注。该原则具有一定通用性，可能迁移到其他需要精确空间标注的 VLM 训练数据生成场景。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法论是 rendering-as-supervision：不直接对截图标注，而是从渲染器（PDF、XLSX、PPTX、HTML）的原生几何信息中读取真值源/目标边界框。实现了两种标签提取方式：解析式直接从源文件坐标系映射到像素空间（如 PDF 文本 span 坐标、PPTX EMU 单位）；探针式对扰动源（如单元格填充特殊颜色）做一次渲染来视觉定位目标，再渲染原始源获得最终截图。覆盖四个拖拽领域：文本高亮、单元格选择、元素缩放、滑块操纵。共 286K 训练截图、3.5M 训练任务、2000 测试样例，比之前 drag 语料大 1-2 个数量级。
summary.experiments: 评测了 GPT、Claude、Gemini 等闭源模型和 Qwen、Kimi、Holo 等开源模型，所有前沿模型在 drag grounding 上得分均低于 30%，表明拖拽视觉定位对当前 VLM 仍是难题。在 DragOn 训练数据上 fine-tune 的 Qwen3.5VL 超过所有前沿模型，证明数据量增加可有效提升 VLM 拖拽交互能力。
summary.reading_guide: 重点精读第 3 节 Rendering-as-Supervision 的方法论框架，这是论文最有迁移价值的部分；第 4 节四个领域的具体实现可快速浏览；评测结果在第 5 节。预计阅读时间 20-30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Research on visual grounding for GUI agents has focused on click grounding with datasets reaching tens of millions of examples. Drag-based interactions (drag-and-drop, swipe, text highlighting, cell selection) have training data an order of magnitude smaller and are dominated by text highlighting tasks, leaving current VLMs with poor performance on drag-based GUI interactions.
summary_en.importance: The key insight for pretraining research is the data synthesis methodology—using the renderer's own geometry as the labeling function (rendering-as-supervision) to produce pixel-accurate annotations at a fraction of the cost of VLM/OCR-based annotation. This principle is generalizable and could be extended to other VLM training data generation scenarios requiring precise spatial annotations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core methodology is rendering-as-supervision: instead of annotating screenshots directly, ground-truth source and target bounding boxes are read from the renderer's (PDF, XLSX, PPTX, HTML) native geometry. Two label extraction approaches are used: analytic, which maps source file coordinates directly to pixel space (e.g., PDF text span coordinates, PPTX EMU units); and probe-based, which renders a perturbed source (e.g., cells flooded with a distinctive color) to visually localize targets, then re-renders the original source for the final screenshot. Covers four domains: text highlighting, cell selection, element resizing, and slider manipulation. Totals 286K training screenshots, 3.5M training tasks, and 2,000 evaluation examples—1-2 orders of magnitude larger than prior drag corpora.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation of proprietary (GPT, Claude, Gemini) and open-weight (Qwen, Kimi, Holo) models shows all frontier models score below 30% on drag grounding, confirming it remains challenging. A Qwen3.5VL fine-tuned on DragOn training data outperforms all frontier models, demonstrating that additional training data directly improves VLM drag interaction capabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (Rendering-as-Supervision) for the methodological framework with the most transfer value. Section 4 on domain-specific implementations can be skimmed. Evaluation results are in Section 5. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: GUI Agent领域的重要评测资产，仅看基准构造和基线结果部分即可，对预训练无直接启发。
recommendation.en: Important evaluation asset in the GUI agent domain, only the benchmark construction and baseline results sections are worth reading, with no direct inspiration for pretraining.

paper.title: DeskCraft: Benchmarking Desktop Agents on Professional Workflows and Human-in-the-Loop Collaboration
paper.abstract: Real-world professional desktop workflows in specialized creative and engineering software unfold over long horizons and often require human-in-the-loop coordination, where agents proactively seek necessary information and users provide additional instructions, clarifications, feedback, or corrections as the task progresses. Yet existing desktop GUI benchmarks mostly reduce this setting to short, simplified tasks with all user instructions provided upfront. To address this issue, we introduce De

summary.core_problem: 现有的桌面 GUI Agent 评测基准主要集中在短序列、单次指令的简单任务上，无法反映真实专业工作流中长周期、多步骤以及需要人机交互（Human-in-the-Loop）的复杂场景。
summary.importance: 提出了一个更贴近真实专业场景的桌面 Agent 评测基准，指出了当前模型在长周期任务规划和主动人机协作方面的严重不足，为后续 Agent 预训练和对齐指明了方向。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了 DeskCraft 基准，包含 538 个任务，覆盖图像/矢量设计、视频/音频编辑和 3D 渲染等专业软件。核心设计包括：1) L1/L2/L3 难度分级，L3 任务源自真实交付流程，步骤超 50 步；2) 引入人机交互协议，包含执行中（Agent 主动澄清、用户中断）和执行后（用户追加指令）的触发机制，模拟真实协作。
summary.experiments: 评测了 18 个闭源/开源模型。在标准任务上，最强模型仅达到 33.8% 成功率。在交互式任务（100步限制）中，GPT-5.4 和 Kimi-K2.6 分别仅获 27.6% 和 25.7%。分析表明，模型在 L3 任务上性能断崖式下跌，增加步数限制收益微小，且 Agent 极少主动寻求澄清。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读第 3 节关于 L1/L2/L3 难度分级和人机交互协议的设计，以及第 4 节的实验分析，特别是关于长周期任务失败原因和主动澄清能力缺失的讨论。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing desktop GUI agent benchmarks focus on short, single-instruction tasks, failing to capture the long-horizon, multi-step, and human-in-the-loop nature of real-world professional workflows.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a benchmark closer to real professional scenarios, highlighting severe deficiencies of current models in long-horizon planning and proactive human-agent collaboration, guiding future agent pre-training and alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructed DeskCraft, a benchmark with 538 tasks covering professional software like image/vector design, video/audio editing, and 3D rendering. Key designs: 1) L1/L2/L3 difficulty taxonomy, with L3 tasks derived from real delivery processes (>50 steps); 2) Human-agent interaction protocol with mid-turn (agent clarification, user interruption) and post-turn (user follow-up) triggers to simulate real collaboration.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated 18 models. On standard tasks, the best model achieved only 33.8% success. On interactive tasks (100-step limit), GPT-5.4 and Kimi-K2.6 scored 27.6% and 25.7%, respectively. Analysis shows a sharp performance drop on L3 tasks, marginal gains from increased step limits, and a rare occurrence of proactive clarification by agents.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the L1/L2/L3 taxonomy and interaction protocol design, and Section 4 for experimental analysis, especially discussions on failure modes in long-horizon tasks and the lack of proactive clarification. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 高质量的 GUI Agent 评测基准，重点关注了长视距（>50步）和 Human-in-the-Loop 交互，对研究 Agent 评测和复杂任务规划有参考价值。
recommendation.en: A high-quality GUI Agent benchmark focusing on long-horizon (>50 steps) tasks and Human-in-the-Loop interaction. Valuable reference for agent evaluation and complex task planning research.

paper.title: STaR-KV: Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Re-weighting for KV Cache Compression in GUI Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language-model-based graphical user interface (GUI) agents have shown broad automation capabilities, yet deployment is bottlenecked by a key-value (KV) cache that grows linearly with interaction steps. For instance, UI-TARS-1.5-7B consumes 76 GB of GPU memory on merely five screenshots, approaching the capacity of mainstream 80 GB accelerators. Existing KV compression methods share two structural assumptions: aggregating visual-token importance into a single shared saliency map, and apply

summary.core_problem: 基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的 GUI 智能体在处理多帧高分辨率截图时，KV Cache 会随交互步数线性增长，导致显存耗尽（如 UI-TARS-1.5-7B 处理 5 张截图即消耗 76GB 显存）。现有的 KV Cache 压缩方法假设所有注意力头共享单一显著性图，且采用固定的 Top-B 截断策略，这在 GUI 场景下会导致空间布局信息丢失和分布漂移问题。
summary.importance: 揭示了 GUI 场景下注意力机制的两个核心特性：子空间级别的空间特化（Spatial Specialization）和随时间步漂移的注意力熵（Entropy Drift）。提出了一种无需训练、即插即用的 KV Cache 压缩方案，为长上下文 GUI 智能体的部署提供了实用的显存优化手段。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 STaR-KV 框架，包含三个核心机制：1) 在线空间分析（Online Spatial Profiling）：计算注意力子空间与 2D 屏幕坐标的互信息，保留对布局敏感的子空间信息；2) 累积时间稳定性衰减（Cumulative Temporal Stability Discount）：根据子空间在多帧间的稳定性，对历史视觉 Token 进行加权，抑制静态 UI 元素的冗余缓存，保留动态组件的 Token；3) 自适应熵锐化（Adaptive Entropy-Based Sharpening）：根据注意力分布的归一化熵动态调整温度参数，替代固定的 Top-B 截断，在平缓分布下避免任意截断，在尖峰分布下增强选择性。
summary.experiments: 在多个 GUI 智能体基准测试上，STaR-KV 无需微调即可应用于 UI-TARS 和 OpenCUA 等模型。在相同的显存预算下，其平均性能优于现有的 SOTA KV 压缩方法（如 GUIKV、SnapKV）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中的 Pilot 1 和 Pilot 2，这两个实验清晰地揭示了现有方法的盲区。Method 部分详细阐述了三个核心机制的实现细节，特别是互信息的计算和自适应熵锐化的设计。

summary_en.core_problem: GUI agents based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) face severe memory bottlenecks due to the linear growth of KV cache with interaction steps when processing multiple high-resolution screenshots (e.g., UI-TARS-1.5-7B consumes 76GB for just 5 screenshots). Existing KV cache compression methods assume a shared saliency map across all attention heads and apply a fixed Top-B cutoff, which leads to the loss of spatial layout information and distribution drift issues in GUI scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Reveals two core characteristics of attention mechanisms in GUI scenarios: subspace-level spatial specialization and entropy drift over time steps. Proposes a training-free, plug-and-play KV cache compression scheme, providing a practical memory optimization solution for deploying long-context GUI agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the STaR-KV framework, featuring three core mechanisms: 1) Online Spatial Profiling: Calculates the mutual information between attention subspaces and 2D screen coordinates to preserve layout-sensitive subspace information; 2) Cumulative Temporal Stability Discount: Weights historical visual tokens based on the stability of their governing subspaces across frames, suppressing redundant cache entries from static UI elements while preserving tokens of dynamic components; 3) Adaptive Entropy-Based Sharpening (AEB): Dynamically adjusts the temperature parameter based on the normalized entropy of the attention distribution, replacing the fixed Top-B cutoff to avoid arbitrary truncation in flat distributions and enhance selectivity in peaky ones.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple GUI agent benchmarks, STaR-KV can be directly applied to models like UI-TARS and OpenCUA without fine-tuning. Under matched memory budgets, it achieves stronger average performance than SOTA KV compression methods (e.g., GUIKV, SnapKV).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Pilot 1 and Pilot 2 in the Introduction, which clearly reveal the blind spots of existing methods. The Method section details the implementation of the three core mechanisms, especially the calculation of mutual information and the design of adaptive entropy sharpening.

recommendation.zh: 只看 pilot measurements 和压缩策略即可；它对“统一视觉 saliency + 固定 top-B”的反例比较有用。
recommendation.en: Read the pilot measurements and compression policy; the useful part is the counterexample to global visual saliency plus fixed top-B pruning.

paper.title: Multi-Agent Computer Use

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 computer use agent 的执行形态问题：单个串行 CUA 在长程 GUI / Web 任务中容易卡住、回溯成本高、不能并行探索。作者提出用 manager 维护任务 DAG，并调度多个相同 CUA 子代理并行执行。
summary.importance: 它和基座预训练的关系不是直接的训练 recipe，而是 test-time compute 和 agentic scaling 的系统研究。论文给出的启发是：在 GUI 这类部分可观测环境里，提高能力不只靠更强单模型，也可以靠任务分解、并行执行、持续重规划。对训练侧的间接价值在于，它指出了未来 CUA 数据和奖励信号可能需要覆盖 planner、subtask boundary、依赖关系、状态摘要和失败恢复，而不是只记录单条操作轨迹。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 Multi-Agent Computer Use。系统包含一个 manager 和多个 CUA subagents。manager 接收用户任务后，把任务拆成有向无环图，节点是子任务，边表示依赖关系。调度器每轮选择 ready frontier 上的节点，把它们并行分配给多个运行在独立 VM 或浏览器环境中的 CUA。子代理完成后返回观察、产物和状态摘要；manager 根据新信息继续、修改、取消或重连待执行节点。这个设计把部分可观测性作为核心问题处理：初始计划只是可修正假设，后续需要根据子代理在真实系统中发现的信息不断更新。和一些多代理系统不同，这里不依赖专门训练的异构专家，子代理可以是同一个 CUA backbone，主要复杂度放在图式规划和调度上。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 MACU 在多个 computer use 和 web navigation benchmark 上稳定优于强单代理基线：OSWorld 成功率提升 4.7 个百分点，Online-Mind2Web 提升 3.4 个百分点，WebTailBench-v2 提升 8.7 个百分点，Odysseys 提升 25.5 个百分点。OSWorld 和 Odysseys 上还观察到明显的 wall-clock time 改善。长程任务上，随着 test-time compute 增加，多代理系统的 scaling trend 比单代理更好；单代理容易在某个路径上卡住，多代理可以并行推进独立子任务或探索替代路径。论文还做了 MACU 设计消融，强调持续重规划、DAG 依赖建模和并行调度是主要收益来源。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看系统图和方法部分，理解 manager-DAG-subagent 的控制循环；再看实验主表，重点关注 OSWorld、Online-Mind2Web、WebTailBench-v2、Odysseys 上的绝对提升和 wall-clock 变化；最后看 ablation，判断收益来自并行数量、重规划、图依赖建模还是简单多次采样。对基座研究者，不必细抠每个 GUI benchmark 的任务细节，重点看它如何把 test-time compute 从“更长单轨迹”变成“可重规划的并行任务图”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the execution pattern of computer-use agents. Current CUAs are mostly single serial actors, which is a poor fit for long-horizon GUI and web tasks that require decomposition, parallel work, backtracking, and replanning under partial observability.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly about agentic test-time scaling rather than pretraining itself. Its relevance to foundation-model research is that capability can be improved by orchestration: decomposing work into a graph, running multiple identical agents in parallel, and updating the plan as new state is discovered. For training, it suggests that future CUA datasets and reward signals may need to represent planning structure, subtask dependencies, state summaries, and recovery behavior, not only flat action traces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed setup, Multi-Agent Computer Use, uses a manager model and a pool of CUA subagents. The manager turns a user task into a directed acyclic graph of subtasks, where nodes are executable pieces of work and edges encode dependencies. At each iteration, ready nodes are dispatched to subagents running in parallel on separate virtual machines or browser sessions. Completed subagents return observations, outputs, and summaries; the manager can then continue, add, cancel, modify, or rewire pending subtasks. A key design choice is to treat partial observability as a central constraint. The initial plan is only a hypothesis, because the relevant filesystem, browser state, login state, or dynamic page content may become visible only after execution. Unlike many multi-agent systems with specialized roles, the subagents here can be identical instances of the same CUA backbone; the main novelty is the planning and scheduling loop around them.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports consistent gains over strong single-agent baselines. MACU improves success rates by 4.7 percentage points on OSWorld, 3.4 on Online-Mind2Web, 8.7 on WebTailBench-v2, and 25.5 on Odysseys. It also reduces wall-clock time on OSWorld and Odysseys. The gains are largest on longer-horizon tasks, where single agents tend to get stuck on one trajectory while the multi-agent setup can execute independent subtasks or alternative paths in parallel. Ablations indicate that continuous replanning, DAG dependency tracking, and parallel dispatch are important design choices.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most foundation-model researchers. Start with the system diagram and the method description to understand the manager-DAG-subagent loop. Then read the main benchmark table and the wall-clock results. The ablations are the most useful part if the goal is to understand whether the improvement comes from parallelism, replanning, graph structure, or extra sampling. The practical lesson is that test-time compute for agents need not mean a single longer trajectory; it can be organized as a dynamically revised parallel task graph.

recommendation.zh: CMU知名团队的多Agent电脑操作研究，关注Agent协作机制设计，值得读方法架构部分，无摘要需直接看论文。
recommendation.en: CMU reputable team's multi-agent computer use study; focus on agent collaboration design, worth reading the method architecture section directly since no abstract is available.

paper.title: GUI-C$^2$: Coarse-to-Fine GUI Grounding via Difficulty-Aware Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Existing agentic reinforcement learning methods for GUI grounding have limitations at two levels. At the data level, current approaches typically treat all training samples equally, although their training value to the baseline model varies with difficulty. Overlooking this can greatly reduce training efficiency or even cause collapse. At the strategy level, existing frameworks struggle to balance the trade-off between cropping larger regions for sufficient context and smaller ones for reduced r

summary.core_problem: 提升 GUI grounding agent 在屏幕元素定位中的训练效率和 coarse-to-fine 区域选择能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是 GUI agent 训练方法：用样本难度挖掘和加权 RL 处理训练样本价值不均的问题，并设计粗到细的区域定位策略。它属于通用 GUI agent 的一个子问题，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GUI-D 数据挖掘和难度评分流程，通过测试基线模型识别值得训练的样本并分配 difficulty score；提出 GUI-C2，让 agent 先选择较大上下文区域，再逐步缩小到目标区域，以平衡上下文充分性和冗余。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集名称、baseline 和提升幅度。可确认实验关注小参数模型在 GUI grounding 中的训练稳定性、推理时间和定位表现。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The Hong Kong Polytechnic University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper improves GUI grounding agents by addressing sample difficulty and coarse-to-fine region selection.
