summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training and policy design for GUI agents: difficulty-aware sample mining and weighted reinforcement learning, plus a coarse-to-fine grounding strategy. It is relevant to GUI agents but only indirectly connected to foundation pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: GUI-D scores and mines training-worthy examples by probing a baseline model and assigning difficulty weights. GUI-C2 then uses an area-guided coarse-to-fine strategy, first retaining sufficient context and then narrowing the crop to reduce redundancy.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, dataset names, baselines, or exact gains. The visible evaluation focuses on GUI grounding stability, inference cost, and localization quality, especially for small models.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

recommendation.zh: 可作 GUI agent 训练材料备查；重点看 difficulty scoring，RL 框架本身不像通用后训练信号。
recommendation.en: Keep it as GUI-agent training reference; read the difficulty scoring idea, while the RL setup itself does not look like a general post-training signal.

paper.title: PhoneWorld: Scaling Phone-Use Agent Environments
paper.abstract: A central bottleneck for phone-use agents is that controllable, reproducible environments covering real mobile behavior are hard to build at scale. Existing mobile-agent benchmarks have made important progress on evaluation, but they do not by themselves provide a scalable way to construct many new phone-use environments. We present PhoneWorld, a reusable pipeline that converts real GUI trajectories and screenshots into controllable phone-use environments, executable tasks, automatic verifiers,

summary.core_problem: 手机操作Agent的核心瓶颈是难以大规模构建可控、可复现且覆盖真实移动行为的环境；现有移动Agent benchmark主要关注评测而非环境构建的可扩展性。
summary.importance: 系统创新贡献：提出PhoneWorld，一个将真实GUI轨迹和截图转化为可执行mock Android应用环境、任务、自动验证器和训练rollouts的可复用pipeline，解决了逐一手工构建环境的瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 从真实GUI轨迹中恢复有效屏幕、屏幕连接关系、状态变化交互和可自动验证的目标，构建由只读内容和可变状态支撑的mock Android应用，并从同一环境派生出可执行任务、基于规则的验证器和训练rollouts。
summary.experiments: 将真实GUI轨迹转化为可运行的mock应用和任务；通过真实轨迹数据恢复的屏幕、连接关系和状态变化构建环境；核心贡献是pipeline本身而非评测指标。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队包含来自多个机构的研究者，其中Jason可能为独立贡献者，其余作者背景不详。

summary_en.core_problem: A central bottleneck for phone-use agents is the difficulty of building controllable, reproducible environments covering real mobile behavior at scale; existing mobile agent benchmarks focus on evaluation rather than scalable environment construction.
summary_en.importance: System innovation: PhoneWorld provides a reusable pipeline that converts real GUI trajectories and screenshots into runnable mock Android environments, executable tasks, automatic verifiers, and training rollouts, obviating hand-building each benchmark individually.
summary_en.technical_approach: Recovers meaningful screens, screen connectivity, state-changing interactions, and automatically-verifiable goals from real GUI trajectories, then builds mock Android apps backed by read-only content and mutable state, from which tasks, rule-based verifiers, and training rollouts are derived.
summary_en.experiments: Demonstrates pipeline on real GUI trajectory data converting to runnable mock apps and tasks; the core contribution is the pipeline itself rather than benchmark metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: Author team includes researchers from multiple institutions; Jason listed as a potential independent contributor; remaining institutional affiliations not explicitly stated.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练研究员间接参考——从真实轨迹大规模合成可执行环境+验证器的思路对RL训练数据合成有启发，但读摘要即可，正文细节可略。
recommendation.en: Indirect reference for pretrain researchers — the idea of scaling executable environments + verifiers from real trajectories has loose parallels to RL training data synthesis, but the abstract suffices; skip details.

paper.title: Recovering Policy-Induced Errors: Benchmarking and Trajectory Synthesis for Robust GUI Agents
paper.abstract: While GUI agents have advanced rapidly, they often lack the robustness to recover from their own errors, hindering real-world deployment. To bridge this gap at both the evaluation and data levels, we introduce GUI-RobustEval and propose Robustness-driven Trajectory Synthesis. GUI-RobustEval contains $1,216$ executable test cases that systematically measure error recovery capabilities across a broad and realistic spectrum of error modes. At the data level, RoTS is a scalable synthesis framework t

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文聚焦 GUI agent 的一个很实际但常被弱化的问题：模型犯错之后，能不能识别自己已经进入错误状态，并通过后续操作把任务拉回来。作者把这类问题定义为 policy-induced errors，也就是错误不是外部噪声注入造成的，而是 agent 自己在执行中因为错误 grounding、误判界面状态、选错子目标等动作一步步走出来的。现有 benchmark 更关注 grounding、规划或最终成功率，训练数据也多是人类演示或短程反思样本，因此对真实部署里常见的“长程、自诱发、组合式错误”覆盖不足。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是直接的 pretrain 论文；但对 post-train、agent 数据构造和训练信号设计有明确启发。它把 agent robustness 从“加一个 reflection 模块”转成“训练数据和评测协议是否覆盖真实错误分布”的问题。这个视角很重要，因为很多 agent 失败并不是能力上限不够，而是训练时几乎没见过自己把环境带偏之后如何恢复。对做多模态 action model、GUI agent、在线数据合成的人，这篇工作提供了一个较完整的闭环：先定义错误类型和错误深度，再做针对性 benchmark，最后用在线树搜索式合成去补训练分布缺口。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上分成 benchmark 和数据合成两部分。

第一部分是 GUI-RobustEval。作者把 GUI agent 任务建模为 POMDP：任务指令和动作是语言空间，观测是 screenshot，状态和转移由 GUI 环境决定，策略由 VLM 实现。与普通成功率评测不同，这个 benchmark 不是从初始状态让 agent 从头做任务，而是先给定一段带错误的前缀轨迹，再把环境和 agent 重置到某个“错误深度”对应的状态，让模型从这个已经被带偏的中间状态接管任务。这里有两个关键定义：error type 是根因动作的类别；error horizon / error depth 则描述从根因动作发生到错误变得可识别，需要经过多少步。这个设计比简单注入随机噪声更贴近真实 agent failure，因为很多错误不是立刻显现，而是几步之后才暴露。

GUI-RobustEval 共包含 1216 个可执行测试用例，覆盖 11 类代表性错误和 4 个可控错误深度。指标也不是单一 success rate，而是拆成 Error-Awareness Rate 和 Post-Error Success Rate。前者测模型能否意识到当前状态已经不对，后者测它在意识到或未意识到的情况下，最终能否恢复并完成任务。这样的拆分很有意义，因为有些模型会“知道错了但不会救”，另一些则是“根本不知道已经走偏”。

第二部分是 RoTS，Robustness-driven Trajectory Synthesis。作者观察到现有训练数据有两个错配：error-coverage mismatch 和 error-horizon mismatch。前者指训练数据里的错误类型偏低级、偏人工常见，而真实 agent failure 更高层、更组合式；后者指训练样本多是短程错误，而真实恢复常常需要长程回溯。RoTS 用树状在线合成来同时补这两个缺口。

具体做法是：在 GUI 环境中迭代生长 trajectory tree。对成功分支，从脆弱状态继续分叉，主动探索新的失败模式，同时复用已有正确前缀，提升错误覆盖；对失败分支，则从错误状态回放并合成恢复 rollout，生成长程 failure-recovery 轨迹，提升恢复 horizon。这个设计比离线改写演示数据更自然，因为错误是由策略与环境交互真实诱发的，不是人工编造的局部反思句子。最终作者构建了 800k 规模的数据集，并在 Qwen2.5-VL 基座上训练 RoTS-7B 和 RoTS-32B。
summary.experiments:
实验部分最重要的是作者先做了分布分析，再做 benchmark 和训练验证。

分布分析上，作者从 12 个现有 SOTA GUI agent 在 OSWorld 上采集 1.5k 条轨迹，用 VLM 标注 error type，并在 300 条失败轨迹上由人工标注“最早何时能识别根因错误”，据此得到真实推理时的错误类型分布和错误 horizon 分布。然后把这些分布与三类代表性训练数据比较：AgentTrek、AgentNet、GUI-Reflection。结论是训练数据明显偏向低级执行错误和短程反思，而真实失败更常是高层、组合式、长程暴露的错误。这一步是整篇工作的支撑点，因为它说明 benchmark 和合成数据不是拍脑袋设计，而是针对真实分布缺口。

GUI-RobustEval 的规模是 1216 个测试用例，11 类错误，4 个错误深度。作者报告 Error-Awareness Rate 与 Post-Error Success Rate，并按错误类型和深度做细分。核心观察是：随着错误深度增加，恢复能力显著下降；很多模型在浅层错误上还能补救，但对延迟暴露的错误明显失效。

训练部分，RoTS 生成了 800k 高质量 failure-recovery 数据，并据此微调出 RoTS-7B 和 RoTS-32B。论文声称两者在 GUI-RobustEval 和传统 GUI benchmark 上都有显著提升，后者包括 OSWorld 和 WindowsAgentArena。摘要节选没有给出完整数值，但从正文结构看，重点应是三类对比：一是与原始 Qwen2.5-VL 基座相比的鲁棒性提升；二是与现有 reflection/trajectory 数据训练方案相比，在深错误和复杂错误类型上的增益；三是 robustness 提升是否会迁移到常规任务成功率，而不是只在专门 benchmark 上有效。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 里作者定义的两个错配：error-coverage mismatch 和 error-horizon mismatch。这两个概念把问题讲得很清楚，也是后面 benchmark 与数据合成设计的直接动机。

然后重点看 Benchmark for Policy-Induced Errors。需要弄清楚 error type、error depth、error horizon 的定义，以及为什么要从错误中间态接管任务，而不是从头执行。这里决定了这个 benchmark 是否真的在测 recovery，而不是普通执行能力。

接着看 RoTS 的树状合成流程图和算法描述。要特别注意成功分支与失败分支分别在补什么分布缺口，以及为什么这种在线环境交互式合成比离线反思数据更贴近真实错误恢复训练。

实验部分优先看三类结果：真实失败分布与训练数据分布的差异分析；GUI-RobustEval 上按错误深度/类型拆分的结果；以及在 OSWorld、WindowsAgentArena 上的迁移效果。如果时间有限，30 分钟左右可以抓住主要贡献；如果要复现或借鉴数据合成方法，建议再细看数据过滤、质量控制和回放机制。
summary.authors_note: 阿里云团队工作。论文正文明确写明所有作者均为 Alibaba Cloud Computing 员工，RoTS 与所评测的 Qwen-VL 系列模型也由阿里云开发。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical weakness of GUI agents: once the agent makes its own mistake, can it recognize that it is now in a bad state and recover? The authors focus on policy-induced errors, meaning failures caused by the agent’s own actions during execution, such as wrong grounding, misreading the screen, or pursuing an incorrect subgoal. Existing benchmarks mostly emphasize grounding, planning, or final task success, and training data is often built from human demonstrations or short reflection traces. As a result, current systems are underexposed to realistic long-horizon, self-induced, compositional failures.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to post-training, agent data construction, and training-signal design. The key contribution is to shift robustness from a systems add-on problem to a data-and-evaluation problem. Instead of only adding reflection or backtracking modules, the paper asks whether the benchmark and the training distribution actually cover the kinds of errors agents make in deployment. That is a useful framing for multimodal action models and GUI agents, because many failures come from distribution mismatch in recovery trajectories rather than from raw capability limits.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two main parts: a benchmark and a data synthesis pipeline.

The benchmark, GUI-RobustEval, models GUI interaction as a POMDP where instructions and actions are in language space, observations are screenshots, environment state and transitions come from the GUI, and the policy is a VLM. Unlike standard task-success evaluation, the benchmark does not always start from a clean initial state. Instead, each test case provides an erroneous prefix trajectory, then resets the environment and the agent to a targeted state at a chosen error depth, and asks the model to take over from there. Two definitions matter here. Error type is the category of the root-cause action. Error horizon or depth measures how many steps after the root cause are needed before the error becomes identifiable. This is more realistic than injecting random perturbations, because many GUI failures only become visible several steps later.

GUI-RobustEval contains 1,216 executable test cases spanning 11 representative error types and 4 controllable error depths. The evaluation uses two metrics: Error-Awareness Rate and Post-Error Success Rate. This split is important. Some agents can notice that something is wrong but still fail to recover; others do not even realize they are off track.

The second part is RoTS, Robustness-driven Trajectory Synthesis. The authors identify two mismatches in existing training data. Error-coverage mismatch means training sets overrepresent low-level or human-typical errors, while real agent failures are often higher-level and compositional. Error-horizon mismatch means training examples are usually short-horizon, while real recovery often requires long-horizon backtracking. RoTS addresses both with a tree-based online synthesis process.

The trajectory tree grows inside the GUI environment. On successful branches, the system branches out from fragile states to proactively discover new failure modes while reusing the correct prefix, improving error coverage. On failed branches, it replays from the error state and synthesizes recovery rollouts, producing long-horizon failure-recovery trajectories. This is more realistic than offline reflection rewriting because the failures are induced by actual policy-environment interaction rather than manually fabricated local corrections. The final dataset contains 800k samples, and the authors fine-tune Qwen2.5-VL into RoTS-7B and RoTS-32B.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story starts with distribution analysis, then moves to benchmarking and training.

For the analysis, the authors collect 1.5k trajectories from 12 strong GUI agents on OSWorld. They use a VLM to annotate error types and manually label, on 300 failed trajectories, the earliest step at which the root-cause error becomes identifiable. This gives empirical distributions over error types and error horizons in real inference failures. They then compare these distributions against three representative training datasets: AgentTrek, AgentNet, and GUI-Reflection. The main finding is that existing training data is skewed toward low-level execution mistakes and short-horizon reflection, while real failures are more often high-level, compositional, and delayed in their observability. This analysis is the backbone of the paper because it justifies both the benchmark design and the synthesis strategy.

GUI-RobustEval itself contains 1,216 test cases, 11 error types, and 4 error depths. Results are reported with Error-Awareness Rate and Post-Error Success Rate, broken down by error type and depth. The central pattern is that recovery degrades as error depth increases. Many agents can handle shallow mistakes but fail badly once the consequences of the root-cause action are delayed.

On the training side, RoTS produces 800k failure-recovery samples and is used to fine-tune RoTS-7B and RoTS-32B. The paper reports substantial gains on GUI-RobustEval and also improvements on standard GUI benchmarks such as OSWorld and WindowsAgentArena. The excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, so the most important things to inspect in the paper are: gains over the base Qwen2.5-VL models, gains over prior reflection-style training data, and whether robustness improvements transfer to ordinary task success rather than only to the dedicated recovery benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction, especially the two mismatches: error-coverage mismatch and error-horizon mismatch. These two ideas explain the whole paper.

Then read the benchmark section carefully. Make sure to understand the definitions of error type, error depth, and error horizon, and why the benchmark evaluates takeover from an erroneous intermediate state rather than full execution from scratch. That is what makes it a recovery benchmark instead of a generic GUI benchmark.

Next, focus on the RoTS pipeline figure and algorithm description. Pay attention to what the successful branches and failed branches contribute respectively, and why online environment-grounded synthesis is more faithful than offline reflection augmentation.

In the experiments, prioritize three parts: the mismatch analysis between real failures and training data, the breakdown on GUI-RobustEval by error type and depth, and the transfer results on OSWorld and WindowsAgentArena. Around 30 minutes is enough to capture the main contribution. If you want to reuse the synthesis idea, spend more time on data filtering, replay, and quality control details.
summary_en.authors_note: Alibaba Cloud Computing. The paper explicitly states that all authors are employees of Alibaba Cloud Computing, and that the evaluated Qwen-VL models and RoTS were developed there.

recommendation.zh: GUI Agent错误恢复的专门基准与数据合成方法，树状探索合成错误轨迹的思路可迁移到其他Agent训练数据生成，看§3数据合成部分即可。
recommendation.en: Specialized benchmark and data synthesis method for GUI agent error recovery; the tree-based exploration pipeline for error trajectory synthesis can be migrated to other agent training data generation; read §3 only.

paper.title: STAMP: Training Explicit Memory for Mobile GUI Agents in Controllable and Scalable Virtual Environments
paper.abstract: Mobile GUI agents excel at immediate reactive control but frequently fail in realistic, long-horizon tasks that require memory. This failure stems from a fundamental conflict between limited context windows and token-heavy screenshots. To save the limited context, agents must progressively discard older visual history, permanently losing crucial transient information. Furthermore, existing action-centric datasets fail to teach agents what or when to explicitly memorize, and augmenting static rea

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决移动 GUI agent 在长时程任务中因上下文窗口有限、截图 token 过重而遗忘关键历史信息的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 agent 训练范式与数据生成：不是基座预训练，但对“显式记忆是否应被监督训练出来”这个问题给了较干净的环境化方案。对做长上下文、外部记忆、agent training 的研究员有边际启发。
summary.technical_approach: STAMP 在可控虚拟环境中程序化注入 deterministic memory variables，精确控制什么信息必须记、何时编码、何时检索，从而自动生成可验证监督数据；同时支持在线强化学习训练，让 agent 学会显式 memory write/read，而不是完全依赖上下文堆叠。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明实验聚焦 mobile GUI 长时程任务，对比现有 reactive agents 和 action-centric 数据训练方案，验证显式记忆训练在长任务上的收益。未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模和提升幅度，因此当前更像一个训练框架提案，需看正文确认 setup 是否干净、是否超越简单 retrieval baselines。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the failure of mobile GUI agents on long-horizon tasks, where limited context windows and token-heavy screenshots cause the agent to forget crucial transient information.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-training and data-generation contribution rather than foundation-model pretraining. Its main value is a relatively clean setup for studying whether explicit memory should be trained under supervision, which may still be useful for researchers working on long-context, external memory, or agent training.
summary_en.technical_approach: STAMP builds controllable virtual environments with programmatically injected deterministic memory variables, so the training pipeline can specify what must be memorized, when it should be encoded, and when it must be retrieved. This yields verifiable supervised data at scale and also supports online RL for explicit memory write/read behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract suggests evaluations on long-horizon mobile GUI tasks against reactive agents and action-centric training data. It claims gains from explicit memory training, but provides no concrete benchmarks, model sizes, or margins, so the real value depends on whether the full paper cleanly rules out simpler retrieval or context-management baselines.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“可控环境里把记忆变量显式监督出来”这个 setup 还算干净；若你做 agent memory，只看数据生成和 RL 设计。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the controlled supervision of explicit memory variables is a fairly clean setup; if you work on agent memory, read only the data-generation and RL parts.

paper.title: Scaling, Benchmarking, and Reasoning of Vision-Language Agents for Mobile GUI Navigation
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown rapid progress in mobile GUI navigation. This paper presents a systematic study of data scaling, benchmarking, and reasoning for VLM-based agents in this domain. To facilitate rigorous evaluation, we introduce HyperTrack, a large-scale dataset with over 16000 real-world tasks across more than 650 Chinese mobile applications, along with GUIEvalKit, an open-source toolkit for unified benchmarking of VLMs on offline GUI navigation tasks. Using HyperTrack, we

summary.core_problem: 现有移动端GUI导航的视觉语言智能体缺乏大规模中文场景数据集、统一评测工具，且训练数据规模对监督微调、强化微调的影响，以及推理能力对任务表现的作用均缺乏系统性研究。
summary.importance: 提供了中文移动端GUI领域的大规模评测资产和数据缩放规律结论，对多模态智能体的后训练数据配比、训练范式选择有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 1）构建HyperTrack数据集，包含674款中文安卓应用的16080条真实任务轨迹，覆盖分层UI文档、动作 bounding box、屏幕描述等多维度标注，支持域内、未见应用、未见设备等多维度泛化评测；2）开发开源统一评测工具包GUIEvalKit；3）基于数据集系统性对比监督微调（SFT）和DAPO增强的GRPO强化微调范式的缩放规律，评测主流开源VLM的GUI导航表现。
summary.experiments: 强化微调在所有数据规模下均优于监督微调，尤其是域外泛化场景，体现了数据规模与RL的协同效应；交互历史完整性、模型推理能力对GUI任务成功率有显著正向影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读数据集统计与对比表格，数据缩放实验的SFT与RL性能对比曲线，预计阅读时间20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 武汉大学、小米，通讯作者高鹏志（小米）

summary_en.core_problem: Existing vision-language agents for mobile GUI navigation lack large-scale Chinese scenario datasets and unified evaluation tools. There is also no systematic research on the impact of training data scale on supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement fine-tuning, as well as the effect of reasoning ability on task performance.
summary_en.importance: It provides large-scale evaluation assets and data scaling law conclusions for the Chinese mobile GUI domain, and has reference value for post-training data ratio selection and training paradigm selection for multimodal agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Construct the HyperTrack dataset, which contains 16080 real task trajectories from 674 Chinese Android apps, covering multi-dimensional annotations such as hierarchical UI documents, action bounding boxes, and screen descriptions, supporting multi-dimensional generalization evaluation including in-domain, unseen app, and unseen device settings. 2) Develop the open-source unified evaluation toolkit GUIEvalKit. 3) Systematically compare the scaling laws of SFT and DAPO-augmented GRPO reinforcement fine-tuning paradigms based on the dataset, and evaluate the GUI navigation performance of mainstream open-source VLMs.
summary_en.experiments: Reinforcement fine-tuning outperforms supervised fine-tuning across all data scales, especially in out-of-domain generalization scenarios, demonstrating the synergy between data scale and RL. Completeness of interaction history and model reasoning ability have significant positive effects on GUI task success rate.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the dataset statistics and comparison tables, and the SFT vs RL performance scaling curves in data scaling experiments. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Wuhan University, Xiaomi; corresponding author: Pengzhi Gao (Xiaomi)

recommendation.zh: 提供了一个大规模的 GUI Agent 数据集和评测基准，其关于 RL 在 OOD 泛化上优于 SFT 的结论对 Agent 训练有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Provides a large-scale GUI agent dataset and benchmark; the conclusion that RL outperforms SFT in OOD generalization is valuable for agent training.

paper.title: MIRAGE: Context-Aware Prompt Injection against Mobile GUI Agents via User-Generated Content
paper.abstract: Mobile graphical user interface (GUI) agents driven by vision-language models (VLMs) perceive the screen as rendered pixels and choose actions from what they see, so they cannot reliably separate trusted interface elements from user-generated content. We present MIRAGE (Mobile Injection of Realistic Adversarial GUI Examples), a pipeline that turns benign mobile screenshots into prompt-injection samples by placing attacker-controlled text into ordinary user-generated content regions, without modi

summary.core_problem: 评测和构造针对移动端 GUI agent 的上下文感知 prompt injection：攻击文本伪装成正常用户生成内容，诱导 VLM agent 执行偏离用户意图的操作。
summary.importance: 这是一篇安全评测/攻击方法论文，价值在于指出 GUI agent 的感知边界问题：模型只看像素，难以区分可信 UI 与不可信用户内容。对做原生多模态 agent、界面 grounding 和安全训练的人有参考意义，但与基座预训练的距离较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MIRAGE 三阶段流程：Localizer 找到截图中用户可控区域；Generator 生成与当前界面语境匹配的攻击载荷，并以原生 app 风格渲染；Curator 控制样本真实性并平衡应用、区域类型和攻击意图分布。核心不是修改 agent，而是在真实截图上合成高逼真注入样本。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明实验关注攻击样本的视觉真实性与对 GUI agent 的干扰效果，评测对象应是移动端 VLM agent。未给出具体模型、应用数量、成功率和基线细节，因此更适合作为 threat model 和数据构造思路了解，而不是逐表深读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies context-aware prompt injection against mobile GUI agents, where attacker text is disguised as normal user-generated content to divert VLM-based agents.
summary_en.importance: This is a security/evaluation paper. Its main value is exposing a perception-boundary problem in GUI agents: pixel-only models struggle to distinguish trusted interface elements from untrusted user content. It is relevant to multimodal agents and grounding, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: MIRAGE uses a three-stage pipeline: a Localizer identifies user-controllable regions in screenshots, a Generator creates context-aware payloads rendered in the app’s native style, and a Curator enforces realism while balancing apps, region types, and attack intents. The attack works without modifying the agent, app, or OS.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the evaluation focuses on both visual indistinguishability and attack effectiveness against mobile GUI agents. The abstract does not provide model identities, app counts, success rates, or baseline details, so this is more useful as a threat model and data-construction idea than as a result-heavy read.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不深，但它提醒你原生多模态 agent 的训练信号缺了“信任边界”这一维；看 threat model 与样本构造，结果表可略读。
recommendation.en: Not very close to pretraining, but it highlights that native multimodal agents lack a training signal for trust boundaries; read the threat model and sample construction, skim the tables.

paper.title: SimuWoB: Simulating Real-World Mobile Apps for Fast and Faithful GUI Agent Benchmarking
paper.abstract: Mobile GUI agents powered by large language models have progressed rapidly, creating urgent needs for realistic and comprehensive evaluation. Existing benchmarks prioritize reproducibility but are often limited to open-source apps or file-operation tasks for the difficulty of constructing rewards on real applications, leaving a gap between benchmark settings and real-world usage. Moreover, most benchmarks focus on basic grounding and navigation, with limited coverage of complex, long-horizon int

summary.core_problem: SimuWoB 解决的是移动 GUI Agent 评测中的三个实际瓶颈：真实应用难以稳定复现和构造奖励，现有任务过多集中在短链路导航和基础点击，基于模拟器或真机环境的大规模评测成本较高。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接关系不强，但对通用 Agent 评测有参考价值。它的主要贡献是评测资产和环境生成流程，而不是模型训练方法。值得关注的点在于：用 LLM 生成可交互环境、同步生成可执行 reward function，并通过自动验证修复闭环提高评测可靠性。这类方法也可能服务于 GUI Agent 的在线 RL 或大规模数据合成。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把真实移动应用模拟成可部署的 backend-free 网页环境。生成流程分为两阶段：第一阶段根据应用元数据、视觉风格、功能描述和可选截图生成最小可用环境，重点保证 UI 形态、交互逻辑和 mock data 的一致性；第二阶段向环境中注入具体任务和验证器，重点保证任务可完成、状态可检查、奖励可执行。论文强调这种拆分比单次生成更稳，因为应用仿真和任务验证的质量控制目标不同。生成后还有 validation-and-repair loop，用于检查环境可用性、任务可解性和 reward function 的有效性。
summary.experiments: SimuWoB 包含 63 个模拟移动应用、120 个任务，覆盖 Google Play 33 个应用类别中的 20 个。任务来源参考了 86 名参与者、77 个行业的用户研究。任务分为 simple、long-horizon 和 math-related 三类；一半任务需要超过 20 步交互，最难任务超过 50 步。论文评测了 UI-TARS、AutoGLM、Step-GUI、Seed1.8、Gemini 等移动 GUI Agent。所有任务平均成功率为 27.92%，long-horizon 子集为 17.82%，说明长链路状态管理和中间信息维护仍是主要短板。作者还选取 20 个真实世界样例任务做对照，结果显示合成环境上的评估与真实任务评估有一定一致性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看第 3 节的环境生成流程，尤其是两阶段设计和 reward validation；再看任务构成统计和 long-horizon 定义；最后看实验中的失败模式分析。对预训练研究员来说，重点不是 GUI 任务本身，而是可验证交互环境如何由 LLM 批量生成，以及这种环境是否能用于后续在线 RL 或 Agent 数据合成。

summary_en.core_problem: SimuWoB targets three practical gaps in mobile GUI-agent evaluation: real apps are hard to reproduce and reward-check reliably, many existing tasks remain short-horizon and navigation-heavy, and emulator-based evaluation is expensive to scale.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but it is useful for general agent evaluation. The main contribution is an evaluation asset and an environment-generation pipeline rather than a new training method. The useful idea is to use LLM code generation to synthesize interactive app-like environments together with executable reward functions, then validate and repair them automatically. This design may also be useful for GUI-agent data generation or online RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark converts mobile-app workflows into backend-free web environments with mock data and aligned interaction logic. The generation pipeline is split into two stages. Stage 1 builds a minimal working app simulation from app metadata, visual style, feature descriptions, and optional screenshots. Stage 2 injects benchmark tasks and task-specific validators. This separation matters because app fidelity and reward correctness require different checks. A validation-and-repair loop then tests solvability, environment behavior, and executable reward functions before the task is accepted.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 120 tasks across 63 simulated apps, covering 20 of the 33 Google Play app categories. The task pool is informed by a user study with 86 participants from 77 industries. Tasks are grouped into simple, long-horizon, and math-related categories. Half of the tasks require more than 20 interaction steps, and the hardest ones require more than 50. The paper evaluates UI-TARS, AutoGLM, Step-GUI, Seed1.8, and Gemini. The average success rate is 27.92% across all tasks and 17.82% on the long-horizon subset. A comparison against 20 real-world sample tasks suggests that the synthetic environments give broadly transferable agent rankings and failure signals.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the environment-generation pipeline in Section 3, especially the two-stage construction and reward-validation mechanism. Then check the task statistics, the long-horizon split, and the failure analysis. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main value is not the mobile-app domain itself, but the recipe for scalable, verifiable interactive environments that could feed agent training or RL.

recommendation.zh: 移动GUI Agent的新基准，做Agent评测的研究员可看方法和任务设计部分。
recommendation.en: A new benchmark for mobile GUI agents, researchers working on agent evaluation can check the methodology and task design sections.

paper.title: Video2GUI: Synthesizing Large-Scale Interaction Trajectories for Generalized GUI Agent Pretraining
paper.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language models have driven growing interest in graphical user interface (GUI) agents, yet their generalization remains constrained by the scarcity of large-scale training data spanning diverse real-world applications. Existing datasets rely heavily on costly manual annotations and are typically confined to narrow domains. To address this challenge, we propose Video2GUI, a fully automated framework that extracts grounded GUI interaction trajectories directly f

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是 GUI agent 预训练数据不足的问题：真实 GUI 操作轨迹规模小、标注贵、平台覆盖窄，导致模型很难泛化到新的应用、网站和设备环境。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的价值主要在数据构造方法，而不是模型结构。它把互联网上未标注的 GUI 教程视频转成可训练的多模态 agent 轨迹，提供了一条低人工成本扩展 GUI agent 预训练数据的路线。对多模态预训练研究员有两个启发：一是视频可以作为交互轨迹的弱监督来源；二是 GUI agent 的预训练数据需要同时满足视觉状态、动作、坐标 grounding 和任务意图，而不只是图文配对。
summary.technical_approach: Video2GUI 采用 coarse-to-fine 的数据管线。第一步用视频标题、描述、关键词等 metadata 在 5 亿条视频元信息中做低成本粗筛，先排除和 GUI 操作无关的视频，降低存储和计算压力。第二步用视觉评分模型细筛视频内容，评估画面清晰度、教程完整性和任务相关性。之后从原始视频中抽取任务指令、操作时间戳、动作细节以及动作背后的推理信息，再在对应时间点截取屏幕图像，并把动作精确映射到屏幕坐标。这个设计比直接从视频帧做端到端标注更稳，因为视频压缩和帧间变化会让坐标 grounding 变得不可靠，先定位操作时间再做空间 grounding 可以降低噪声。
summary.experiments: 产出的 WildGUI 覆盖网站、移动端和桌面三类平台，包含 1,500 多个应用和网站、1,270 万条 GUI 操作轨迹、1.245 亿张截图，平均每条轨迹 9.7 个 turn。表格中给出的规模明显大于 MiniWoB++、MIND2WEB、AITW、AndroidControl、GUI-Net 等已有公开数据集。实验部分使用 WildGUI 对 Qwen2.5-VL 和 Mimo-VL 做 continual pre-training，再用人工整理的开源数据做 post-training，并在 GUI grounding、离线 agent benchmark 和在线 agent benchmark 上评估。给出的结论是不同模型架构上都有稳定提升，但当前提供内容没有列出各 benchmark 的具体分数和消融数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 分钟。重点看三部分：第一，Video2GUI 的筛选和自动标注流程，尤其是视觉评分、时间戳定位和坐标 grounding 的实现细节；第二，WildGUI 的数据统计和平台覆盖，判断它和已有 GUI 数据集的差异；第三，continual pre-training 与 post-training 的训练 recipe 和消融，尤其要确认提升来自规模、数据多样性，还是来自更干净的 action grounding。若只关心 LLM 预训练，可跳过具体 GUI benchmark 细节，把它当作大规模交互数据合成案例来读。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括北京大学多媒体信息处理全国重点实验室、小米 LLM-Core、中国人民大学、香港大学。文中标注部分贡献来自小米 LLM-Core 实习期间。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets the data bottleneck for GUI agents: real GUI interaction trajectories are expensive to annotate, small in scale, and usually limited to narrow platforms, which hurts generalization to unseen applications and environments.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is in scalable data construction rather than model design. The paper treats unlabeled internet tutorial videos as a source of weak supervision for multimodal agent pretraining. For pretraining researchers, the useful point is that GUI data is not just image-text data; it must bind visual states, actions, screen coordinates, task intent, and temporal structure into one trajectory format.
summary_en.technical_approach: Video2GUI uses a coarse-to-fine pipeline. It first filters 500 million video metadata entries using titles, descriptions, and keywords to remove videos unrelated to GUI operations at low cost. It then applies a visual scoring model to assess screen quality, instructional completeness, and task relevance. For selected videos, it extracts task instructions, operation timestamps, action details, and action rationales, samples screenshots at the identified timestamps, and performs spatial grounding to map actions to screen coordinates. This staged design is more robust than direct frame-level annotation because video compression and temporal ambiguity make coordinate grounding noisy.
summary_en.experiments: The resulting WildGUI dataset covers websites, mobile apps, and desktop software, with more than 1,500 applications and websites, 12.7 million trajectories, 124.5 million screenshots, and an average trajectory length of 9.7 turns. The scale is much larger than the listed public GUI datasets such as MiniWoB++, MIND2WEB, AITW, AndroidControl, and GUI-Net. The authors continually pretrain Qwen2.5-VL and Mimo-VL on WildGUI, then post-train on curated open-source GUI data. They report consistent gains on GUI grounding, offline agent benchmarks, and online agent benchmarks across both model families, although the provided content does not include the detailed benchmark scores or ablation numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 minutes. Focus on the Video2GUI pipeline, especially video filtering, operation timestamp detection, and coordinate grounding. Then check the WildGUI data statistics to understand what kind of diversity is actually added over prior GUI datasets. The most relevant experimental part is the continual-pretraining recipe and ablations, because that determines whether the gains come from scale, diversity, or cleaner grounding. Readers focused on foundation-model pretraining can treat this as a case study in interaction-data synthesis and skip most benchmark-specific details.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Peking University, Xiaomi LLM-Core, Renmin University of China, and The University of Hong Kong. The paper notes that part of the contribution was made during an internship at Xiaomi LLM-Core.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据管线和清洗消融；如果泄漏控制干净，Video-to-trajectory 是 GUI 预训练可复现的放大路径。
recommendation.en: Read the data pipeline and filtering ablations; if leakage control is clean, video-to-trajectory becomes a practical scaling path for GUI-agent pretraining.

paper.title: OmniGUI: Benchmarking GUI Agents in Omni-Modal Smartphone Environments
paper.abstract: Current benchmarks for graphical user interface (GUI) agents predominantly rely on static screenshots. However, real-world smartphone interaction routinely requires agents to process transient audio cues and temporal video dynamics that are tightly coupled with the moment of action. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniGUI, the first step-level benchmark designed to evaluate GUI agents in omni-modal smartphone environments. OmniGUI provides continuous, interleaved multimodal inputs comprising st

summary.core_problem: 现有 GUI agent benchmark 多依赖静态截图，无法评估真实手机交互中与动作时机耦合的音频和视频线索。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 贡献。它把 GUI agent 评测从静态视觉扩展到 step-level 的图像+音频+视频输入，对原生多模态 agent 的能力边界有现实意义。对预训练研究员的价值主要在数据形态与评测需求，而不是方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OmniGUI，一个面向智能手机环境的 omni-modal GUI agent benchmark。每个 action step 提供连续交错的静态图像、同步音频和视频片段，并标注多模态依赖程度。由于专门的 omni-modal GUI agent 尚不成熟，作者用能原生处理交错输入的基础 omni-modal 模型作为代理 baseline。
summary.experiments: 数据包含 709 条专家演示 episode、2579 个 action step，覆盖 29 个应用。评测重点是不同多模态依赖级别下的 agent 表现。摘要未给出具体模型名和分数，但明确指出现有模型在需要时序音视频理解的 GUI 场景下存在明显缺口。

summary_en.core_problem: Current GUI-agent benchmarks rely heavily on static screenshots and fail to evaluate audio/video cues that are tightly coupled with action timing in real smartphone use.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution. It extends GUI-agent evaluation from static visual inputs to step-level image+audio+video streams, which matters for native multimodal agents. For pretraining researchers, the value is mostly in the data/evaluation shape rather than in a new modeling method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces OmniGUI, an omni-modal benchmark for smartphone GUI agents. Each action step contains interleaved static images, synchronized audio, and video clips, with annotations for multimodal dependency levels. Because dedicated omni-modal GUI agents are still immature, the authors use foundational omni-modal models that can natively process interleaved inputs as proxy baselines.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 709 expert-demonstrated episodes and 2,579 action steps across 29 apps. The evaluation focuses on how performance changes with multimodal dependency. The abstract does not list exact model names or scores, but it clearly argues that current models struggle when GUI interaction requires temporal audio-video understanding.

recommendation.zh: 作为 benchmark 选题是对的：GUI agent 迟早要吃时序音视频；但对 pretrain 只提供需求侧信号，读数据设计和失败案例就够。
recommendation.en: The benchmark direction is right—GUI agents will eventually need temporal audio/video—but for pretraining this is mostly a demand-side signal; read the dataset design and failure cases only.
