paper.title: OpenComputer: Verifiable Software Worlds for Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: We present OpenComputer, a verifier-grounded framework for constructing verifiable software worlds for computer-use agents. OpenComputer integrates four components: (1) app-specific state verifiers that expose structured inspection endpoints over real applications, (2) a self-evolving verification layer that improves verifier reliability using execution-grounded feedback, (3) a task-generation pipeline that synthesizes realistic and machine-checkable desktop tasks, and (4) an evaluation harness

summary.core_problem: 为 computer-use agents 构建可验证的软件世界，使桌面任务的完成情况可以通过真实应用状态而非 LLM judge 可靠判定。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent eval / harness / verifier 系统。现有 GUI 或桌面 agent 评测常依赖文本结果、人工判断或 LLM-as-judge，难以审计细粒度应用状态。OpenComputer 用 app-specific verifier 和 partial-credit reward 提供更可复查的评测信号，对 agent RL、tool-use 数据生成和长程交互评估都有价值。
summary.technical_approach: OpenComputer 包含四部分：面向真实应用的 state verifier，通过结构化 inspection endpoint 读取应用状态；self-evolving verification layer，用执行反馈提升 verifier 可靠性；任务生成 pipeline，合成真实且机器可检查的桌面任务；evaluation harness，记录完整轨迹并计算可审计的 partial-credit reward。
summary.experiments: 当前版本覆盖 33 个桌面应用，包含 1,000 个 finalized tasks，范围包括浏览器、办公软件、创意软件、开发环境、文件管理器和通信应用。实验显示，硬编码 verifier 在依赖细粒度应用状态的任务上比 LLM-as-judge 更接近人工判定。摘要未给出具体一致性数值和 frontier agent 成绩。
summary.authors_note: Arman Cohan 是知名 NLP 研究者；仅凭给定信息无法确认本文作者机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper constructs verifiable software worlds for computer-use agents, so desktop task success can be judged through real application state rather than an LLM judge.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent evaluation harness with verifiers. Existing GUI or desktop-agent evaluations often rely on textual outcomes, human judgment, or LLM-as-judge, which are hard to audit at fine-grained application state. OpenComputer provides more inspectable signals for agent RL, tool-use data generation, and long-horizon interaction evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: OpenComputer has four components: app-specific state verifiers exposing structured inspection endpoints over real applications; a self-evolving verification layer that improves verifier reliability from execution-grounded feedback; a task-generation pipeline for realistic and machine-checkable desktop tasks; and an evaluation harness that records full trajectories and computes auditable partial-credit rewards.
summary_en.experiments: The current version covers 33 desktop applications and 1,000 finalized tasks, spanning browsers, office tools, creative software, development environments, file managers, and communication apps. Experiments show that hard-coded verifiers align more closely with human adjudication than LLM-as-judge, especially when fine-grained application state matters. The abstract does not provide the exact agreement numbers or frontier-agent scores.
summary_en.authors_note: Arman Cohan is a well-known NLP researcher; the provided metadata is insufficient to confirm author affiliations for this paper.

recommendation.zh: 读 verifier 设计和 partial reward；比又一个 GUI 榜单更像可用于 agent RL 的环境信号。
recommendation.en: Read the verifier design and partial rewards; this looks more like usable agent-RL environment signal than just another GUI leaderboard.

paper.title: ScreenSearch: Uncertainty-Aware OS Exploration
paper.abstract: Desktop GUI agents operate under partial observability: visually similar screens can correspond to different underlying workflow states, so locally plausible actions can lead to sharply different outcomes. We frame this as a problem of computer/OS state exploration, where effective behavior requires both expanding the reachable frontier and reducing ambiguity before committing. We present ScreenSearch, a system that combines structural screen retrieval and deduplication with an ambiguity-aware P

summary.core_problem: 桌面GUI智能体面临局部可观测性局限：视觉相似的屏幕可能对应不同工作流状态，导致局部合理的动作产生差异巨大的结果
summary.importance: 提出了针对操作系统状态探索的通用框架，属于桌面GUI Agent领域的方法创新
summary.technical_approach: 提出ScreenSearch系统，将UIA树转化为位置感知的结构特征，通过稀疏token检索和元数据过滤索引相似屏幕，维护跨VM工作节点的去重状态图；基于相同动作下相似屏幕的结果离散度定义歧义信号，结合歧义感知的PUCT图-老虎机算法进行大规模桌面探索
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未披露具体实验数据、基线模型及效果对比
summary.authors_note: 作者Michael Solodko、Justin Wagle，未披露所属机构信息

summary_en.core_problem: Desktop GUI agents suffer from partial observability: visually similar screens may correspond to different underlying workflow states, leading to drastically divergent outcomes from locally plausible actions
summary_en.importance: Proposes a general framework for OS state exploration, representing methodological innovation in desktop GUI agent research
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents ScreenSearch, which converts UIA trees into location-aware structural features, indexes similar screens via sparse token search and metadata filters, maintains a shared deduplicated state graph across VM workers; defines ambiguity signal based on outcome dispersion of identical actions on similar screens, and combines ambiguity-aware PUCT graph-bandit for large-scale desktop exploration
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental data, baselines or performance comparisons are disclosed in the abstract
summary_en.authors_note: Authors Michael Solodko and Justin Wagle, no institutional affiliation disclosed

recommendation.zh: 桌面GUI Agent的状态去重和歧义感知设计有参考价值，仅作领域前沿了解即可，无需精读
recommendation.en: The state deduplication and ambiguity-aware design for desktop GUI agents has reference value, only for frontier understanding, no need for in-depth reading

paper.title: Video2GUI: Synthesizing Large-Scale Interaction Trajectories for Generalized GUI Agent Pretraining
paper.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language models have driven growing interest in graphical user interface (GUI) agents, yet their generalization remains constrained by the scarcity of large-scale training data spanning diverse real-world applications. Existing datasets rely heavily on costly manual annotations and are typically confined to narrow domains. To address this challenge, we propose Video2GUI, a fully automated framework that extracts grounded GUI interaction trajectories directly f

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决 GUI agent 预训练数据规模不足的问题。现有 GUI 轨迹数据多来自人工标注或模拟环境，质量可控但覆盖面窄，难以覆盖真实网站、桌面软件和移动应用中的长尾交互。论文尝试把未标注互联网视频转成可训练的 GUI 操作轨迹。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在数据侧，而不是模型结构侧。它把互联网视频视为一种大规模行为数据源，用自动筛选、时间定位和空间 grounding 把视频转成 agent trajectory。这个方向对 multimodal agent pretraining 有实际意义：GUI agent 的泛化瓶颈通常不只是模型能力，而是缺少跨平台、跨应用、跨任务的交互监督。WildGUI 的规模明显大于常见 GUI 数据集，适合作为继续预训练数据，而不是只用于小规模 SFT。
summary.technical_approach: Video2GUI 采用 coarse-to-fine 的自动构建流程。第一步用视频标题、描述、关键词等 metadata 做低成本粗筛，从 5 亿条视频 metadata 中去掉与 GUI 操作无关的内容，避免直接处理原始视频带来的存储和算力开销。第二步用视觉评分模型做细筛，评估画面清晰度、教程完整性、任务相关性等，以控制视频质量。第三步从视频中抽取结构化轨迹：识别任务 instruction、操作时间戳、动作细节以及动作背后的 reasoning；再在对应时间点抽帧，并把动作映射到屏幕坐标，得到可用于训练 GUI agent 的 grounded action trajectory。基于该流程构建的 WildGUI 覆盖 web、mobile、desktop 三类平台，包含高层 instruction 和低层 action supervision。训练上，论文不是从零训练 VLM，而是在 Qwen2.5-VL 和 Mimo-VL 上做 continual pretraining，再用整理后的开源 GUI 数据做 post-training。
summary.experiments: 数据规模是论文最核心的数字：从 5 亿条视频 metadata 出发，得到 1270 万条 GUI 操作轨迹、1.245 亿张截图，覆盖 1500 多个应用和网站，平均每条轨迹 9.7 轮。表 1 显示，WildGUI 在开源 GUI 预训练数据中规模最大，且同时覆盖网站、移动端和桌面端。实验使用 WildGUI 对 Qwen2.5-VL 和 Mimo-VL 做继续预训练，并在 GUI grounding、offline agent benchmark 和 online agent benchmark 上评估。提供内容中没有给出具体分数表，但论文声称在不同模型架构和评测设置下都有稳定提升，并能达到或超过强基线。需要重点看消融：metadata 粗筛、视觉质量评分、时间戳抽取、坐标 grounding、continual pretraining 与后续 post-training 各自贡献多少。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。优先看数据构建流程图、Table 1、数据清洗与轨迹抽取章节、训练设置和消融实验。重点不是 benchmark 排名，而是三个问题：一是视频筛选如何避免大量噪声；二是从压缩视频中恢复点击、输入、拖拽等 grounded action 的误差如何控制；三是 WildGUI 更像预训练数据还是 SFT 数据。若只关心基座预训练，可跳过部分 GUI benchmark 细节，重点看数据规模化 pipeline 和 continual pretraining 方案。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括北京大学多媒体信息处理全国重点实验室、小米 LLM-Core、中国人民大学、香港大学。文中可见通讯作者为 Sujian Li；部分贡献来自小米 LLM-Core 实习期间。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the data bottleneck for GUI agent pretraining. Existing GUI trajectory datasets are mostly manually annotated or simulator-generated, which keeps quality high but limits scale and diversity. The work turns unlabeled Internet videos into grounded GUI interaction trajectories.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is on the data-pretraining interface rather than model architecture. It treats web videos as large-scale behavioral supervision for multimodal agents, then converts them into structured trajectories through filtering, temporal localization, and spatial grounding. This matters because GUI agent generalization is often limited by coverage across real applications, platforms, and user workflows, not only by model capacity. WildGUI is large enough to be used for continual pretraining, rather than only as a small instruction-tuning corpus.
summary_en.technical_approach: Video2GUI uses a coarse-to-fine automated pipeline. It first filters 500 million video metadata entries using titles, descriptions, and keywords, which removes clearly irrelevant content before downloading or processing videos. It then applies a visual scoring model to assess visual fidelity, instructional completeness, and task relevance. For selected videos, the pipeline extracts task instructions, operation timestamps, action details, and action rationales. It samples screenshots at the identified timestamps and grounds the actions to screen coordinates, producing structured GUI trajectories. The resulting WildGUI dataset covers web, mobile, and desktop environments, and includes both high-level instructions and low-level action supervision. The training recipe applies continual pretraining on Qwen2.5-VL and Mimo-VL with WildGUI, followed by post-training on curated open-source GUI datasets.
summary_en.experiments: The key numbers are on data scale: starting from 500 million video metadata entries, the pipeline produces 12.7 million GUI trajectories and 124.5 million screenshots across more than 1,500 applications and websites, with an average of 9.7 turns per trajectory. Table 1 shows that WildGUI is substantially larger than prior open GUI datasets and spans websites, mobile apps, and desktop software. The models are evaluated on GUI grounding, offline agent benchmarks, and online agent benchmarks after continual pretraining on WildGUI. The provided text does not include exact benchmark scores, but reports consistent gains across Qwen2.5-VL and Mimo-VL. The most useful experimental details to verify are the ablations on metadata filtering, visual scoring, timestamp extraction, coordinate grounding, continual pretraining, and downstream post-training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Focus on the pipeline figure, Table 1, the dataset construction section, training setup, and ablation studies. The important questions are how the pipeline controls noise in Internet videos, how accurately it recovers grounded actions from compressed video frames, and whether WildGUI behaves more like pretraining data or instruction-tuning data. Readers focused on foundation-model pretraining can skim the benchmark-specific GUI details and spend more time on the scalable data pipeline and continual-pretraining recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: The affiliations shown include Peking University, Xiaomi LLM-Core, Renmin University of China, and The University of Hong Kong. Sujian Li is listed as a corresponding author; part of the contribution was made during an internship at Xiaomi LLM-Core.

recommendation.zh: 值得看数据管线，不必迷信 benchmark 涨幅；重点判断自动抽取轨迹的噪声结构，若噪声可控，这类视频挖掘会是 agent pretrain 的便宜数据源。
recommendation.en: Read it for the data pipeline, not the headline gains; the real question is whether the extracted trajectory noise is structured enough to make internet video a cheap pretraining source for GUI agents.

paper.title: ReVision: Scaling Computer-Use Agents via Temporal Visual Redundancy Reduction
paper.abstract: Computer-use agents~(CUAs) rely on visual observations of graphical user interfaces, where each screenshot is encoded into a large number of visual tokens. As interaction trajectories grow, the token cost increases rapidly, limiting the amount of history that can be incorporated under fixed context and compute budgets. This has resulted in no or very limited improvement in the performance when using history unlike other domains. We address this inefficiency by introducing ReVision, which is used

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 computer-use agent 在长轨迹场景里的一个很具体但长期被低估的问题：历史截图确实有用，但现有 MLLM 把每一帧都当成独立图像编码，导致大量重复视觉 token 挤占上下文，结果不是“历史没用”，而是“历史表示太低效”。论文要解决的核心不是单纯压缩图像，而是在不改底层 MLLM 架构的前提下，按时间维度识别连续 GUI 截图中的冗余 patch，只保留真正变化或任务相关的区域，让模型能在同样上下文预算下看到更长的交互历史，并且学会基于这种稀疏历史做决策。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接启发不在于 agent 应用本身，而在于它把“跨时间冗余建模”明确成了多模态序列建模里的训练问题，而不是推理时的工程裁剪。这个视角有两点价值。第一，它说明多图像/视频式上下文里，token budget 的主要浪费常常来自重复观测，而不是模型容量不足；如果训练时就暴露给模型压缩后的时序输入，性能和效率可以同时改善。第二，它给统一多模态预训练一个可迁移的思路：不是一味追求更长上下文，而是先问哪些 token 在时间上是可删的、删掉后模型是否还能维持空间结构和决策能力。对 GUI agent 是 patch redundancy，对视频、桌面操作、甚至语音离散 token 序列，也都对应“相邻帧/相邻片段高度重复”的同类问题。贡献量级上，这更像一个扎实的训练范式改造，而不是新的基础架构。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 ReVision Token Selection（RTS）加上基于过滤轨迹的端到端微调。先说冗余定义：作者把相邻两帧截图按同一视觉 tokenizer 的 patch 网格对齐，对每个位置的 patch embedding 做比较，判断当前帧该 patch 是否可由前一帧“解释”，如果可以，就视为冗余。为此他们训练了一个轻量三层 MLP 分类器，输入是相邻截图中对应 patch 的表示，输出该 patch 是否应保留。这里的关键设计不是做全局检索式压缩，而是保留原有二维空间布局，只在 patch 级别做删减，这样可以继续兼容 Qwen2.5-VL 这类现成视觉-语言架构，不需要改 attention 结构或重写位置编码。

训练流程分两步。第一步训练 RTS，让它学会在时间上识别冗余 patch。第二步把 RTS 接入 MLLM 数据流水线，对 AgentNet 轨迹中的历史截图做 patch 过滤，再用这些压缩后的多步视觉历史去微调 Qwen2.5-VL-7B。论文强调这不是推理时外挂式 token pruning，而是让模型在训练阶段就适应“部分历史图像只保留变化区域”的输入分布，因此模型会学会把证据分散地整合到多帧里，而不是默认每一帧都完整可见。

与常见 baselines 的区别主要有三点。其一，不是简单减少历史帧数，而是在固定帧数下减少每帧冗余 token，因此保留了更长时间跨度。其二，不是基于启发式像素差分，而是用 learned selector 在 embedding 空间判断冗余，鲁棒性更高，也更接近模型实际感知空间。其三，不改 backbone，因此结论更干净：收益主要来自时序冗余消除和训练分布匹配，而不是额外模型容量。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 OSWorld、WebTailBench、AgentNetBench 三个长程 computer-use benchmark，底座模型是 Qwen2.5-VL-7B。论文先做了一个很重要的统计：连续 GUI 截图之间平均有 45.4% 的 patch 不发生变化，某些设置超过 56%，折算下来平均每一步有 1000 多个冗余 patch。这为方法提供了明确动机。

主结果上，在使用 5 张历史截图时，ReVision 平均减少约 46% 的视觉 token，同时相对不做 drop 的 baseline 带来约 +3% 的 success rate 提升。若只给 3 张历史图，ReVision 的表现已经接近一些更重的 baseline，但视觉 token 量大约只有一半。随着历史长度增加到 5 张及以上，ReVision 相对同规模 baseline 的优势更稳定，平均至少高 2% 左右。论文最有信息量的观察不是单点提升，而是历史长度-性能曲线的形状变化：在普通表示下，性能较早饱和；做了冗余过滤后，继续增加历史仍能带来收益。这说明过去很多“history 不再有用”的结论，部分是被低效视觉表示误导的。

从消融角度，值得注意的点通常包括： learned RTS 相比不加选择或简单保留最近帧更优；训练时使用过滤后的轨迹优于只在推理时做过滤；在相近 token 预算下，保留更多时间步但每步更稀疏，优于保留更少时间步但每步完整。这些结果共同支持作者的中心论点：长程 GUI 决策更缺的是有效历史，而不是原始像素堆叠。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但建议把几个关键位置看仔细。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，核心结论已经很清楚：问题不是历史无效，而是视觉 token 冗余导致历史装不进去。然后看 Temporal Visual Redundancy 和 Table 1，这部分决定了方法是否值得做；如果你关心多模态预训练里的 token economy，这一节最有启发。方法部分重点看 Figure 2 和 RTS 的输入输出定义，确认它如何在不改 backbone 的情况下保留空间结构。实验部分优先看不同 history length 下的曲线，而不是只看单个 benchmark 平均分，因为真正有价值的是“延后饱和点”这个现象。

预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主要信息。如果要深挖，建议追问三件事：一，RTS 的监督信号具体如何构造，是否会把语义上重要但视觉变化小的区域误删；二，patch 过滤后位置编码和视觉聚合是否存在分布偏移；三，这种时间冗余压缩能否推广到原生视频预训练或多帧 VLM，而不只是 GUI agent 微调。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific bottleneck in computer-use agents: history is useful, but screenshot history is represented in a wasteful way. Standard MLLMs encode every GUI frame independently, so long trajectories quickly fill the context window with repeated visual tokens. The real issue is not that past observations stop helping, but that the model spends too much budget re-encoding unchanged interface regions. ReVision addresses this by learning to remove temporally redundant patches across consecutive screenshots while preserving the spatial structure needed by the underlying vision-language model.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is less about the agent setting itself and more about the framing: temporal redundancy reduction is treated as a training-time modeling problem, not just an inference-time compression trick. That matters because it suggests a broader principle for multimodal pretraining: before scaling context length, ask which tokens are redundant across time and whether the model can be trained directly on a compact temporal representation. The paper also provides evidence that apparent history saturation in GUI agents is partly an artifact of inefficient visual tokenization. That idea should transfer to other sequential modalities with high local redundancy, including video and discrete audio streams.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two main pieces: a lightweight patch selector called ReVision Token Selection (RTS), and end-to-end fine-tuning of an MLLM on filtered trajectories. RTS is a 3-layer MLP that takes the embeddings of corresponding patches from two consecutive screenshots and predicts whether the current patch is redundant given the previous frame. The design choice here is important: the model does not perform global image compression or frame dropping. Instead, it keeps the original patch grid and removes only redundant patches at aligned spatial locations, which preserves compatibility with an existing backbone such as Qwen2.5-VL-7B.

After training RTS, the selector is inserted into the data pipeline. Historical screenshots in AgentNet trajectories are filtered patch-wise, and the MLLM is fine-tuned directly on these compact visual histories. This is a stronger setup than post-hoc token pruning at inference time, because the model is exposed during training to temporally sparse visual evidence and can learn to integrate information distributed across multiple steps.

Relative to common baselines, the contribution is fairly clean. It does not simply reduce the number of history images; it reduces redundancy within each image so that longer temporal context fits under the same budget. It does not rely on hand-crafted pixel differencing; redundancy is predicted in embedding space, which is closer to the model’s own representation. And it does not modify the backbone architecture, so the gains can be attributed mainly to temporal token filtering plus training on the filtered distribution.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments are run on OSWorld, WebTailBench, and AgentNetBench with Qwen2.5-VL-7B as the base model. The motivating analysis is already useful on its own: consecutive GUI screenshots contain 45.4% unchanged patches on average, and in some settings the redundancy exceeds 56%, corresponding to more than 1,000 redundant patches per step.

On the main benchmarks, using 5 history screenshots, ReVision reduces visual token usage by about 46% on average while improving success rate by roughly 3 percentage points over the no-drop baseline. With only 3 history images, it reaches performance close to some stronger baselines while using about half as many visual tokens. The more interesting result is the trend with history length: once the history grows to 5 images or more, ReVision consistently outperforms most same-scale baselines by at least around 2 points on average. The key takeaway is not a single headline number but the shift in the history-performance curve. Without redundancy reduction, performance appears to saturate early; with filtered histories, adding more past context continues to help. That supports the claim that prior saturation was driven by inefficient visual representations rather than by the irrelevance of history itself.

The ablations appear to reinforce this story: learned patch selection beats naive history truncation, training on filtered trajectories is better than applying filtering only at inference, and keeping more time steps with sparse patches is better than keeping fewer full frames under a similar token budget.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but a careful skim is worthwhile. Start with the introduction and Figure 1, because the main claim is already visible there: history was bottlenecked by representation inefficiency, not by lack of utility. Then read the temporal redundancy analysis and Table 1. That section is the strongest motivation and the part most relevant to multimodal token economy. In the method section, focus on Figure 2 and the exact RTS input-output formulation to see how spatial structure is preserved without changing the backbone. In the experiments, prioritize the curves over history length rather than only average benchmark scores; the delayed saturation effect is the most informative result.

About 20–30 minutes should be enough for the main ideas. If reading more deeply, three questions are worth checking: how the RTS supervision is constructed, whether semantically important but visually stable regions can be dropped by mistake, and whether the same temporal filtering idea could be extended from GUI trajectories to native video pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 适合做 VLM agent 的 token-budget baseline；重点看 selector 是否保空间结构，46% token 降幅比 3% 成功率更有用。
recommendation.en: Good baseline for VLM-agent token budgeting; inspect the selector and spatial preservation, since the 46% token cut matters more than the 3% gain.

paper.title: ToolCUA: Towards Optimal GUI-Tool Path Orchestration for Computer Use Agents
paper.abstract: Computer Use Agents (CUAs) can act through both atomic GUI actions, such as click and type, and high-level tool calls, such as API-based file operations, but this hybrid action space often leaves them uncertain about when to continue with GUI actions or switch to tools, leading to suboptimal execution paths. This difficulty stems from the scarcity of high-quality interleaved GUI-Tool trajectories, the cost and brittleness of collecting real tool trajectories, and the lack of trajectory-level sup

summary.core_problem: 解决计算机使用代理（CUA）的混合GUI-工具动作空间调度问题：现有代理要么过度调用工具导致错误率上升，要么完全不利用工具仅依赖GUI长序列操作效率低下。现有方法缺乏高质量的交错GUI-工具轨迹数据，且训练信号仅聚焦单步模仿或最终任务完成，无法提供轨迹级的路径选择反馈，难以学习最优的GUI-工具切换策略。
summary.importance: 提出可扩展的混合GUI-工具路径编排范式，解决了计算机使用代理同时支持原子GUI操作和结构化工具调用的核心落地痛点，对通用智能体的多粒度动作空间统一建模、训练信号设计有直接参考价值，也为复用现有大规模纯GUI轨迹数据提供了低成本方案。
summary.technical_approach: 采用两阶段训练范式：第一阶段是可扩展的交错GUI-工具数据构造管线，基于已有的静态GUI语料，用多模态大模型从重复出现的GUI操作流程中合成轨迹感知的工具库，通过工具步骤生成和下一状态接地，将纯GUI数据转换为交错的GUI-工具轨迹，无需采集成本高昂的真实工具轨迹。第二阶段是分层强化微调：先通过暖启动有监督微调获得基础混合动作能力，再用单轮强化学习优化显式的GUI-工具切换点决策，最后在真实GUI-工具环境中用在线智能体强化学习优化，奖励函数包含工具适配性项（鼓励在有益时调用工具、无必要时避免调用）和路径效率项（鼓励用工具调用替代冗余GUI操作缩短路径），提供轨迹级反馈引导模型选择全局最优执行路径。
summary.experiments: 在OSWorld-MCP基准上，同等参数量级下ToolCUA达到46.85%的任务成功率，相比Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct基线相对提升约66%，性能接近头部闭源模型。消融实验验证了数据合成管线和轨迹级奖励的贡献：仅用合成数据的有监督微调阶段就比基线提升27%相对性能，加入轨迹级强化学习后再提升31%相对性能；不同强度的工具偏好设置下，模型可在工具调用率和成功率之间实现可控的权衡。
summary.reading_guide: 首先精读引言部分的混合动作空间问题定义和现有方案的缺陷分析，然后重点看数据合成管线设计和分层强化学习训练框架章节，核心图表关注路径选择问题建模示意图、基准对比结果表、以及工具奖励项的消融实验表。值得深挖的点包括：如何将该数据合成范式扩展到更多非桌面端的智能体场景、轨迹级奖励的设计是否可迁移到其他多动作空间的智能体训练。

summary_en.core_problem: This work addresses the hybrid GUI-tool action space orchestration problem for Computer Use Agents (CUAs): existing agents either overuse tools leading to higher error rates, or underutilize tools and rely solely on long sequences of GUI operations with low efficiency. Current methods lack high-quality interleaved GUI-tool trajectory data, and training signals only focus on step-level imitation or final task completion, failing to provide trajectory-level path selection feedback, making it hard to learn optimal GUI-tool switching policies.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a scalable hybrid GUI-tool path orchestration paradigm, solving the core deployment pain point of CUAs that need to support both atomic GUI operations and structured tool calls. It provides direct reference for unified modeling of multi-granularity action spaces and training signal design for general agents, and offers a low-cost solution for reusing existing large-scale pure GUI trajectory corpora.
summary_en.technical_approach: A two-stage training paradigm is adopted: The first stage is a scalable interleaved GUI-tool data construction pipeline. Based on existing static GUI corpora, MLLMs are used to synthesize trajectory-aware tool libraries from recurring GUI operation procedures. Pure GUI data is converted to interleaved GUI-tool trajectories through tool step generation and next-state grounding, eliminating the need to collect high-cost real tool trajectories. The second stage is hierarchical reinforcement fine-tuning: first, warmup supervised fine-tuning is used to obtain basic hybrid action capabilities, then single-turn RL is applied to optimize decisions at explicit GUI-tool switching points, finally online agentic RL is performed in a realistic GUI-tool environment. The reward function includes a tool appropriateness term (incentivizing tool calls when beneficial and abstention when unnecessary) and a path efficiency term (encouraging replacement of redundant GUI operations with tool calls to shorten trajectories), providing trajectory-level feedback to guide the model to select globally optimal execution paths.
summary_en.experiments: On the OSWorld-MCP benchmark, ToolCUA achieves 46.85% task success rate at the same parameter scale, a ~66% relative improvement over the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct baseline, on par with leading closed-source models. Ablation studies verify the contribution of the data synthesis pipeline and trajectory-level reward: the SFT stage using only synthetic data already delivers 27% relative performance gain over the baseline, and adding trajectory-level RL brings another 31% relative improvement. With different tool preference settings, the model can achieve controllable trade-offs between tool call rate and success rate.
summary_en.reading_guide: First carefully read the hybrid action space problem definition and limitation analysis of existing solutions in the Introduction, then focus on the data synthesis pipeline design and hierarchical RL training framework sections. Key figures and tables include the path selection problem modeling diagram, benchmark comparison results table, and ablation tables for tool reward terms. Worth further exploring points include extending the data synthesis paradigm to more non-desktop agent scenarios, and whether the trajectory-level reward design can be transferred to training of other agents with multi-action spaces.

recommendation.zh: 预训练方向不必通读，只看轨迹合成和 RFT 设计；它对“工具数据从哪来”比对模型结构更有信息量。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end for pretraining; inspect the trajectory synthesis and RFT setup, since the useful signal is where tool-use supervision comes from.

paper.title: Faithful Mobile GUI Agents with Guided Advantage Estimator
paper.abstract: Vision-language model based graphical user interface (GUI) agents have shown strong interaction capabilities. However, they often behave unfaithfully, relying on memorized shortcuts rather than grounding actions in displayed screen evidence or user instructions. To address this, we propose Faithful-Agent, a faithfulness-first framework that reformulates GUI interaction to prioritize evidence groundedness and internal consistency. Faithful-Agent employs a two-stage pipeline: (i) a faithfulness-or

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文关注 GUI Agent 的“faithfulness”问题：模型在手机界面交互时，可能没有真正依据当前屏幕证据和用户指令做决策，而是依赖记忆化捷径、任务先验或格式化动作模板。作者把问题拆成两类：一类是 evidence groundedness 不足，包括看不到关键证据仍继续操作、或偏离用户指令；另一类是 internal inconsistency，即推理文本表达的意图和最终执行动作不一致。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不高，但对 post-train 阶段的 RL 信号设计有参考意义。它不是一个通用基座预训练方法，而是 GUI Agent 的对齐与强化微调工作。值得看的点在于：作者没有只优化任务成功率，而是把“缺证据时应 abstain”写进训练目标，并分析了 GRPO 在低方差 rollout group 下的 advantage collapse。这对稀疏奖励场景下的 RL 微调有一定启发，尤其是当正确行为集中在少数离散动作，例如 terminate、back、system_button 时。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是两阶段训练。第一阶段是 faithfulness-oriented SFT，通过证据扰动样本让模型学习在证据缺失、遮挡、指令冲突时不要猜测执行，而是选择返回、移除遮挡或终止任务。第二阶段是在 GRPO 基础上做 RFT，引入 Guided Advantage Estimator，简称 GuAE。其动机是标准 GRPO 依赖组内 reward 归一化，如果同一输入下多个 rollout 的 reward 接近，组内方差很低，advantage 会被压到接近 0，导致策略几乎没有有效更新。作者称之为 advantage collapse。GuAE 用 anchor-based 和 variance-adaptive tempering 的方式，在低方差组中保留非平凡 advantage，在高方差组中避免过度放大更新。除此之外，训练还加入 action-matching reward 和 thought-action consistency reward，分别约束动作是否匹配目标、以及推理意图和执行动作是否一致。和普通 GUI Agent RFT 相比，这篇工作的差别不在 backbone 或大规模数据，而在 reward granularity 和 advantage 估计方式。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 Faithful-Agent Stage II 将 Trap SR 从 baseline 的 13.88% 提升到 80.21%，同时保持一般指令跟随能力，整体 success rate 为 71.67%。这个结果说明 faithfulness 训练没有只是在拒绝执行上“保守化”，而是在陷阱场景中显著减少了无证据执行。更关键的实验应看 GuAE 相对标准 GRPO 的消融：如果低方差组中的离散 abstainment action 确实难以通过常规组内归一化学习，那么 GuAE 应该主要提升 trap、occlusion、instruction conflict 这类场景，而不是均匀提升所有 GUI 操作。给出的材料没有完整列出每个 benchmark、backbone、数据规模和消融表，因此不宜推断更细的数值结论。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。建议重点看三处：第一，Section 3 对 step-wise faithfulness 和 advantage collapse 的定义，看作者如何把 GUI 错误从“任务失败”拆成证据 groundedness 与 reasoning-action consistency；第二，GuAE 的公式和实现细节，尤其是 anchor 如何设定、variance-adaptive tempering 如何避免在高方差组中过度更新；第三，ablation 表，确认 Stage I SFT、GuAE、thought-action consistency reward 分别贡献了什么。对基座预训练研究员来说，这篇论文不需要精读 GUI 任务细节，重点是稀疏奖励 RL 中 advantage 信号质量的处理方式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies faithfulness failures in mobile GUI agents. The agent may execute actions based on memorized shortcuts or task priors rather than the current screen and the user instruction. The authors separate the issue into two parts: weak evidence grounding, such as acting without visible support or drifting away from the instruction, and internal inconsistency, where the reasoning trace commits to one intent while the executed action follows another.
summary_en.importance: This is not a base pretraining paper, but it is relevant to reinforcement fine-tuning and reward design for agents. The useful part is the treatment of abstention as a learnable behavior under missing or conflicting evidence. The paper also identifies a practical failure mode of GRPO in sparse-reward GUI settings: when rollouts within a group have near-constant rewards, normalized advantages can collapse and provide little learning signal. This is a concrete post-training issue that can also appear in other sparse discrete-action environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two stages. The first stage performs faithfulness-oriented SFT, using evidence perturbations to teach the model to abstain, go back, remove occlusions, or terminate when the screen evidence is insufficient. The second stage applies GRPO-style reinforcement fine-tuning with a Guided Advantage Estimator, or GuAE. GuAE is an anchor-based, variance-adaptive advantage tempering mechanism. It keeps advantages informative for low-variance rollout groups while avoiding excessive scaling when the group variance is already high. The training also adds action-matching rewards and thought-action consistency rewards, so the final action is encouraged to follow the stated reasoning intent. The main methodological difference from standard GUI-agent RFT is not a new backbone, but a more careful advantage estimator and reward decomposition for faithful actions.
summary_en.experiments: The reported Stage II model increases Trap SR from 13.88% for the baseline to 80.21%, while maintaining general instruction-following performance and reaching a 71.67% overall success rate. The key empirical claim is that faithfulness training improves trap and conflict cases without simply making the agent overly conservative. The supplied text does not include the full benchmark table, model size, data scale, or all ablation numbers, so the strongest supported reading is limited to the reported Trap SR and overall success results.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on three parts: the formalization of step-wise faithfulness and advantage collapse in Section 3, the exact GuAE formula and how the variance-adaptive tempering is implemented, and the ablation tables separating the effects of SFT, GuAE, and the thought-action consistency reward. For base-model researchers, the GUI benchmark details are less important than the handling of weak RL signals under sparse rewards and discrete abstention actions.

recommendation.zh: 只看 GuAE 的定义和 sparse-reward 消融；若 setup 干净，它是 GRPO 在 agent 场景失效模式的好案例。
recommendation.en: Read the GuAE definition and sparse-reward ablations; if the setup is clean, it is a useful GRPO failure-mode case for agents.

paper.title: AutoFocus: Uncertainty-Aware Active Visual Search for GUI Grounding
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled autonomous GUI agents that translate natural language instructions into executable screen coordinates. However, grounding performance degrades in high-resolution interfaces, where dense layouts and small interactive elements expose a resolution gap between modern displays and model input constraints. Existing zoom-in strategies rely on fixed anchors, heuristic grids, or reinforcement learning, lacking a principled mechanism to adaptively determine where

summary.core_problem: 高分辨率 GUI 中，小控件和密集布局会让 VLM 坐标 grounding 失效；论文尝试用不确定性驱动的主动搜索来决定放大哪里。
summary.importance: 贡献是通用 GUI agent 的推理时 grounding 方法，不需要训练；有一定方法信号，因为它把坐标生成 token 的 perplexity 当作空间不确定性估计。
summary.technical_approach: AutoFocus 对坐标生成采样多个候选点，用横纵轴 token-level perplexity 构造各向异性高斯空间概率场，再根据不确定区域自适应选择局部放大和细化搜索，而不是固定网格、固定 anchor 或 RL 学到的缩放策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、VLM backbone、屏幕分辨率、baseline 或数值提升；只能确认方法是 training-free，并面向高分辨率 GUI grounding。
summary.authors_note: Wuhan University of Technology；Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses GUI grounding failures in high-resolution screens, where dense layouts and small elements exceed the effective input resolution of current VLMs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference method for GUI agents. The useful idea is to treat coordinate-token perplexity as a spatial uncertainty signal for active visual search.
summary_en.technical_approach: AutoFocus samples multiple coordinate hypotheses, converts axial token-level perplexities into an anisotropic Gaussian probability field, and adaptively zooms into uncertain regions instead of relying on fixed grids, anchors, or reinforcement-learned zoom policies.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied abstract does not provide benchmark names, backbone models, screen resolutions, baselines, or numerical gains; it only specifies the training-free GUI grounding setup.
summary_en.authors_note: Wuhan University of Technology; Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences.

recommendation.zh: 预训练无关，但 perplexity 当 grounding 不确定性这个 trick 可偷；只看方法图和不确定性构造。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the perplexity-as-grounding-uncertainty trick is reusable; read only the method figure and uncertainty formulation.

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: A11y-Compressor: A Framework for Enhancing the Efficiency of GUI Agent Observations through Visual Context Reconstruction and Redundancy Reduction
paper.abstract: AI agents that interact with graphical user interfaces (GUIs) require effective observation representations for reliable grounding. The accessibility tree is a commonly used text-based format that encodes UI element attributes, but it suffers from redundancy and lacks structural information such as spatial relationships among elements. We propose A11y-Compressor, a framework that transforms linearized accessibility trees into compact and structured representations. Our implementation, Compressed

summary.core_problem: 解决 GUI Agent 使用 accessibility tree 作为观察输入时冗余高、结构信息弱的问题，以降低 token 开销并提升任务成功率。
summary.importance: 这是一个面向 GUI agent 的输入表示工程改进。对基座预训练没有直接方法贡献，但对 agent 系统里“观察压缩是否比更强模型更划算”这个问题有实际参考。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 A11y-Compressor，将线性化 accessibility tree 转成更紧凑、结构化的表示。实现 Compressed-a11y，包含 modal detection、冗余删除和语义结构化三个步骤，试图在保留 grounding 所需信息的同时减少无效 token。
summary.experiments: 在 OSWorld benchmark 上评测，输入 token 降到原始的 22%，平均任务成功率提升 5.1 个百分点。摘要未说明使用的基座模型、agent 框架和对照输入格式细节，因此更适合作为系统技巧参考，而不是结论很强的研究论文。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Hosei University，属于较典型的 GUI agent 表示层优化工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses redundancy and weak structural information in accessibility-tree observations for GUI agents, aiming to reduce token cost while improving task success.
summary_en.importance: This is an engineering improvement for GUI-agent input representation. It has little direct value for foundation-model pretraining, but it is a useful data point on whether observation compression can beat simply using a stronger model.
summary_en.technical_approach: A11y-Compressor converts linearized accessibility trees into a more compact and structured representation. The implementation, Compressed-a11y, applies modal detection, redundancy reduction, and semantic structuring to preserve grounding-relevant information while removing wasted tokens.
summary_en.experiments: On OSWorld, the method reduces input tokens to 22% of the original and improves average task success by 5.1 points. The abstract does not specify the base model, agent stack, or exact baselines, so this is better treated as a practical systems trick than a strong scientific conclusion.
summary_en.authors_note: The work comes from Hosei University and is a fairly typical GUI-agent representation optimization paper.

recommendation.zh: 如果你碰 GUI agent，上来先看输入表示而不是换更大模型；否则这就是个不错的系统小技巧，不必细读。
recommendation.en: If you touch GUI agents, check the observation representation before scaling the model; otherwise this is a decent systems trick, not a paper to spend time on.

paper.title: Step-level Optimization for Efficient Computer-use Agents
paper.abstract: Computer-use agents provide a promising path toward general software automation because they can interact directly with arbitrary graphical user interfaces instead of relying on brittle, application-specific integrations. Despite recent advances in benchmark performance, strong computer-use agents remain expensive and slow in practice, since most systems invoke large multimodal models at nearly every interaction step. We argue that this uniform allocation of compute is fundamentally inefficient

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 computer-use agent 在推理阶段的算力分配问题：现有 GUI agent 往往在每一步都调用同一个大多模态模型，导致长轨迹任务的成本、时延和单位经济性都很差。作者指出，GUI 轨迹的难度并不均匀，真正容易出错的往往集中在少数高风险时刻，主要表现为两类：一是 progress stall，即代理在局部状态里打转、重复等价操作却没有推进；二是 silent semantic drift，即动作在局部上看似合理，但已经偏离用户目标，后续步骤虽然自洽，最终任务仍会失败。核心问题不是如何再训练一个更强 agent，而是如何在不改动底层大模型的前提下，把“大模型每步在线”改成“按风险事件触发”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接贡献有限，它更接近部署期控制与 agent inference orchestration，而不是新的预训练目标、数据配方或建模范式。但它有两个值得注意的启发。第一，长程交互任务中的错误分布高度稀疏且结构化，这说明未来如果要做 agent-oriented pretraining 或 mid-training，训练信号不一定要均匀铺在每一步，围绕关键转折点构造监督可能更高效。第二，这篇工作把“何时需要强模型”显式建模成一个可学习的风险预测问题，这对后续做 test-time compute allocation、分层 policy、甚至 pretrain 阶段的 curriculum 设计都有参考价值。贡献量级更像是一个扎实的系统方法：它改善了 cost-quality trade-off，但没有改变 web/GUI agent 的能力上限。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是一个事件驱动的 step-level cascade。默认由小模型执行 GUI policy，只有在监控器判断风险升高时才升级到更强模型。控制器包含两个轻量监控器，输入都是最近若干步交互历史的滚动摘要，而不是完整长上下文。其一是 Stuck Monitor，用来判断当前轨迹是否处于退化执行状态，尤其是循环、无进展、重复点击等局部失败模式；其二是 Milestone Monitor，用来判断当前步骤是否完成了一个语义上有意义的阶段性检查点。作者的设计取舍很明确：如果每步都做强模型校验，成本太高；如果只在最终结果做校验，又太晚，无法纠正中途的语义漂移。Milestone 就是介于两者之间的稀疏监督单位。

训练流程也偏工程化。作者先用小 agent 在多样网站和界面上收集交互轨迹，再让更强的 LLM 对短窗口片段打标签，标注哪些片段是健康推进、哪些是 stuck，以及哪些步骤构成 milestone。然后训练一个紧凑分类器，文中使用 BERT-family encoder，对短历史窗口输出校准后的风险分数。运行时采用带 hysteresis 的稳定控制策略和 bounded recovery budget：不是一次触发就频繁切换，而是要求风险持续存在才升级，并限制恢复阶段的大模型预算，避免控制器抖动和升级失控。方法的关键不是训练一个更强的动作模型，而是把大模型当作按需调用的恢复器和验证器。与 fixed-interval checking 相比，它利用了轨迹异质性；与纯启发式规则相比，它把 stuck 和 milestone 都做成了可学习信号，因此更容易迁移到不同 GUI 环境。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见，实验重点不是追求绝对成功率，而是证明事件驱动升级比“全程大模型”与“固定间隔检查”更划算。作者在多步 GUI benchmark 上评估了任务成功率、强模型调用次数、wall-clock time 和美元成本。结论是：在接近 always-large agent 成功率的前提下，cascade 显著减少了大模型使用量，从而降低时延和推理成本。文中前言给出的现实背景数字是，真实多步 computer-use 任务常有 20–35 个交互步骤、数十万 token、十几分钟级运行时间，若每步都用 frontier model，单任务成本可超过 1 美元；这也是该方法试图解决的实际瓶颈。

消融部分的主要信息有三点。第一，只做 stuck detection 可以改善局部恢复，但对 silent semantic drift 的帮助有限；只做 milestone verification 能抓住部分语义偏航，但对循环和卡死恢复不足；两者结合效果最好，说明它们覆盖的是不同失败模式。第二，事件驱动检查优于固定步长检查，因为固定间隔无法对齐真正的风险时刻，要么浪费预算，要么错过关键节点。第三，轻量监控器的信号质量已经足以支撑稳定路由，不需要再引入一个中等规模的复杂 controller。由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格，无法可靠摘录更细的绝对数值、阈值和各 benchmark 分项结果；精读时需要直接核对主表和附录中的 calibration / threshold sweep。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和方法总图，抓住两个失败模式：stall 与 semantic drift，以及两个监控器分别解决什么。然后看控制逻辑部分，重点理解为什么作者选 milestone 作为稀疏验证单位，而不是每 k 步检查一次。实验部分优先看三类对比：always-large、always-small、fixed-interval checking。再看 ablation，确认 stuck monitor 和 milestone monitor 的互补性。若时间有限，20–30 分钟足够把主要思想读清。

真正值得留意的点有两个。第一，监控器训练标签来自强模型对短窗口的判别，这是一种把 frontier model 蒸馏成运行时控制信号的思路。第二，作者强调 hysteresis 和 recovery budget，这说明路由问题不是单步分类精度，而是闭环控制稳定性。做 agent 系统的人可以从这里学到，controller 的误报和漏报要放在轨迹层面看，而不是只看 step-level F1。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets inference-time compute allocation for computer-use agents. Current GUI agents typically invoke the same large multimodal model at every interaction step, which makes long-horizon tasks slow and expensive. The key observation is that GUI trajectories are not uniformly difficult. Failures cluster around a small number of high-risk moments, mainly in two forms: progress stalls, where the agent loops or repeats equivalent actions without changing the state, and silent semantic drift, where the agent keeps acting plausibly but has already deviated from the user’s intent. The problem is therefore not to build a stronger agent from scratch, but to replace always-on large-model inference with event-triggered escalation.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the strict sense. Its main contribution is deployment-time control for agent inference rather than a new training objective, data recipe, or modeling paradigm. Still, it offers two useful lessons for foundation-model research. First, errors in long interactive trajectories are sparse and structured, which suggests that future agent-oriented pretraining or mid-training may benefit from concentrating supervision around critical transition points rather than treating all steps equally. Second, the paper formulates “when to spend strong-model compute” as a learnable risk prediction problem. That framing is relevant to test-time compute allocation, hierarchical policies, and possibly curriculum design for interactive model training. The contribution is best understood as a solid systems improvement to the cost-quality trade-off, not as a change to the capability frontier.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is an event-driven step-level cascade. A small and cheap GUI policy runs by default, and the system escalates to a stronger model only when lightweight monitors predict degradation. The controller has two learned components, both operating on short rolling summaries of recent interaction history rather than the full trajectory. The Stuck Monitor predicts whether the current behavior reflects degraded execution, especially loops, no-op repetition, or lack of progress. The Milestone Monitor predicts whether the current step completes a semantically meaningful checkpoint. This design addresses a practical trade-off: verifying every step with a strong model is too expensive, while verifying only the final outcome is too late to catch semantic drift. Milestones provide a sparse but timely unit of oversight.

The training pipeline is pragmatic. The authors first collect trajectories from small agents across diverse interfaces. A stronger LLM then labels short windows as healthy vs. degraded and identifies milestone-completing steps. These labels are used to train a compact classifier, implemented with a BERT-family encoder, to output calibrated risk scores. At runtime, the scores feed into a stable control policy with hysteresis and bounded recovery budgets. Escalation is triggered only when degradation persists, and the amount of strong-model recovery is limited to avoid oscillation and runaway cost. The key idea is not to train a better action model, but to treat the large model as an on-demand recoverer and verifier. Compared with fixed-interval checking, the method exploits trajectory heterogeneity. Compared with hand-written heuristics, it turns both stuckness and milestone completion into learnable routing signals.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental focus is on cost-quality trade-offs rather than absolute benchmark leadership. The paper evaluates task success, strong-model invocation frequency, wall-clock latency, and dollar cost on multi-step GUI benchmarks. The main result is that the cascade reaches success rates close to an always-large agent while substantially reducing large-model usage, which in turn lowers latency and inference cost. The introduction provides the practical motivation: realistic computer-use tasks often involve 20–35 interaction steps, hundreds of thousands of tokens, and runtimes in the tens of minutes, with per-task cost exceeding one US dollar when a frontier model is used at every step.

The ablations carry the main insight. Using only stuck detection helps local recovery but does little for silent semantic drift. Using only milestone verification catches some semantic deviation but is weaker at recovering from loops and stalls. Combining both works best, which supports the claim that they cover different failure modes. Event-driven checking also outperforms fixed-interval checking because periodic checks do not align with actual risk concentration. Finally, lightweight monitors are accurate enough to support reliable routing, so the controller itself does not need to be large. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the final tables, so precise benchmark-by-benchmark numbers should be verified directly from the main results and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the introduction and the system overview figure. The two failure modes—stall and semantic drift—are the conceptual anchor. Then read the control logic to understand why milestones are used as the unit of sparse verification instead of checking every k steps. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons against always-large, always-small, and fixed-interval baselines. The ablation section is the most informative part because it shows the complementarity between the two monitors. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to extract the main idea.

Two details are worth extra attention. First, the monitor labels come from a stronger model judging short windows, which is a useful example of distilling frontier-model judgment into runtime control signals. Second, the emphasis on hysteresis and recovery budgets shows that routing is a closed-loop control problem, not just a step-level classification problem. In practice, false positives and false negatives matter at the trajectory level, not only in terms of monitor F1.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和失败检测 ablation；若路由信号不偷看未来，这会是 GUI Agent 降成本的实用 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the method and failure-detection ablations; if the router does not leak future information, this is a useful prior for cheaper GUI agents.

paper.title: WindowsWorld: A Process-Centric Benchmark of Autonomous GUI Agents in Professional Cross-Application Environments
paper.abstract: While GUI agents have shown impressive capabilities in common computer-use tasks such as OSWorld, current benchmarks mainly focus on isolated and single-application tasks. This overlooks a critical real-world requirement of coordinating across multiple applications to accomplish complex profession-specific workflows. To bridge this gap, we present a computer-use benchmark in cross-application workflows, named WindowsWorld, designed to systematically assess GUI Agents on complex multi-step tasks

summary.core_problem: 现有 GUI agent benchmark 多聚焦单应用、孤立任务，无法评估真实职业工作流中跨应用、多步骤协同能力；这篇工作试图补上这一缺口。
summary.importance: 价值主要在 benchmark 设计。它把 GUI agent 评测从单软件操作推进到跨应用流程，且引入过程检查点，能更细地暴露失败模式。对做通用 agent 的人有参考，但对基座预训练研究员更多是外围信息。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建 WindowsWorld：以 16 类职业为引导，通过多 agent 生成任务，再经人工审核，在模拟桌面环境中执行。任务覆盖 17 个常见桌面应用，设置四档难度，并加入中间 inspection 以做过程级评测，而不只看最终成败。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 181 个任务，平均 5.0 个子目标，78% 为天然跨应用任务。实验评测多种领先大模型和 GUI agent，摘要表明当前系统在复杂跨应用流程上仍明显不足，但未给出具体模型名和分数。作为 benchmark，重点应在任务构成、过程指标和错误分布，而非单一榜单。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自哈尔滨工业大学与 Shenzhen Loop Area Institute。未见头部实验室发布，但 benchmark 设计方向清楚。

summary_en.core_problem: Current GUI-agent benchmarks mostly test isolated single-application tasks, missing the cross-application, multi-step workflows required in real professional settings; this work addresses that gap.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly benchmark design. It pushes GUI-agent evaluation from single-app interaction to cross-application workflows and adds process-centric inspection points, which can expose failure modes more precisely. For pretraining researchers, this is peripheral but still useful situational awareness.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces WindowsWorld, a benchmark generated with a multi-agent pipeline guided by 16 occupations, then refined by human review and executed in a simulated desktop environment. It spans 17 common desktop applications, four difficulty levels, and includes intermediate inspections for process-level evaluation rather than only final success.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 181 tasks with an average of 5.0 sub-goals, and 78% are inherently cross-application. Leading LLMs and GUI agents are evaluated, with the abstract indicating substantial weakness on complex professional workflows, though exact model names and scores are not given there. The main value lies in task composition and process metrics rather than leaderboard numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Harbin Institute of Technology and Shenzhen Loop Area Institute. This is not a frontier-lab release, but the benchmark direction is clear.

recommendation.zh: 如果你不做 agent，知道有这么个 benchmark 就够了；真要读，只看任务构造和中间 inspection 设计，榜单本身信息密度不高。
recommendation.en: If agent work is not your lane, just know this benchmark exists; if you do read it, focus on task construction and intermediate inspections, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: FineState-Bench: Benchmarking State-Conditioned Grounding for Fine-grained GUI State Setting
paper.abstract: Despite the rapid progress of large vision-language models (LVLMs), fine-grained, state-conditioned GUI interaction remains challenging. Current evaluations offer limited coverage, imprecise target-state definitions, and an overreliance on final-task success, obscuring where and why agents fail. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{FineState-Bench}, a benchmark that evaluates whether an agent can correctly ground an instruction to the intended UI control and reach the exact target state. Fi

summary.core_problem: 解决 GUI agent 评测中过于粗粒度的问题，尤其是无法准确判断模型是否定位到正确控件并把界面设置到精确目标状态。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent benchmark 工作。对预训练研究员的价值不在 GUI 本身，而在它把 agent 失败拆成定位、交互和状态达成几个阶段，评测信号比单一任务成功率更干净。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FineState-Bench，覆盖桌面、网页和移动端 2209 个实例；每个实例显式定义目标状态。配套 FineState-Metrics，用四阶段指标分别衡量定位成功、交互成功、定位时精确状态成功和交互后精确状态成功。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体参评模型和数值，但从 benchmark 设计看，重点是暴露 LVLM/GUI agent 在细粒度状态设定上的系统性失败，而不是追求单一排行榜。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the coarse evaluation of GUI agents, especially the inability to tell whether a model grounded the right control and reached the exact target UI state.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent benchmark paper. Its value for pretraining researchers is not the GUI domain itself, but the cleaner decomposition of failures into localization, interaction, and exact-state achievement instead of relying on final task success alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: FineState-Bench contains 2,209 instances across desktop, web, and mobile platforms, each with an explicitly specified target state. FineState-Metrics provides a four-stage diagnostic pipeline measuring localization success, interaction success, and exact-state success at different stages.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list the evaluated models or exact numbers. The main contribution is exposing systematic failure modes of LVLM/GUI agents in fine-grained state setting rather than building a leaderboard.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 agent 数据或 tool-use 后训练，这类分阶段指标比 end-task success 更有用；正文未必都要读，先看 metric 设计和失败案例。
recommendation.en: If you work on agent data or tool-use post-training, this staged evaluation is more useful than end-task success; read the metric design and failure cases, not necessarily the whole paper.

paper.title: GUI Agents with Reinforcement Learning: Toward Digital Inhabitants
paper.abstract: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for intelligent systems that perceive and interact with graphical interfaces visually. Yet supervised fine-tuning alone cannot handle long-horizon credit assignment, distribution shifts, and safe exploration in irreversible environments, making Reinforcement Learning (RL) a central methodology for advancing automation. In this work, we present the first comprehensive overview of the intersection between RL and GUI agents,

summary.core_problem: 现有GUI Agent仅靠监督微调无法解决长程信用分配、分布偏移、不可逆环境安全探索问题，缺乏RL与GUI Agent交叉领域的系统梳理
summary.importance: 综述类贡献，首次提出该领域的分类体系，分析现有技术瓶颈与发展趋势
summary.technical_approach: 将现有RL驱动的GUI Agent方法分为离线RL、在线RL、混合策略三类，梳理奖励工程、数据效率、核心技术创新的现状，总结领域发展趋势
summary.experiments: 无新增实验，仅对现有公开工作做归纳分析
summary.authors_note: 作者来自山东大学、香港科技大学、香港大学、上海交通大学

summary_en.core_problem: Existing GUI agents relying only on supervised fine-tuning cannot solve long-horizon credit assignment, distribution shift and safe exploration in irreversible environments, lacking systematic review of the intersection of RL and GUI agents
summary_en.importance: Survey contribution, first proposes a taxonomy for this field, analyzes existing technical bottlenecks and development trends
summary_en.technical_approach: Categorizes existing RL-powered GUI agent methods into offline RL, online RL and hybrid strategies, sorts out current status of reward engineering, data efficiency and key technical innovations, summarizes development trends
summary_en.experiments: No new experiments, only inductive analysis of existing public works
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from Shandong University, HKUST, HKU, Shanghai Jiao Tong University

recommendation.zh: RL与GUI Agent交叉领域的综述，仅作为领域调研备查，无需精读
recommendation.en: Survey of RL-powered GUI agents, only for literature reference, no in-depth reading needed

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Beyond Screenshots: Evaluating VLMs' Understanding of UI Animations
paper.abstract: AI agents operating on user interfaces must understand how interfaces communicate state and feedback to act reliably. As a core communicative modality, animations are increasingly used in modern interfaces, serving critical functional purposes beyond mere aesthetics. Thus, understanding UI animation is essential for comprehensive interface interpretation. However, recent studies of Vision Language Models (VLMs) for UI understanding have focused primarily on static screenshots, leaving it unclear

summary.core_problem: 现有 UI 理解评测多依赖静态截图，无法回答 VLM 是否理解界面动画所表达的状态变化、反馈和交互含义。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个面向 UI 动画理解的小规模密集标注 benchmark。它补上了 GUI/VLM 评测中的动态界面维度，对多模态 Agent 的感知评测有价值，但离基座预训练方法较远。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 AniMINT，包含 300 个密集标注的 UI animation videos；评测 VLM 对动画效果感知、动画目的识别、动画含义解释等层级能力，区分低层运动检测和高层语义解释。
summary.experiments: 系统评测若干当前 VLM。摘要结论是模型能较可靠地检测 primitive motion，但高层动画解释不稳定；具体模型列表、评分协议和数值需要看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing UI-understanding evaluations focus on static screenshots, leaving unclear whether VLMs understand state changes, feedback, and interaction meaning conveyed through UI animations.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a small but densely annotated benchmark for UI animation understanding. It is useful for evaluating GUI-oriented multimodal agents, though it is not directly about base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce AniMINT, a dataset of 300 densely annotated UI animation videos. They evaluate VLMs on multiple levels: perceiving animation effects, identifying animation purposes, and interpreting animation meaning.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates current VLMs. The abstract reports that models can reliably detect primitive motion but remain inconsistent on high-level animation interpretation; exact model lists and scores require the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务定义和错误类型即可；它提醒 native multimodal 训练别只吃截图，但 300 条数据不足以支撑强结论。
recommendation.en: Read the task definition and error taxonomy only; it reminds native multimodal training not to overfit screenshots, but 300 videos cannot support strong claims.

paper.title: Benchmarking and Improving GUI Agents in High-Dynamic Environments
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents have predominantly focused on training paradigms like supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). However, the challenge of high-dynamic GUI environments remains largely underexplored. Existing agents typically rely on a single screenshot after each action for decision-making, leading to a partially observable (or even unobservable) Markov decision process, where the key GUI state including important information for a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是 GUI agent 在高动态界面中的部分可观测问题：如果 agent 每一步只看动作后的单张截图，那么很多关键状态变化会发生在两次截图之间并直接消失，导致决策依据缺失。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练的直接价值较弱，不属于预训练方法、建模目标或训练动态研究。它的启发主要在于两点：一是把“单帧观测不足”明确表述为 POMDP 问题，这对多模态 agent 的训练信号设计有帮助；二是 benchmark 构造强调 hidden interstitial dynamics，而不是静态截图上的 GUI 理解。这更接近 agent evaluation 与系统设计，而不是 foundation model pretraining。
summary.technical_approach:
工作包含 benchmark 和 agent 两部分。Benchmark 方面，作者提出 DynamicGUIBench，覆盖 10 个应用、149 个任务，专门设计四类动态场景：interruptive UI states、ephemeral reference、dynamic list selection、content-triggered interaction。重点不是加入可见干扰，而是构造那些会在动作间隙出现、变化、消失的关键信息，使单截图策略天然信息不足。

方法方面，DynamicUI 以完整交互录屏视频而不是单帧截图作为输入。其 dynamic perceiver 先对视频帧做聚类，再结合 caption 与置信度迭代选出代表性帧，目的是把长视频压缩成可供 VLM 使用的动态上下文。随后 refinement strategy 用来修正“模型计划动作”和“环境实际执行结果”之间的偏差，reflection module 则基于修正后的轨迹给后续步骤提供高层反馈。整体上，这是一个围绕时序观测压缩、执行校正、轨迹反思构建的 GUI agent pipeline。
summary.experiments:
实验主轴是 DynamicGUIBench 和 OSWorld。作者声称 DynamicUI 在高动态 GUI 场景下明显优于现有方法，同时在静态或一般 GUI 理解任务上保持竞争力。Benchmark 构造部分还强调了可复现性：对 Chrome 类和多应用任务提供离线资产与确定性 HTML，以减少网络波动和环境更新带来的评测噪声。

从当前给出的全文片段里，看不到足够完整的数值表，因此不适合复述具体提升百分比。阅读时应重点确认三件事：视频输入带来的提升有多少；这种提升是否主要来自更多观察信息而非 agent 策略本身；在不同动态类别上，dynamic perceiver、refinement、reflection 各自贡献是否清晰。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇只建议泛读。先看 benchmark 定义和四类动态任务，理解作者到底把哪些 GUI 变化视为“单截图不可恢复”的隐藏状态。再看 DynamicUI 的系统图，确认视频压缩流程是否足够轻量，是否存在把长时序信息重新变成少量关键帧摘要的工程取舍。最后扫一眼主结果和模块消融，判断性能提升主要来自 benchmark 更匹配视频输入，还是方法本身确实更善于处理时序 GUI 线索。预计 15 到 25 分钟足够。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a concrete failure mode of GUI agents in highly dynamic environments: if the agent only observes a single screenshot after each action, important interface changes that occur between two observations may be missed entirely, turning the interaction into a partially observable decision process.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to LLM pretraining is limited. This is mainly an agent benchmark and system paper, not a study of pretraining objectives, scaling, tokenization, or optimization. The useful takeaway is conceptual: it frames dynamic GUI interaction as a POMDP caused by sparse temporal observation, and it evaluates agents on hidden interstitial dynamics rather than static screenshot understanding. That matters for multimodal agent training and evaluation, but only indirectly for foundation-model research.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two parts: a benchmark and an agent framework. DynamicGUIBench contains 149 tasks across 10 applications and is designed around four dynamic scenario types: interruptive UI states, ephemeral reference, dynamic list selection, and content-triggered interaction. The key idea is not just to add visible perturbations, but to create cases where task-relevant evidence appears, evolves, or disappears between action steps, so a single screenshot is insufficient.

The proposed agent, DynamicUI, consumes full interaction screen-recording video rather than one post-action frame. Its dynamic perceiver clusters frames and iteratively selects salient centroids using generated captions and confidence scores, effectively compressing long videos into informative dynamic context. A refinement strategy then addresses mismatches between intended actions and actually executed behaviors. Finally, a reflection module uses the refined trajectory to provide higher-level guidance for subsequent decisions. In short, the system is built around temporal observation compression, execution correction, and trajectory-level reflection.
summary_en.experiments:
The main evaluations are on DynamicGUIBench and OSWorld. The paper reports that DynamicUI performs strongly in dynamic GUI settings while remaining competitive on more standard GUI tasks. The benchmark construction also emphasizes reproducibility by providing offline assets and deterministic HTML for Chrome-based and multi-app tasks, which is important because GUI evaluation is otherwise noisy and hard to standardize.

The excerpt provided here does not include enough numeric detail to restate exact margins. When reading the full paper, the key checks are: how much of the gain comes from having video instead of single-frame input, whether the gain remains after controlling for observation budget, and how much each module—dynamic perceiver, refinement, and reflection—contributes across different dynamic scenario types.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the benchmark section and the four dynamic task categories to understand what the authors mean by hidden GUI dynamics. Then read the system diagram for DynamicUI and check how the video is compressed into a manageable context for the VLM. Finally, inspect the main results and ablations to see whether the improvement is mostly due to better temporal observability or to the agent design itself. Around 15 to 25 minutes should be enough.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 benchmark 设计和失败案例；它提醒 GUI Agent 的观测建模比 RL 算法选择更容易成为瓶颈。
recommendation.en: Skim the benchmark design and failures; it suggests observation modeling, not the RL recipe, may be the bottleneck for GUI agents.

paper.title: AutoGUI-v2: A Comprehensive Multi-Modal GUI Functionality Understanding Benchmark
paper.abstract: Autonomous agents capable of navigating Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) hold the potential to revolutionize digital productivity. However, achieving true digital autonomy extends beyond reactive element matching; it necessitates a predictive mental model of interface dynamics and the ability to foresee the "digital world state" resulting from interactions. Despite the perceptual capabilities of modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs), existing benchmarks remain bifurcated (focusing either on black

summary.core_problem: 现有 GUI agent 评测要么只看任务完成率，要么只看静态元素 grounding，无法衡量模型是否真正理解界面功能和交互后的状态转移。
summary.importance: 这是一个 benchmark 工作，价值在于把 GUI agent 的评测从“看见按钮”推进到“理解功能与后果预测”。对通用 agent 研究有意义，也能给多模态世界模型评测提供更细粒度信号，但对预训练本身仍是间接相关。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AutoGUI-v2，多模态 GUI 功能理解 benchmark。核心构建流程是 VLM-human 协同解析多平台截图，递归生成层次化功能区域与交互结果标注，从而评测功能理解、状态变化预测等更深层能力，而不只做元素定位或黑盒任务成功率统计。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出样本规模与具体参评模型。实验应覆盖多个主流 VLM/GUI agent，在功能理解、交互结果预测、静态 grounding 与端到端任务完成之间做区分，证明现有模型在“会点”与“真懂”之间仍有明显落差。作为 benchmark，关键要看标注质量、任务分布和与真实 agent failure 的相关性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中科院自动化所、香港科技创新研究院（CASIA 体系）和上海人工智能实验室。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing GUI-agent benchmarks either focus on end-task success or shallow static grounding, and fail to test whether models understand interface functionality and state transitions.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution that pushes GUI-agent evaluation from element matching toward functional understanding and outcome prediction. It matters for general agent research and multimodal world-model evaluation, though its relevance to pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces AutoGUI-v2, a multimodal benchmark for GUI functionality understanding. It uses a VLM-human collaborative pipeline to recursively parse screenshots from multiple platforms into hierarchical functional regions and interaction-outcome annotations, enabling evaluation of deeper capabilities beyond static grounding.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide dataset size or the exact evaluated models. The experiments likely compare major VLMs/GUI agents on functionality understanding, interaction outcome prediction, static grounding, and end-to-end task completion, showing a gap between clicking competence and true interface understanding. For a benchmark, annotation quality and correlation with real agent failures are the main things to inspect.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from CASIA-related institutions and Shanghai AI Laboratory.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 native multimodal agent，这篇的价值在评测拆得更细；读任务定义和误差分解就够，别把它当方法论文。
recommendation.en: If you care about native multimodal agents, the value is in the finer-grained evaluation; read the task taxonomy and error breakdown, not as a methods paper.
