paper.title: SOLAR-RL: Semi-Online Long-horizon Assignment Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) mature, GUI agents are evolving from static interactions to complex navigation. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training MLLM agents on dynamic GUI tasks, its effective application faces a dilemma. Standard Offline RL often relies on static step-level data, neglecting global trajectory semantics such as task completion and execution quality. Conversely, Online RL captures the long-term dynamics but suffers from

summary.core_problem: 解决GUI Agent训练中Offline RL缺失全局轨迹语义、Online RL交互成本高且环境不稳定的两难问题
summary.importance: 属于通用Agent训练方法创新，提出半在线长程分配强化学习框架
summary.technical_approach: 从静态交互数据重构多样化推演候选，检测轨迹首个失败点，回溯分配稠密步级奖励，将全局轨迹语义融入离线训练过程
summary.experiments: 面向GUI交互任务场景，未公开具体训练模型规模
summary.authors_note: 机构包括vivo AI Lab、浙江实验室、CUHK MMLab、湖北大学，无知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the dilemma that offline RL for GUI agent training lacks global trajectory semantics, while online RL suffers from high interaction cost and environment instability
summary_en.importance: General agent training method innovation, proposes SOLAR-RL semi-online long-horizon RL framework
summary_en.technical_approach: Reconstruct diverse rollout candidates from static data, detect first failure point of trajectories, retroactively assign dense step-wise rewards, integrate global trajectory semantics into offline learning process
summary_en.experiments: Targets GUI interaction task scenarios, no specific model scale disclosed
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include vivo AI Lab, Zhejiang Lab, CUHK MMLab, Hubei University, no well-known authors

recommendation.zh: GUI Agent强化学习训练的增量改进，对预训练研究员仅做领域备查即可，无需深读
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement on GUI agent RL training, only for domain reference for pretraining researchers, no in-depth reading needed

paper.title: VLAA-GUI: Knowing When to Stop, Recover, and Search, A Modular Framework for GUI Automation
paper.abstract: Autonomous GUI agents face two fundamental challenges: early stopping, where agents prematurely declare success without verifiable evidence, and repetitive loops, where agents cycle through the same failing actions without recovery. We present VLAA-GUI, a modular GUI agentic framework built around three integrated components that guide the system on when to Stop, Recover, and Search. First, a mandatory Completeness Verifier enforces UI-observable success criteria and verification at every finish

summary.core_problem: 解决 GUI Agent 在真实交互中常见的两类失败：过早宣称任务完成，以及陷入重复操作循环却无法恢复。
summary.importance: 这是一个通用 GUI agent 可靠性问题，不是单纯换模型刷分。贡献主要是系统设计：把停止判定、失败恢复和外部搜索拆成强制执行的模块，试图提升 agent 在开放界面中的鲁棒性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出模块化框架 VLAA-GUI，核心有三部分：一是 Completeness Verifier，在每次 finish 动作前强制检查是否存在可观察的 UI 证据支持“已完成”；二是 Loop Breaker，用多级规则检测重复失败、界面状态回环和无效反思，并强制切换交互模式或策略；三是按需触发的 Search Agent，在遇到陌生工作流时调用更强 LLM 做在线搜索与步骤补全。方法偏系统编排与控制逻辑，不是新的基础模型或训练范式。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和完整 benchmark 数字，但实验目标显然是比较加入 verifier、loop breaking、search 后对 GUI 自动化成功率和稳定性的提升。更值得关注的应是 ablation：验证器是否真能压制虚假完成，loop breaker 是否减少重复轨迹，以及 search 是否只在陌生流程上带来增益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two recurring failure modes in GUI agents: premature success claims without verifiable evidence, and repetitive action loops with no recovery behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is a reliability problem for general GUI agents rather than a task-specific wrapper. The contribution is mainly a systems design: explicitly separating stopping, recovery, and external search to improve robustness in open-ended interfaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: VLAA-GUI is a modular framework with three components. A mandatory Completeness Verifier checks whether every finish action is backed by UI-observable evidence. A mandatory Loop Breaker detects repeated failures, recurring screen states, and ineffective reflection, then forces strategy or interaction-mode changes. An on-demand Search Agent queries a stronger LLM for unfamiliar workflows. The novelty is in orchestration and control logic, not in a new foundation model or training objective.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes or full benchmark numbers, but the evaluation is clearly about GUI automation success and robustness with and without the verifier, loop breaker, and search modules. The most informative part is likely the ablation: whether the verifier suppresses false completion, whether loop breaking reduces cyclic trajectories, and whether search helps mainly on unfamiliar workflows.

recommendation.zh: 这是 GUI agent 工程补丁而不是新范式；若你做 tool-use reliability，可只看 verifier 和 loop-breaker 设计，别把结果外推到基座能力。
recommendation.en: This is a reliability patch for GUI agents, not a foundation-model advance; read the verifier and loop-breaker design if you care about tool-use robustness, but do not overgeneralize it to base-model capability.

paper.title: Coding with Eyes: Visual Feedback Unlocks Reliable GUI Code Generating and Debugging
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have shown remarkable progress in code generation. However, current agent methods mainly rely on text-output-based feedback (e.g. command-line outputs) for multi-round debugging and struggle in graphical user interface (GUI) that involve visual information. This is mainly due to two limitations: 1) GUI programs are event-driven, yet existing methods cannot simulate user interactions to trigger GUI element logic 2) GUI programs possess vi

summary.core_problem: 解决 GUI 代码生成与调试中，纯文本反馈无法覆盖事件驱动逻辑和视觉布局正确性的难题。
summary.importance: 主要价值在 benchmark 和 agent 反馈回路设计：把视觉反馈引入 GUI coding/debugging。对基座预训练没有直接方法论推进，但对多模态 agent 的评测和闭环调试有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 InteractGUI Bench，覆盖 984 个真实桌面 GUI 任务；同时提出 VF-Coder，多智能体系统通过视觉感知界面状态、模拟交互触发事件逻辑，并基于渲染结果做多轮调试。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调 benchmark 规模和真实任务设置，但未给出所用基础模型、与哪些 coding agent 基线比较、以及具体提升幅度；从定位看，benchmark 可能比方法本身更值得看。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自深圳先进技术相关研究机构和电子科技大学，属于学术界的 GUI coding agent 工作，不是顶级实验室的基座研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets GUI code generation and debugging, where text-only feedback fails to capture event-driven logic and visual layout correctness.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is in benchmark design and feedback-loop engineering: bringing visual feedback into GUI coding/debugging. It does not directly advance foundation-model pretraining, but it is somewhat relevant for multimodal agent evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces InteractGUI Bench with 984 real-world desktop GUI tasks, and proposes VF-Coder, a multi-agent system that perceives rendered interfaces, simulates user interactions, and debugs code using visual feedback over multiple rounds.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract highlights benchmark scale and realism, but does not specify the underlying models, coding-agent baselines, or effect sizes. The benchmark is likely more useful than the method itself.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Shenzhen-based research institutes and UESTC. This is an academic GUI coding-agent paper rather than a foundation-model study from a top lab.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心多模态 agent 评测，可以只看 benchmark 设计；方法本身更像把视觉闭环补上，对基座训练启发有限。
recommendation.en: If you care about multimodal agent evaluation, read the benchmark design; the method is mostly a visual feedback patch, with limited implications for foundation training.

institutions: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

paper.title: UI-Copilot: Advancing Long-Horizon GUI Automation via Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization

summary.core_problem: 如何提升基于多模态大模型(MLLM)的GUI自动化在长时序/长地平线任务中的稳定性与可控性，缓解记忆退化、进度混乱与数值/算术幻觉。
summary.importance: 提出“执行agent + 轻量copilot工具”的协作范式与对应的策略优化方法（TIPO），属于较通用的tool-use与长地平线训练框架探索；对后训练阶段如何学会选择性调用工具、以及记忆/计算能力模块化有启发。
summary.technical_approach: UI-Copilot框架：主GUI agent负责操作执行；轻量copilot按需提供两类能力（Retriever用于记忆检索、Calculator用于数值计算）。关键设计包括memory decoupling（持久观测与瞬时执行上下文分离）以及Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization (TIPO)：将工具选择学习（单轮预测）与任务执行学习（on-policy多轮rollout）分开优化，以提升工具调用的可学性与稳定性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体benchmark名称/规模与量化结果细节，仅描述针对长地平线GUI场景的改进；缺少模型参数量、训练数据/轨迹规模、与强基线（如纯ReAct/纯toolformer式调用/现有GUI agent训练法）的明确对比幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Improving long-horizon MLLM-based GUI automation by mitigating memory degradation, progress confusion, and numerical/math hallucinations.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a collaborative agent+copilot tool-use paradigm and a dedicated policy-optimization recipe (TIPO). It is a fairly general contribution to tool invocation learning and long-horizon agent training, offering insights for post-training and modular capability design.
summary_en.technical_approach: UI-Copilot: a GUI policy agent executes actions while a lightweight copilot provides on-demand assistance as a Retriever (memory) or Calculator (numerics). Uses memory decoupling to separate persistent observations from transient execution context. Proposes Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization (TIPO): optimize tool selection via single-turn prediction and task execution via on-policy multi-turn rollouts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete benchmark names, model/data scale, or numeric gains; it only claims improvements on long-horizon GUI scenarios. Strong-baseline comparisons are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 关注它如何把长地平线稳定性拆成“主策略+轻量工具copilot”并做策略优化；对后训练配方有用，但结论强度取决于任务/工具设定是否干净。
recommendation.en: Look at the decomposition into a main policy plus a lightweight tool-copilot with policy optimization; useful for post-training recipes, but strength depends on how clean the task/tool setup is.

paper.title: Towards Scalable Lightweight GUI Agents via Multi-role Orchestration

summary.core_problem: 轻量级多模态GUI Agent在端侧部署受限（算力/容量不足）且难以在复杂真实GUI工作流中扩展技能与任务覆盖，如何在低成本下提升可扩展性与任务泛化。
summary.importance: 属于通用GUI Agent方向的“能力扩展/编排”思路：用多角色编排替代训练多个专家模型，试图在端侧成本与任务可扩展性之间取得折中；对“轻量模型如何通过系统化编排获得更强任务覆盖”有一定启发，但对基座预训练方法论直接贡献有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出LAMO框架：给轻量MLLM注入GUI特定知识，并通过multi-role orchestration扩展能力边界；核心包含面向角色的训练数据构造/组织（abstract截断处提到role-oriented data synthesis）与在工作流中由不同“角色”分工协作的编排机制，以减少端到端episodic学习对模型容量的依赖、避免训练多专家的成本。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出关键实验细节（具体基座模型规模、训练数据量、对比基线、提升幅度、评测基准名称均不完整）；只能确认其关注端侧轻量MLLM在真实GUI场景的可扩展性与成本权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: Lightweight multimodal GUI agents are bottlenecked by limited on-device capacity and poor scalability in complex real-world GUI workflows; the goal is to improve task coverage and scalability under tight deployment budgets.
summary_en.importance: A system/agent-level approach to expand capabilities via orchestration rather than training multiple experts. Potentially useful for thinking about capability scaling with small models, but it is not directly advancing foundation-model pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes LAMO: inject GUI-specific knowledge into a lightweight MLLM and use multi-role orchestration to extend the capability boundary. The abstract indicates role-oriented data synthesis/organization and workflow-level role division to reduce reliance on end-to-end episodic learning and avoid costly multi-expert training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete experimental specifics (model sizes, data scale, baselines, or exact gains). It mainly claims improved scalability/cost trade-offs for lightweight MLLMs in realistic GUI scenarios.

recommendation.zh: 端侧 GUI agent 的编排思路而非训练突破：只看多角色分工与成本对比表，判断是否值得在产品栈里替代多专家模型。
recommendation.en: Orchestration over training novelty: just read the multi-role decomposition and the cost/latency table to decide if it can replace multi-expert models in your stack.

paper.title: Mobile GUI Agents under Real-world Threats: Are We There Yet?
paper.abstract: Recent years have witnessed a rapid development of mobile GUI agents powered by large language models (LLMs), which can autonomously execute diverse device-control tasks based on natural language instructions. The increasing accuracy of these agents on standard benchmarks has raised expectations for large-scale real-world deployment, and there are already several commercial agents released and used by early adopters. However, are we really ready for GUI agents integrated into our daily devices a

summary.core_problem: 评估移动 GUI agent 在真实世界威胁下是否仍能稳定完成任务，尤其是面对广告、用户生成内容等不可信界面元素时的鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 Agent benchmark/robustness 评测，不是新代理范式，但问题设定是现实部署前必须补的一环：现有静态 benchmark 高分未必能转化为真实设备可用性。
summary.technical_approach: 论文指出现有 GUI agent 测试环境为追求可复现，通常使用内容静态、干净的 app 页面，遗漏了现实中最常见的第三方噪声与诱导内容。作者因此构造贴近真实威胁的评测设定，考察 agent 在受污染界面上的任务表现与安全性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型名单和指标数字，但实验主线应是比较标准 benchmark 与威胁场景下的性能落差。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于提醒：下游 agent 能力测量容易被干净环境高估。
summary.authors_note: 从作者名单与题目看，团队来自人机交互/系统方向，聚焦移动端 GUI agent 的真实部署风险。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether mobile GUI agents remain reliable under real-world threats, especially untrusted interface content such as ads, emails, and user-generated media.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent robustness/benchmark contribution rather than a new agent paradigm, but it targets a missing pre-deployment validation step: strong results on static benchmarks may not translate to real-device usability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper argues that existing GUI-agent benchmarks rely on static and sanitized app content for reproducibility, thereby missing realistic third-party noise and malicious distractions. It then introduces threat-oriented evaluation settings to measure robustness and safety under contaminated interfaces.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model names or exact metrics, but the central experiment is likely the gap between standard benchmark performance and performance under threat scenarios. For pretraining researchers, the main takeaway is about measurement bias rather than method design.
summary_en.authors_note: Based on the author list and topic, the team appears to come from HCI/systems research with a focus on real-world deployment risks of mobile GUI agents.

recommendation.zh: 不是方法论文，但 benchmark 设定很对：很多 GUI agent 分数是被干净环境抬出来的，只看威胁模型和性能掉点即可。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper, but the benchmark premise is right: many GUI-agent scores are inflated by sanitized environments; read the threat model and the drop tables only.

paper.title: ClawGUI: A Unified Framework for Training, Evaluating, and Deploying GUI Agents
paper.abstract: GUI agents drive applications through their visual interfaces instead of programmatic APIs, interacting with arbitrary software via taps, swipes, and keystrokes, reaching a long tail of applications that CLI-based agents cannot. Yet progress in this area is bottlenecked less by modeling capacity than by the absence of a coherent full-stack infrastructure: online RL training suffers from environment instability and closed pipelines, evaluation protocols drift silently across works, and trained ag

summary.core_problem: GUI Agent 缺乏统一的训练、评测和部署基础设施，在线 RL 训练不稳定、评测协议漂移、部署难以触达真实设备
summary.importance: 系统/工程贡献：首个开源支持并行虚拟环境+真实设备的 GUI Agent RL 基建，并统一了评测协议
summary.technical_approach: 三件套：ClawGUI-RL（GiGPO + Process Reward Model 做 step-level 稠密监督）、ClawGUI-Eval（6 benchmark/11+ 模型，95.8% 可复现率）、ClawGUI-Deploy。主要是框架整合而非方法创新
summary.experiments: 在 6 个主流 GUI benchmark 上做标准化复现，对 11+ 模型评测，具体提升数字未详述
summary.authors_note: 浙大团队（Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen），之前在 Agent 领域有持续工作

summary_en.core_problem: GUI agents lack a unified full-stack infrastructure for training, evaluation, and deployment; online RL is unstable and eval protocols silently drift
summary_en.importance: System/engineering contribution: first open-source RL infra supporting both parallel virtual envs and real physical devices plus standardized eval
summary_en.technical_approach: Three-part framework: ClawGUI-RL (GiGPO + Process Reward Model for dense step-level supervision), ClawGUI-Eval (standardized across 6 benchmarks, 11+ models), ClawGUI-Deploy. Integration rather than novel method
summary_en.experiments: Reproduction study across 6 GUI benchmarks, 11+ models, claims 95.8% reproducibility rate
summary_en.authors_note: ZJU team including Yueting Zhuang and Yongliang Shen, with prior agent work

recommendation.zh: 基建型工作，对 pretrain 研究员价值有限；如果你关心 GUI Agent RL 的 reward 稠密化设计，扫一下 PRM 部分即可，其余不必细看
recommendation.en: Infra paper with limited value for pretrain researchers; if you care about dense reward shaping for GUI RL, skim the PRM section, otherwise skip

paper.title: ClawGUI: A Unified Framework for Training, Evaluating, and Deploying GUI Agents

summary.core_problem: GUI 智能体研究的主要瓶颈不在“模型是否足够大”，而在缺少一套端到端、可复现、可落地的全栈基础设施：在线 RL 训练难以稳定运行（环境漂移、奖励稀疏、真实设备难接入）、评测协议在不同论文间暗中漂移导致不可比、训练出的策略很少真正部署到真实设备与真实用户场景。
summary.importance: GUI 是通用的人机交互层，GUI agent 理论上可操作任意 App/设备，覆盖 CLI/API agent 无法触达的长尾应用。若没有统一的训练-评测-部署闭环，研究进展会被“工程不可复现/不可对齐/不可交付”持续拖慢：RL 结果难复现、benchmark 数字难对齐、真实世界价值难验证。
summary.technical_approach:
ClawGUI 提供三模块一体化框架：
(1) ClawGUI-RL：开源 GUI agent 在线 RL 基础设施，支持 Docker 并行 Android 模拟器与真实物理设备训练；集成 GiGPO（相对 episode-level GRPO 的 step-level 变体）并引入 Process Reward Model（PRM）提供更密集的逐步奖励/监督，以缓解长时序 GUI 任务的稀疏回报与信用分配问题；核心工程点在环境管理（长跑稳定性、设备健康、信号采集）与奖励塑形（PRM）。
(2) ClawGUI-Eval：对 6 个 benchmark、11+ 模型执行“严格三阶段评测流水线”，把每个模型的评测选择（prompt、坐标归一化、分辨率、采样配置等）显式 pin 住，目标是让结果可复现而非“名义可比”。
(3) ClawGUI-Agent：面向真实用户的部署层，覆盖 Android/HarmonyOS/iOS，并接入 12+ 聊天平台；提出混合 CLI-GUI 控制策略（CLI 的精确性 + GUI 的通用覆盖）以及持久化个性化记忆系统，形成研究到产品的闭环。
summary.experiments: 端到端验证：在 ClawGUI-RL 内训练 ClawGUI-2B，并在 MobileWorld GUI-Only 上评测：SR=17.1%，优于同规模 MAI-UI-2B（11.1%），也超过更大但未训练的 Qwen3-VL-32B（11.9%）与 UI-Venus-72B（16.4%）。消融：将 episode-level GRPO 替换为 step-level GiGPO，SR 提升 2.6%（14.5%→17.1%），直接支持“密集信用分配/过程奖励”对 GUI RL 的价值。评测侧：ClawGUI-Eval 在 6 benchmark、11+ 模型上对已发表 baseline 的复现率达 95.8%，强调协议锁定的重要性。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- 重点章节：Introduction（3 个 gap 的问题定义与动机）；ClawGUI-RL 设计（并行模拟器+真实设备、环境健康管理、PRM 与 GiGPO 的结合方式、训练闭环）；ClawGUI-Eval 的“三阶段流水线”与“pin 评测配置”的具体清单；ClawGUI-Agent 的混合 CLI-GUI 控制与个性化记忆（部署闭环如何做）。
- 重点图表/结果：端到端 SR 对比（ClawGUI-2B vs MAI-UI-2B vs 大模型）；GiGPO vs GRPO 的消融提升；95.8% reproduction rate 的复现统计（看其覆盖的 benchmark/模型与误差来源）。
- 创新点抓手：①首个开源且验证支持“并行虚拟环境+真实设备”的 GUI RL 基建；②用 PRM 做 step-level 密集监督并与 GiGPO 配合解决稀疏奖励；③评测协议显式固化（prompt/分辨率/坐标/采样）以实现可复现；④研究到真实多平台部署与持久化个性化记忆。

skim（泛读）：
- 先看 Introduction（为什么需要统一框架）；再看贡献列表与端到端结果段（17.1%、2.6% 提升、95.8% 复现率）；最后快速扫 ClawGUI 三模块的接口与能力边界（RL/Eval/Agent 各解决什么）。
- 若只关心训练：看 GiGPO+PRM 与真实设备支持；若只关心评测：看三阶段评测与配置 pin；若只关心落地：看多 OS/多聊天平台接入与混合控制策略。
summary.authors_note: 作者将“GUI agent 的进展瓶颈”重新定位为全栈基础设施缺失，并用一个统一 harness 同时解决训练（可扩展且可在真实设备上跑）、评测（协议可复现）、部署（真实用户可用）三件事；论文的核心价值在于把分散的研究环节变成可复用、可对齐、可交付的工程系统，并用端到端训练与复现率数据证明其必要性。

summary_en.core_problem: Progress on GUI agents is bottlenecked less by model capacity than by the lack of an end-to-end, reproducible, deployable full-stack infrastructure: online RL training is unstable (environment drift, sparse rewards, limited real-device access), evaluation protocols silently vary across papers (prompting, coordinate normalization, resolution, sampling), and trained agents rarely reach real users on real devices.
summary_en.importance: GUIs are the universal interaction layer; GUI agents can in principle operate arbitrary apps/devices, covering the long tail beyond CLI/API agents. Without a unified train–eval–deploy loop, the field suffers from non-reproducible RL results, non-comparable benchmark numbers, and unverified real-world utility—slowing practical progress even when modeling improves.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ClawGUI is an integrated open-source framework with three tightly coupled modules:
(1) ClawGUI-RL: scalable online RL infrastructure for GUI agents with validated support for both Docker-parallel Android emulators and real physical devices; integrates GiGPO (step-level variant vs episode-level GRPO) and a Process Reward Model (PRM) to provide dense step-wise supervision, addressing sparse long-horizon rewards and credit assignment; key engineering focus is robust environment management and reward shaping.
(2) ClawGUI-Eval: a strict three-stage evaluation pipeline across 6 benchmarks and 11+ models, explicitly pinning per-model evaluation choices (prompt format, coordinate conventions, image resolution, sampling configs) to make results reproducible rather than nominally comparable.
(3) ClawGUI-Agent: deployment layer bringing trained agents to Android/HarmonyOS/iOS via 12+ chat platforms; introduces a hybrid CLI–GUI control strategy (CLI precision + GUI universality) and persistent personalized memory for long-term user adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: End-to-end validation: ClawGUI-2B is trained entirely within ClawGUI-RL and evaluated on MobileWorld GUI-Only, achieving 17.1% success rate (SR) vs 11.1% for same-scale MAI-UI-2B, and surpassing larger untrained models such as Qwen3-VL-32B (11.9%) and UI-Venus-72B (16.4%). Ablation: replacing episode-level GRPO with step-level GiGPO improves SR by 2.6% (14.5%→17.1%), supporting the benefit of dense credit assignment in GUI RL. Evaluation: ClawGUI-Eval reproduces published baselines with a 95.8% reproduction rate across 6 benchmarks and 11+ models.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive):
- Key sections: Introduction (the three gaps); ClawGUI-RL design (parallel emulators + real devices, environment health management, how PRM and GiGPO are integrated); ClawGUI-Eval’s three-stage pipeline and the exact list of pinned evaluation knobs; ClawGUI-Agent (hybrid CLI–GUI control and persistent personalization/memory).
- Key figures/results: SR comparisons (ClawGUI-2B vs baselines and larger models); GiGPO vs GRPO ablation; the 95.8% reproduction-rate table and its coverage/error sources.
- Innovation checklist: (i) first open-source GUI RL infra validated on both large-scale virtual envs and real devices; (ii) PRM-driven step-level dense supervision combined with GiGPO for sparse-reward GUI tasks; (iii) evaluation protocol pinning for reproducibility; (iv) real multi-OS deployment with hybrid control and persistent personalization.

skim (overview):
- Read Introduction, contributions, and the headline end-to-end results (17.1% SR, +2.6% from GiGPO, 95.8% reproduction). Then skim each module’s scope and interfaces (RL/Eval/Agent).
- If you only care about training: focus on GiGPO+PRM and real-device support; for evaluation: the pinned-config pipeline; for deployment: multi-platform chat integration and hybrid control.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper reframes the GUI-agent bottleneck as an infrastructure problem and delivers a unified harness that closes the loop across training (scalable and real-device-capable), evaluation (protocol-reproducible), and deployment (real-user accessible). Its main value is turning fragmented research components into a reusable, auditable, and shippable system, backed by end-to-end training gains and high baseline reproduction rates.

recommendation.zh: 只需看评测协议与部署链路那几节：它更像“把坑填平”的基础设施论文，结论不改变模型 prior，但能省掉大量不可复现的工程时间。
recommendation.en: Skim the evaluation protocol and deployment pipeline sections: it’s mostly infra debt payoff, not a new modeling prior, but it can save you from weeks of irreproducible GUI-agent engineering.

paper.title: EE-MCP: Self-Evolving MCP-GUI Agents via Automated Environment Generation and Experience Learning

summary.core_problem: 在结合 MCP（结构化 API 调用）与 GUI（视觉界面操作）的 computer-use agents 中，如何让智能体学会在每一步“何时用 MCP、何时用 GUI”，并在跨应用（如浏览器、IDE、表格软件）场景下实现可持续的自动化自我进化（self-evolving），而不是依赖一次性 SFT 或低效的在线 RL？
summary.importance: 混合式 CUA 已成为软件自动化的主流形态，但现有训练往往把样本/奖励一视同仁，缺乏对失败模式的诊断与针对性数据生成，也缺少对“工具调用率低、模态选择不当”等系统问题的机制化解决。本文把 MCP–GUI 协同提升为统一的混合策略学习问题，并给出自动闭环：性能剖析→定向环境/任务生成→轨迹收集与过滤→蒸馏或经验增强→再评估。其关键价值在于：揭示不同进化机制对应不同失败模式，且最优机制依赖应用的 MCP/GUI 任务构成，从而为真实部署提供“按应用选机制”的工程原则。
summary.technical_approach: 作者将 computer use 形式化为 MDP：状态包含截图 s_visual、可用 MCP 工具描述 s_mcp 与历史 s_history；动作空间由两种模态组成：MCP 结构化调用与 GUI 交互（点击/输入/滚动/快捷键等）。任务 τ 由目标 g、初始状态 s0、难度 d、技能类别集合 c（六类通用技能：检索/操作/搜索/执行/导航/配置）以及 LLM-judge 评分函数 φ_judge 构成。在此统一表述下提出 EE-MCP 自进化框架（闭环自动流水线）：(1) 多维性能剖析定位系统性短板；(2) 自动环境生成与验证，产生针对性训练任务；(3) 轨迹收集与质量过滤；(4) 两类互补进化机制：蒸馏（distillation）与经验增强（experience bank）。经验库通过 LLM 对比轨迹提炼“简洁可执行规则”，按技能类别组织、容量受限，并按应用类型过滤以避免跨应用污染；可在推理时直接注入以提升行为，无需再训练。核心论断：蒸馏更擅长修复 MCP 主导任务的失败模式；经验库更擅长 GUI 密集任务的推理期纠错，因此需要 application-aware 的机制选择。
summary.experiments: 作者在多应用场景（Chrome、VS Code、LibreOffice Calc）上做系统对比分析，评估混合 MCP+GUI 智能体在不同任务构成下的自进化收益，并报告关键发现：不同应用的最优进化机制不同——例如 Chrome 从蒸馏获益最大（+17.8pp），而 GUI 操作更重的 VS Code 主要受益于经验库（+10pp）。实验还强调：distillation 与 experience augmentation 针对的是“根本不同的失败模式”，不能互相替代；需要通过性能剖析与任务构成识别来选择机制，并通过自动环境生成与质量控制保证迭代有效。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议）
1) Problem Formulation：精读 MDP 定义（状态三元组：截图/工具描述/历史；动作两模态）与任务 τ 的构成（含难度、技能标签、LLM-judge），这是后续“按任务构成选机制”的理论支点。
2) Figure 1（框架总览，若文中给出）：沿着闭环链路逐块理解：性能剖析→定向生成→收集/过滤→蒸馏/经验库→再评估；关注哪些环节是“全自动”。
3) Experience Bank 机制：重点看轨迹对比如何抽取规则、规则的组织方式（按技能类别、容量限制）、以及“按应用过滤避免污染”的工程细节；理解其为何能在不微调的情况下提升推理。
4) Cross-application 结果与消融：精读 Chrome/VS Code/Calc 的对比，理解为何 MCP 主导 vs GUI 密集会导致蒸馏/经验库收益差异，并把它总结成可迁移的选择准则。
5) 失败模式诊断（gap analysis）：关注作者如何把错误归因到“模态选择不当”“工具调用不足”“GUI 操作链不稳”等，并据此驱动任务生成。

skim（泛读建议）
1) Introduction：抓住统一混合策略学习视角与“机制互补、按应用选机制”的主结论。
2) 框架图 + 经验库概念：理解闭环自动化与 inference-time 规则注入。
3) 关键结果段落：只看跨应用结论（Chrome 蒸馏更强、VS Code 经验库更强）与提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：MCP 与 GUI 不是两套独立技能，而是需要在序列决策中动态权衡的统一混合策略；同时，自我进化不应只靠“更多数据/更多 RL”，而应先做可解释的性能剖析与失败模式定位，再用自动环境生成提供针对性训练信号。更重要的是，蒸馏与经验库修复的失败类型不同，必须依据应用的 MCP–GUI 任务构成进行机制选择。

summary_en.core_problem: For computer-use agents that combine structured MCP API calls with GUI interactions, how can an agent learn a unified hybrid policy that decides when to use MCP vs GUI at each step, and how can it self-improve iteratively across diverse applications via an automated closed loop rather than one-shot SFT or inefficient online RL?
summary_en.importance: Hybrid MCP+GUI agents are increasingly practical, yet current training often lacks principled modality balancing, systematic failure diagnosis, and targeted data generation—leading to issues like low tool-invocation rates and brittle GUI action chains. This paper elevates MCP–GUI interplay to a unified policy-learning problem and proposes an automated self-evolving pipeline. A key engineering takeaway is that different evolution mechanisms address fundamentally different failure modes, and the best mechanism depends on an application’s MCP/GUI task composition—yielding an application-aware strategy for real deployments.
summary_en.technical_approach: Computer use is formulated as an MDP where the state includes a screenshot (s_visual), available MCP tool descriptions (s_mcp), and action history (s_history). Actions come from two modalities: MCP actions (structured tool calls following MCP) and GUI actions (click/type/scroll/shortcuts). A task τ includes a natural-language goal g, initial state s0, difficulty d, required skill categories c (six app-agnostic skills: retrieval, manipulation, search/query, execution/automation, navigation/browsing, configuration/settings), and an LLM-judge scoring function φ_judge. On top of this, EE-MCP proposes a fully automated self-evolving framework: multi-dimensional performance profiling to identify systematic weaknesses; automated environment generation and validation to create targeted tasks; trajectory collection with quality filtering; and two complementary evolution mechanisms—distillation and an experience bank. The experience bank extracts concise actionable rules via LLM-based trajectory comparison, organizes them by skill with capacity limits, and filters by application type to avoid cross-app contamination; it can improve inference without additional fine-tuning. Central claim: distillation is most effective for MCP-dominant tasks, while the experience bank better fixes GUI-intensive failures, requiring application-aware mechanism selection.
summary_en.experiments: The paper conducts cross-application studies on Chrome, VS Code, and LibreOffice Calc to evaluate self-evolution under different MCP–GUI compositions. A headline finding is that the optimal mechanism varies by application: Chrome benefits most from distillation (+17.8pp), whereas GUI-heavy VS Code benefits primarily from the experience bank (+10pp). Results support that distillation and experience augmentation target different underlying failure modes and are not interchangeable; performance profiling plus targeted environment/task generation is used to drive effective iterative improvement.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive)
1) Problem Formulation: the MDP/state/action definitions and the task tuple τ (difficulty, skill tags, LLM-judge) underpin the “application-aware mechanism selection” thesis.
2) Figure 1 (framework overview, if present): trace the closed loop end-to-end and note what is fully automated.
3) Experience Bank: how rules are extracted from trajectory comparisons, how they are organized (by skill, capacity limits), and how app-type filtering prevents cross-app contamination; why this enables inference-time gains without fine-tuning.
4) Cross-application results/ablations: study Chrome vs VS Code vs Calc to understand why MCP-dominant vs GUI-intensive compositions favor different mechanisms; distill this into a practical selection guideline.
5) Gap analysis: how failures are diagnosed (modality misuse, low tool calls, brittle GUI chains) and mapped to targeted task generation.

skim (quick read)
1) Introduction: unified hybrid policy view + main conclusion (mechanisms are complementary; choose per app composition).
2) Framework figure + experience bank concept: closed-loop automation and inference-time rule injection.
3) Key results paragraphs: the cross-app takeaways and improvement magnitudes.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s stance is that MCP and GUI are not independent skills but two modalities that must be balanced within a single sequential decision policy. Self-improvement should be driven by interpretable profiling and targeted environment generation, not just more generic training. Crucially, distillation and experience banks fix different failure types, so mechanism choice must be conditioned on each application’s MCP–GUI task composition.

recommendation.zh: 更像工程闭环手册：性能剖析→定向环境生成→过滤蒸馏，告诉你“按应用选机制”；只看各机制对应的失败模式对照表，别纠结总分。
recommendation.en: Reads like an ops playbook: profiling → targeted env generation → filtering/distillation, with “pick mechanisms per app”; just study the failure-mode-to-mechanism mapping table, not the headline scores.

paper.title: CORA: Conformal Risk-Controlled Agents for Safeguarded Mobile GUI Automation

summary.core_problem: 移动端GUI自动化代理（VLM/LLM驱动）从“建议”走向“代操作”后，动作空间巨大且不可逆高风险（转账、授权、隐私外发等）。现有防护（提示词自检、启发式规则、VLM-critic）缺乏形式化保证、难以在分布漂移下校准，且无法提供用户可调的风险-自主性权衡。
summary.importance: 移动端场景比桌面更脆弱：屏幕小导致误触更频繁；权限/支付/社交与真实身份资产强绑定；通知/弹窗/覆盖层带来持续的注入面；个性化与版本碎片化导致强分布漂移。若没有“可验证的执行风险控制”，代理一旦误执行会造成不可逆损失，因此需要可部署、可校准、可调参的安全控制层。
summary.technical_approach:
CORA提出“选择性动作执行”（带拒绝/弃权的预测）范式：基础策略每步提出动作a^t，安全控制器决定Execute或Abstain。

核心由三部分耦合：
1) Guardian风险模型Rψ：学习“动作条件风险”——在当前GUI状态与历史下，执行该特定候选动作会导致伤害的概率/风险（不是泛化的‘是否危险’评分，而是对‘执行这个动作’的条件化评估）。
2) Conformal Calibration（CRC）：不直接阈值化原始风险分数，而用Conformal Risk Control把执行/拒绝边界校准到满足用户指定风险预算α（对“已执行动作中的伤害率”给出统计保证）。同时面向部署的分布漂移，扩展为加权校准（covariate shift下的weighted conformal）与更保守的序列化处理以应对时序相关。
3) Diagnostician干预模型：对被拒绝的动作进行多模态反思与最小化干预建议，将拒绝细分为Confirm/Reflect/Abort，目标是在降低伤害的同时控制打扰成本。

额外机制：Goal-Lock（目标锁定）冻结用户目标g，将屏幕文本视为不可信证据以缓解间接注入/目标劫持。

评估与报告方式：强调风险-覆盖率（coverage=执行比例）与安全-有用性-打扰的前沿曲线，而非单一分数，直接对应部署中的“少打扰 vs 少出事”的可调权衡。
summary.experiments: 提出Phone-Harm移动端安全基准：Harm-150（150个人工撰写高风险任务，含逐步伤害标注）+ Normal-150（150个同协议构造的纯良性任务），用于对抗式安全评估与混合流量（更贴近部署）分析。Harm-150将OS-Harm威胁框架迁移到移动端，强调不可逆与隐私敏感动作（授权、支付、外发）。数据由人工撰写与人工标注，并与训练分布保持隔离以降低泄漏风险。论文主张用CORA在该基准上展示：在给定α下对“执行伤害率”实现校准控制，并通过Diagnostician在拒绝时减少不必要中断。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim（泛读）】
- 读Introduction：把握移动端GUI风险来源、为何现有prompt/heuristic/critic不够。
- 重点看“Selective action execution”定义与风险-覆盖率/前沿报告协议（理解论文评价口径）。
- 快速扫Phone-Harm构建与Harm-150/Normal-150设定（理解任务与标注粒度）。

【must_read（精读）】
- 精读方法部分三件套：Guardian（动作条件风险建模目标与输入输出）、CRC校准（α含义、保证对象是‘executed-harm rate’而非总体风险、以及加权校准处理shift）、Diagnostician（Confirm/Reflect/Abort的触发逻辑与如何降低打扰）。
- 精读Goal-Lock：其威胁模型假设（屏幕文本不可信）与对注入的覆盖边界。
- 精读实验：风险-覆盖率曲线、混合流量设置、以及在shift/序列依赖下保证是否仍成立（看是否采用保守扩展/加权）。
- 建议对照：CORA是post-policy、pre-action控制层——与“训练时对齐/奖励惩罚”不同，关注其可插拔性与部署校准流程。
summary.authors_note: 作者核心主张是把GUI安全从“让模型更乖”转为“对已执行动作的伤害率做可校准、可验证的统计控制”，并提供用户可调α来显式管理风险-自主性权衡；同时用Phone-Harm把移动端不可逆高风险动作系统化为可评测基准。

summary_en.core_problem: Mobile GUI agents powered by VLMs/LLMs are moving from assistance to autonomous execution, where a single mis-click can trigger irreversible harm (payments, permissions, privacy disclosures). Existing safeguards (prompting, heuristics, VLM-as-critic) are brittle, poorly calibrated under distribution shift, and provide no formal, user-tunable guarantees.
summary_en.importance: Mobile environments amplify risk: small screens increase grounding/mis-tap errors; permissions/payments/social actions are tightly coupled to real identity and assets; notifications/pop-ups create a constant injection surface; personalization and app/version churn induce strong distribution shift. Deployment therefore needs a calibrated execution controller with explicit statistical guarantees, not ad-hoc filters.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CORA frames safety as selective action execution (prediction with abstention). At each step, a base policy proposes an action a^t; a safety controller decides Execute vs Abstain.

CORA couples three components:
1) An action-conditional Guardian model Rψ that estimates the risk of executing the specific proposed action in the current GUI state/history.
2) A Conformal Calibration module using Conformal Risk Control (CRC) to calibrate the execute/abstain boundary to satisfy a user-specified risk budget α on the executed-harm rate (rather than thresholding raw scores). For deployment realism, it incorporates weighted calibration under covariate shift and conservative extensions for sequential dependence.
3) A trainable Diagnostician that handles rejected actions with minimal interventions—Confirm, Reflect, or Abort—to reduce harm while controlling user interruption.

Additionally, CORA uses Goal-Lock: it freezes the user goal and treats on-screen text as untrusted evidence to mitigate indirect prompt injection/goal hijacking.

Evaluation is reported as risk–coverage and safety–helpfulness–interruption frontiers, matching the real deployment trade-off between autonomy and safety.
summary_en.experiments: Introduces Phone-Harm, a mobile benchmark with Harm-150 (150 human-authored harmful tasks with step-level harm labels) and a matched Normal-150 (150 benign tasks) for both adversarial safety testing and mixed-traffic analysis. Harm-150 adapts OS-Harm threat framing (misuse, injection, misbehavior) to mobile, emphasizing irreversible/privacy-sensitive actions (permissions, payments, external disclosures). The benchmark is human-authored/annotated and kept disjoint from pipeline-generated training data to reduce leakage. Experiments are positioned to show CRC-calibrated control of executed-harm rate at target α and reduced unnecessary interruptions via the Diagnostician.
summary_en.reading_guide:
【skim】
- Introduction: why mobile GUI safety is harder; limitations of prompt/heuristic/critic safeguards.
- The “selective execution” formulation and the risk–coverage / frontier-based reporting.
- Phone-Harm setup (Harm-150 vs Normal-150) to understand the evaluation target.

【must_read】
- Method details: (i) Guardian’s action-conditional risk objective, (ii) CRC calibration and what guarantee is provided (executed-harm rate), plus weighted conformal for shift and conservative sequential handling, (iii) Diagnostician’s Confirm/Reflect/Abort design and interruption minimization.
- Goal-Lock: threat model assumptions and what injection channels it covers.
- Experimental plots: risk–coverage curves, mixed-traffic evaluation, and robustness under shift/sequential dependence.
- Conceptual positioning: CORA is post-policy, pre-action (plug-in controller), distinct from training-time alignment.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s key thesis is to move from “make the agent behave” to “statistically control the harm rate of executed actions” with a user-tunable α, enabled by conformal risk control, and to ground mobile-specific evaluation via the Phone-Harm benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 把“可调风险预算+校准保证”引入GUI代操作，比提示词自检靠谱；建议细读风险控制形式化与校准实验，便于落地成安全层。
recommendation.en: Brings tunable risk budgets + calibration-style guarantees to GUI actuation, more actionable than prompt self-checks; read the formal risk control and calibration experiments for deployment.
